correctAnswer: Uvamile ukuveza izwi lakho ngokudlidliza kwamathambo ekhanda agcizelela amafrekhwezi aphansi
explanation: Ukudluliswa kwamathambo kudlulisa izimpondo zomculo eziphansi ngqo emazweni angaphakathi; irekhodi langaphandle lithola umsindo womoya kuphela.

question: Ocwaningweni lwezobugebengu, kungani amathontsi egazi amancane akhombisa i-engeli yokushayisana cishe ku-90 degrees?

explanation: Uma kushaywa ngengxenye ye-engeli efanele, ukuminyana kobuso boketshezi kusakazeka ngokulinganayo kube yindilinga enobudlelwane obu-1.0.

question: Kungani ukhiye wensimbi ojwayelekile ushisa emva kokushukunyiswa ngokukhulu ngaphakathi kuvaliweyo yomshini?

correctAnswer: Ufriction wokuqina phakathi kwamagquma okhiye namaphini angaphakathi wokuvali uguqula amandla okunyakaza ube ukufudumala
explanation: Ukuxubha surfaces ze-brass ngokumelene namaphini esikhuphukile sesitshalo kuveza ukufudumala ngenxa yokuxhumana okuncane

question: Kungani iwashi likagogo elidala elinependulum lensimbi lishukuma kancane ehlobo kunebusika?
options: Ukubanda okubangelwa ukufudumala kwandisa ubude bependulum, kwandisa isikhathi sokushukuma kwayo
Amandla adonsela phansi ayancipha ezinyangeni zasehlobo
correctAnswer: Ukubanda okubangelwa ukufudumala kwandisa ubude bependulum, kwandisa isikhathi sokushukuma kwayo
explanation: Isikhathi T = 2*pi*sqrt(L/g). Izinga lokushisa eliphezulu likhuphula ubude bependulum L, lenyusa isikhathi sokushukuma futhi kwehlise iwashi.

question: Kungani amapayipi amanzi eqhwa futhi eqhuma ikakhulukazi lapho izinga lokushisa lomoya lehla kakhulu ngaphansi kuka-0 degrees Celsius?
options: Amanzi akhethekile andulela cishe ngo-9 ekhulwini lapho eba iqhwa le-hexagonal
Iqhwa liyancipha futhi lidonse amapayipi ngaphakathi
Amanzi aqandayo akhiqiza igesi ye-hydrogen ephahlazayo
Insimbi yekhopha iyancipha futhi iqheke ngokwayo
correctAnswer: Amanzi akhethekile andulela cishe ngo-9 ekhulwini lapho eba iqhwa le-hexagonal
explanation: Amabhondi e-hydrogen akha ulayini we-crystalline ovulekile eqhweni eliqinile, okwandisa ivolumu futhi kudale ingcindezi enkulu yamanzi emapayipini avaliwe.

question: Kungani ugesi wesibhakabhaka uvela ngokushesha kulo lonke uhlangothi lwesibhakabhaka kanti umsindo wezulu uthatha imizuzwana embalwa ukufika?

Umsindo wezulu udalwa emamayela ambalwa phezulu esibhakabhakeni
Izindlebe zomuntu ziphendula kancane kunamehlo omuntu
correctAnswer: Ugesi uhamba cishe ngamakhilomitha angama-300,000 ngomzuzwana kanti umsindo emoyeni uhamba kuphela ngamamitha angu-343 ngomzuzwana
explanation: Ukwehluka okungu-million-fold phakathi kokuhamba kukagesi nokucindezela komoya kwezakhamzimba kudala ukubambezeleka okubonakalayo.

question: Kungani umkhumbi wezimpahla wolwandle ugxuma phansi kakhulu emachwebeni emifuleni amanzi amasha kunasolwandle olwandle lwesawoti?
options: Amanzi amasha anobunzima obuphansi, kudingeka ukuthi isikebhe sinciphise ivolumu enkulu ukuze lifane nesisindo sesikebhe
Izifudlana zomfula zidonsela phansi izingxenye zesikebhe
Amanzi emfuleni anezinqwaba ezingaphansi kolwandle ezingakhuli kakhulu
correctAnswer: Amanzi amasha anobunzima obuphansi, kudingeka ukuthi isikebhe sinciphise ivolumu enkulu ukuze lifane nesisindo sesikebhe
explanation: Umthetho ka-Archimedes uthi amandla okuphakamisa amanzi alingana nosayizi wamanzi ashintshiwe. Amanzi anezinga eliphansi lokugqwala adinga ivolumu enkulu etshintshe.

question: Kungani isihlabathi esimanzi sizizwa siqinile phansi kwezinyawo zakho, kuyilapho isihlabathi esomile nesihlehlayo sivuma futhi sithinteka ngaphansi kwesisindo sakho?
options: Ukugqwala kobuso bemifantu yamanzi okuncane kudala ibhuloho le-capillary phakathi kwamagobolondo esihlabathi
Amanzi ayatshabalalisa isihlabathi abe itshe eliqinile
Isihlabathi esimanzi siba bandayo futhi sifreeze sibe siqinile
correctAnswer: Ukugqwala kobuso bemifantu yamanzi okuncane kudala ibhuloho le-capillary phakathi kwamagobolondo esihlabathi
explanation: Amandla e-capillary adonsa amagobolondo angomakhelwane ndawonye, anikeza amandla okusika asekele ingcindezi yezinyawo kuze kufike esigabeni sokwaneliseka.

question: Kungani umuntu ohlasela phambili ezinyaweni zakhe ukuze abheke phansi kwecanyon ezwa imisipha yensimbi yezinyawo yakhe iqinisa ngokwemvelo?
options: Imisipha yensimbi yezinyawo iyaphuma ukuze idale i-torque ye-plantarflexion futhi ibambe indawo yesisindo esiphambili
correctAnswer: Imisipha yensimbi yezinyawo iyaphuma ukuze idale i-torque ye-plantarflexion futhi ibambe indawo yesisindo esiphambili
explanation: Uma isisindo sishintsha phambili kwiphoyinti le-ankle, imisipha ye-gastrocnemius iyaphusha ngengcindezi yokulungisa emuva.

question: Kungani umbuya wensimbi ojwayelekile ekwazi ukuma ngokuvundlile phezu komhlaba wamanzi athule uma ubekwe ngokubekezelela kakhulu?
options: Ukungezwani komhlaba wamanzi kwakha isikhumba esibukeka njenge-elastic esekela isisindo sombuya
Imbuya iqukethe amaphakethe emoyeni amancane kakhulu abambekile
Amanzi athule awanalo ukudonswa okukhulu komhlaba
correctAnswer: Ukungezwani komhlaba wamanzi kwakha isikhumba esibukeka njenge-elastic esekela isisindo sombuya
explanation: Amaphesenti e-hydrogen asebenzisanayo emngceleni wamanzi nomoya adala ukungezwani komhlaba okuvimbela ukungena uma kungagwinywanga.

question: Kungani amabhayisikili okuncintisana esebenzisa ingcindezi ephezulu kakhulu yomoya kumathayi (80-120 psi) uma kuqhathaniswa namathayi ezimoto (32-35 psi)?

Amabhayisikili asindayo nge-square inch ngayinye ye-rabha
correctAnswer: Ukucindezela okuphezulu kunciphisa kakhulu ukuguquguquka kwecala lethayi, kunciphisa kakhulu ukumelana nokujikeleza endleleni ethambile
explanation: Amathayi aqinile aguquki kakhulu lapho ethintana nomgwaqo, anciphisa amandla alahlekile ku-hysteresis yangaphakathi ye-rabha yethayi nokuhudula.

question: Kungani intuthu yomlilo wemhlangano ibonakala ihamba ngokuqhubekayo ngqo emehlweni womuntu ohlezi eduze komlilo?
options: Umzimba womuntu uvimba umoya ojikeleza, udala indawo enengcindezi ephansi epholayo edonsa intuthu eshisayo kuye
Intuthu idonswa ngokwemvelo yi-carbon dioxide yomuntu
correctAnswer: Umzimba womuntu uvimba umoya ojikeleza, udala indawo enengcindezi ephansi epholayo edonsa intuthu eshisayo kuye
explanation: Isithiyo sakha ukuqhamuka komoya okunciphisa ingcindezi endaweni ethile, okuheha ngokuzenzakalelayo imithombo yomoya nokuthuthumela kwentuthu.

question: Kungani ama-honeycomb akhiwe izinyosi ezimumatha uju ehlala emvelo enezicucu eziyizisigubhu ezinembayo kunokuba nezicucu ezijikelezayo noma ezikwele?
options: Ama-hexagon ahlela ipulani eliyisicaba ngaphandle kwezikhala ngenkathi esebenzisa umkhawulo ophansi kakhulu we-wax ukuvala ivolumu
Izicucu ezijikelezayo ziyawa ngaphansi komthelela wokudonsa komhlaba
correctAnswer: Ama-hexagon ahlela ipulani eliyisicaba ngaphandle kwezikhala ngenkathi esebenzisa umkhawulo ophansi kakhulu we-wax ukuvala ivolumu
explanation: Umqondo we-honeycomb ubonisa ukuthi i-geometry ye-hexagonal inikeza ukuhlangana kwezindawo okusebenza kangcono kakhulu emkhawulweni.

question: Kungani ukushaya ibhodlela le-soda lengilazi eceleni ngensipuni kukhiqiza umsindo ophakeme wokudlala ngesikhathi uphuza isiphuzo esiphilayo?
options: Ubuningi obuncane besiphuzo kusho ukuthi kune-inertia encane kwesigaba esivunguzayo sesiphuzo nengilazi, okukhuphula imvamisa yemvelo yokuzwakala
Umoya wenza umsindo ube ne-pitch ephansi
correctAnswer: Ubuningi obuncane besiphuzo kusho ukuthi kune-inertia encane kwesigaba esivunguzayo sesiphuzo nengilazi, okukhuphula imvamisa yemvelo yokuzwakala
explanation: Lapho ushaya, uhlelo lwamanzi nengilazi oluhlanganisiwe luvunguza; ukunciphisa ubuningi bamanzi kunciphisa ubuningi obuvunguzayo, kukhuphula imvamisa.

question: Kungani isiphethu esisindayo esijikelezayo sihlala simile ngaphezulu kwephoyinti laso ngaphandle kokuwela eceleni?
options: Umzuliswano we-angular udala ukuzinza kwe-gyroscopic okuphikisana namandla azama ukushintsha i-axis yaso yokujikeleza
correctAnswer: Umzuliswano we-angular udala ukuzinza kwe-gyroscopic okuphikisana namandla azama ukushintsha i-axis yaso yokujikeleza
explanation: Ukulondolozwa komzuliswano we-angular kusho ukuthi ukufaka i-torque yangaphandle ye-gravitational kubangela i-gyroscopic precession kunokuwela.

question: Kungani izindiza zokuhweba zinezimpiko ezincane eziphakeme ezisemaceleni (ama-winglet) emaphethelweni angaphandle ezindizeni zazo?
options: Ukuhlakaza ama-vortices aphakeme-pressure emaphethelweni empiko, kwehlise ukudonswa okubangelwa ukuntuleka kokuhla komoya futhi kugcine uphethiloli lwendiza
Ukuvimbela izinyoni ukuba zingami ngesikhathi sendiza
correctAnswer: Ukuhlakaza ama-vortices aphakeme-pressure emaphethelweni empiko, kwehlise ukudonswa okubangelwa ukuntuleka kokuhla komoya futhi kugcine uphethiloli lwendiza
explanation: Ama-winglet avimba umoya onengcindezi ephakeme ngaphansi kwephiko ukuthi ungajikajiki emaphethelweni uye phezulu ephepheni eliphansi, kwehlise ukudonswa okuyinselele.

question: Kungani isiqephu se-apula siguquka sibe nsundu ngemizuzu embalwa ngemva kokusikwa nokubekwa emoyeni egumbini?
options: Ama-enzyme e-polyphenol oxidase akhuthaza ukushintsha kwe-phenols abe yimibala emnyama ye-melanin uma exhunywe nomoya-mpilo
Uthayela olusemaphepheni lwenza inyama ye-apula ligule
correctAnswer: Ama-enzyme e-polyphenol oxidase akhuthaza ukushintsha kwe-phenols abe yimibala emnyama ye-melanin uma exhunywe nomoya-mpilo
explanation: Ukushintsha kombala okubangelwa ama-enzyme kwenzeka lapho ukulimala kwezicubu kunikeza umoya-mpilo ku-polyphenol oxidase nasezithweni ze-phenolic.

question: Kungani uwoyela we-olive ohlanzekile uguquka ube mfumbe futhi ube semi-solid uma ugcinwa ngaphakathi kwefriji ejwayelekile yasekhaya?
options: Amafutha e-monounsaturated anezinga lokuncibilika eliphezulu akha ama-crystals ngezinga lokushisa lefriji (cishe ku-4°C)
correctAnswer: Amafutha e-monounsaturated anezinga lokuncibilika eliphezulu akha ama-crystals ngezinga lokushisa lefriji (cishe ku-4°C)
explanation: I-oleic acid nama-triacylglycerols anamazinga okubanda phakathi kuka-0°C no-5°C, okubenza ukuba abonakale bengasagcini uwoyela ngaphandle kokuwonakalisisa.

question: Kungani izimoto zesimanje zabagibeli zinezindawo eziguquguqukayo zokushayisana phambili eziklanyelwe ukucindezela kalula ngesikhathi sokushayisana okukhulu?
options: Ukwehlisa isikhathi sokushayisana kwehlisa amandla aphezulu okusheshisa adluliselwa kubagibeli (F = dp/dt)
Ukwenza izimoto zibe sezingeni eliphansi ukukhiqiza
correctAnswer: Ukwehlisa isikhathi sokushayisana kwehlisa amandla aphezulu okusheshisa adluliselwa kubagibeli (F = dp/dt)
explanation: Ngokuguqulwa kancane kancane, izindawo eziguquguqukayo zinciphisa amandla okusheshisa ngokwengxenye yesikhathi eside, kunciphisa ukuhlaselwa okungase kubangele ukufa.

question: Kungani umuntu ozwa ekhathazekile noma ekhungathekile evame ukubuyela esimweni ngokushesha lapho elele phansi ekhanda eliqondile nezinyawo eziphakanyisiwe?
options: Umthamo wesihlahla usiza igazi lomphimbo ukuthi libuyele ekhanda, kubuyiswe ingcindezi yokugeleza kwegazi emqondweni
correctAnswer: Umthamo wesihlahla usiza igazi lomphimbo ukuthi libuyele ekhanda, kubuyiswe ingcindezi yokugeleza kwegazi emqondweni
explanation: I-hypotension yemiqondo emafutheni iyisusa umoya-mpilo ophuma ebuchosheni; ukuphakamisa izinyawo usebenzisa umthamo wesihlahla ukufaka ukugcwala kwegazi emaphakathi.

question: Kungani amabhamuza kakhwetha ezehlelwa phansi enza njalo amasondo aphelele emoyeni naphezu kwesimo se-wand yepulasitiki esetshenziselwa ukuwabhabhula?
options: -Isondo linezindawo ezincane kakhulu zomhlaba kunoma yikuphi okuvalelwe kuwo, kunciphisa amandla omsindo wokugcoba
correctAnswer: -Isondo linezindawo ezincane kakhulu zomhlaba kunoma yikuphi okuvalelwe kuwo, kunciphisa amandla omsindo wokugcoba
explanation: -Amandla omsindo uqhubeka nokudonsa ifilimu yesipuni ngaphakathi kuze kufinyelele isimo samandla aphansi kakhulu: isondo.

question: Kungani ingilazi yokukhulisa ishisa amaqabunga omile ngaphansi kwelanga eliqhakazile, kodwa iphane lewindow eliqondile lengilazi alikhohlisi?
options: I-lensi ye-convex iyaphambuka imisebe yelanga elihambisana ngendlela yokuhlangana endaweni eyodwa eqinile yokugxila, igxile ekushiseni
Ingilazi eqondile ibuyisela amaphesenti angama-100 okushisa
correctAnswer: I-lensi ye-convex iyaphambuka imisebe yelanga elihambisana ngendlela yokuhlangana endaweni eyodwa eqinile yokugxila, igxile ekushiseni
explanation: Ukuphambuka ngomumo ogobile kugxilisa amandla kagesi welanga obanzi endaweni encane, kufinyelela izinga lokutshaleka.

question: Kungani abalobi abakhuphuka ngokushesha kakhulu ukusuka emanzini ajulile behlangabezana nesimo esibuhlungu esaziwa ngokuthi 'ama-bends'?
options: Ukwehliswa ngokushesha kwengcindezi kubangela igesi ye-nitrogen exutshiwe ukuba yenze amabhakede akhula egazini nasemathunjini
Ingcindezi yegazi yehliswa yaba nolwazi oluphansi kakhulu
correctAnswer: Ukwehliswa ngokushesha kwengcindezi kubangela igesi ye-nitrogen exutshiwe ukuba yenze amabhakede akhula egazini nasemathunjini
explanation: Umthetho ka-Henry uyalawula ukuthi ukuwohloka kwegasi kwehla ngokuncipha kwengcindezi ye-hydrostatic; i-nitrogen exutshiwe iyazamazama ngokuyingozi.

question: Kungani isibuko siguqula kwesokunxele nakwesokudla ngokombono wethu, kodwa asisiguquli ngaphezulu nangaphansi?
options: Isibuko empeleni siguqula phambili-nasemuva (i-axis yobunzima), okubonwa ubuchopho bethu njengokushintshana kwesokunxele kwesokudla
correctAnswer: Isibuko empeleni siguqula phambili-nasemuva (i-axis yobunzima), okubonwa ubuchopho bethu njengokushintshana kwesokunxele kwesokudla
explanation: Izibuko ziguqula i-axis ye-z (evundlile ebangeni lesibuko). Ngokwengqondo sizicabanga siguqula ngo-180 degrees ukuze sibheke thina, okudala ukubonakala kokuguqulwa ngakolunye uhlangothi.

question: Kungani isipuni sezandla esibukhali sasike imifino eluhlaza kalula kakhulu kunesipuni esigugile esingenakho ukukhanya?
options: Indawo encane kakhulu yokugcina umphetho igxila emandleni afakwe phansi ibe ingcindezi yokusika ephakeme kakhulu (P = F/A)
Izimpondo ezibambezelelekile zikhiqiza ukushisa ngenxa yokudlidliza
correctAnswer: Indawo encane kakhulu yokugcina umphetho igxila emandleni afakwe phansi ibe ingcindezi yokusika ephakeme kakhulu (P = F/A)
explanation: Ingcindezi ihambisana ngokuphambene nendawo. Umphumela wesiraya esimincane udala amaphawundi ezinkulungwane zengcindezi nge-intshi yesikwele ngayinye.

question: Kungani izakhiwo eziphakeme ezinkulu zokuhweba zishukumisa emuva naphambili emoyeni onesivinini esiphezulu ngaphandle kokuphuka kwezisekelo zazo?
options: Zakhelwe ngokuguquguquka kwesakhiwo kanye nama-tuned mass dampers ukudambisa amandla okushukumisa
Izakhiwo zixhunywe edwaleni eliqinile ngamabhande erabha aguquguqukayo
Amafasitela avuleka ukuvumela umoya ukudlula kalula
correctAnswer: Zakhelwe ngokuguquguquka kwesakhiwo kanye nama-tuned mass dampers ukudambisa amandla okushukumisa
explanation: Izakhiwo eziqinile ezibuthaka ziqhekeka; izakhiwo zensimbi eziguquguqukayo zishukumisa ngobumnene, kanti izisindo ezimisiwe zinqamula ukuvumelana komsindo.

question: Kungani ukushefa usawoti omile we-sodium chloride ezindleleni eziqhwa kubangela ukuthi iqhwa eliqinile lincibilike ngezinga lokushisa elingaphansi kwe-zero?
options: Ama-ion kasawoti ahlanganisiwe anciphisa iphuzu lokubanda kwamanzi ngaphansi kwe-zero degrees Celsius (ukwehliswa kwephuzu lokubanda)
Usawoti ushisa iqhwa ngokwekhemikhali ngezinga lokuphuma kwamandla (exothermic)
Usawoti uthatha ilanga futhi ushise ufinyelele ku-50 degrees
correctAnswer: Ama-ion kasawoti ahlanganisiwe anciphisa iphuzu lokubanda kwamanzi ngaphansi kwe-zero degrees Celsius (ukwehliswa kwephuzu lokubanda)
explanation: Ama-ion wesixazululo aphazamisa ukukuhlehla kwe-thermodynamic kokwakheka kweziqweqwe zeqhwa, enza amanzi ahlale e-liquid kuze kufinyelele cishe -21°C.

question: Kungani umuntu ozizwa engakhululeki ngenxa yokugula ngokuhamba kwesikebhe ezwa engcono kakhulu lapho ebheka emhlabeni obonakalayo wolwandle olude?
options: Kuxazulula ukungqubuzana kwemizwa phakathi kwamachibiyelo okuvumelana nokulinganisa ekhaleni langaphakathi kanye nemibono yezinto ezibukwayo
Ukugxila kwamehlo kwehlisa inhliziyo ibe zero
Amafu asemhlabeni obonakalayo akhiqiza imisindo yokuthulisa
correctAnswer: Kuxazulula ukungqubuzana kwemizwa phakathi kwamachibiyelo okuvumelana nokulinganisa ekhaleni langaphakathi kanye nemibono yezinto ezibukwayo
explanation: Ukugula ngokuhamba kwenzeka lapho uketshezi lwezindlebe zangaphakathi lukhombisa ukunyakaza kokugobeka kanti izindonga zekhabhinethi zibonakala zimi; umhlaba obonakalayo uqinisekisa ukunyakaza kwangempela.

question: Kungani ukuwasha ishoshi evamile yokuphepha emabhokisini kubangela umlilo, kodwa ukuwasha kuyo ithayili elibushelelezi kwehluleka?

Amathayili abushelelezi amunca konke ukushayisana kukagesi

explanation: Ukungqubuzana kuguqula iphosphorasi ebomvu emceni ibe iphophorasi emhlophe ezovuthwa futhi ivuse umqhezu we-oksijeni wamakhanda e-match.

question: Kungani izinyoni ezihlala ezintanjeni zikagesi eziphakeme kakhulu zingalokothi zishaywe ugesi?

Umakhi wentambo yamandla angaphandle uthatha yonke ikhona yamanje
Amakhekhe aphezulu kagesi ahamba ngaphakathi kwenhliziyo yensimbi kuphela

explanation: Ugesi uhamba kuphela phakathi kokuhluka kwamandla kagesi (ukuhlehla kukagesi). Ngokuthi zonke izinyawo zikhona kumphakamo ofanayo, akukho ugesi odlula enyoni.

question: Kungani ithamosi le-vacuum flask ligcina isobho esishisayo sigcinwa sifudumele amahora amaningi ngaphandle kokushisa okungaphakathi kukagesi?

Udonga lwangaphandle lwenza amandla okuvikela ukushisa.

question: Umhloli webugebengu ungena endlini enkulu lapho othile ocebile atholakala edutshulwe edeskini lakhe. Irekhoda yomsindo esedeskini ladlala: 'Angisakwazi ukuqhubeka, hamba kahle,' kulandelwa ukudubula. Umhloli waphutshuza ngokushesha ukuthi kuwubulawa ngokukhululeka. Kungani?

question: Abesifazane ababili bayalayisha itiye elibandayo ekhefini. U-Alice uphuza izinkomishi ezinhlanu ngokushesha ngemizuzu emibili. U-Beatrice uphuza inkomishi eyodwa kancane phakathi kwehora elilodwa. U-Beatrice uyafa ngenxa yomuthi; u-Alice usindile engenacala. Kanjani?

question: Umthengisi wezinsimbi webiwe. Isigebengu sangena ngewindi lesibhakabhaka elingaphukile endaweni yesibili saphuma ngomnyango wangaphambili, singashiyanga izimpawu zeminwe, sathatha amadayimane kuphela singenandaba nezinsimbi zegolide. Kungani singazinaki izinsimbi ezisindayo zegolide?

question: Umshayeli wemoto umele phansi emgwaqweni omkhulu phakathi nobusuku zonke izibani zangaphandle zisebenza. Umphoyisa wabona isibalo sokushesha sikhombisa 0 mph naphezu kokuthi imoto ibingaphezu kuka-60 mph. Kwakuphutha ini?

question: Owesifazane uthenga uphasi olukhuluma amagama wonke alizwa kuwo, oluqinisekisiwe ngumthengisi wezilwane zasekhaya. Emva kwesonto, uphasi alusho lutho, kodwa umthengisi akazange akhohlise. Kanjani?

question: Inkosi yafuna ukugweba ingcweti. Yamvumela ingcweti ukuba athi okokugcina: 'Uma ukhuluma iqiniso, uzogwetshiselwa; uma ukhulumayo amanga, uzogoqa emanzini.' Yisiphi isitatimende esasindisa impilo yengcweti?

question: Indoda icindezela ibhayisikili layo iphumelele umngcele njalo ngeviki ithwele izikhwama ezimbili zesihlabathi. Abaphathi bomngcele bahluza isihlabathi ngokucophelela kodwa abatholi lutho olungekho emthethweni. Ngemva kweminyaka eyishumi, empeleni wayesemnyama ini?

question: Ibhokisi lensimbi elivaliwe liqukethe amabhalbhu amathathu elula ngaphakathi: obomvu, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka, oluhlaza. Ngokubuka ngaphandle kwebhokisi, ungabona kuphela imbobo yengilazi ebeka umbala odityanisiweyo. Uma imbobo ikhombisa ukukhanya okuphuzi, yiziphi amabhalbhu asebenza?

question: Umkhiqizi wamawashi wakhe iwashi elingenazo izibalo, alinamamaki okuhamba, futhi ane-hand yehora neyi-minute efana. Kukhona kangaki phakathi kuka-12:00 no-1:00 lapho kungelula khona ukunquma isikhathi?

question: Umkhumbi ushiya ichweba eJapan ngoLwesibili ekuseni bese uhamba ngqo empumalanga edlula ePacific Ocean amahora angama-24. Uma usufika endaweni oya kuyo, yiliphi ilanga lelisonto okuyo kulo ikhalenda lendawo?

question: I-safe line-lock yokuxuba enama-dial ama-3, i-dial ngayinye inenombolo kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-9. Isigebengu siyazi ukuthi izinombolo ezifanele zokuxhuma zihlanganisa u-25 futhi zonke izinombolo ezintathu ziyizinombolo ezingezona eziningi (odd numbers). Bangaki ubuso bokuxuba okufanele azame?
correctAnswer: Kunezixhumanisi ezi-3 kuphela (9-9-7, 9-7-9, 7-9-9)
explanation: Izinombolo ezi-odd ezinemininingwane eyodwa zingu-1, 3, 5, 7, 9. Isamba esiphezulu sezinombolo ezingezona eziningi ezintathu siyisi-9+9+9=27. Indlela eyodwa kuphela yokuthi izinombolo ezintathu ezingezona eziningi zibe nesamba esingu-25 wukuthi {9, 9, 7} ngezinhlobonhlobo ezintathu.

question: Kwesinye isivivinyo esidumile, abantu ababukele ividiyo yabadlali bebhola lezandla bedlulisela ibhola bahluleka ngokuphelele ukubona umuntu ogqoke isudi ye-gorilla ehamba esikrinini. Leli fenomena le-psychology libizwa ngokuthi yini?

question: Kungani ukufunda igama elithi 'BLUE' eliprintiwe ngombala obomvu okhanyayo kubangela abantu ukuba beme isikhathi eside ngaphambi kokuthi baveze ngokukhuluma umbala wogazi?

question: Uphenyo uthola iwashi eliphukile endaweni yobugebengu. Isibambo sehora sesiqhekekile ngokuphelele, kodwa isibambo somzuzu sikhomba kahle emizuzwini engu-48 edlule kuwashi. Isibambo sehora esilahlekile sasisesikhundleni esiqondile siphi?

correctAnswer: Kuyizingxenye ezine kwezihlanu phakathi kwenombolo ezimbili (ngokuqondile ku-288 degrees kuhhla wazi lwamahora)

question: Ibulo yomkhumbi linebala eliphezulu lokulayisha lamathani ayi-10. Iloli elisindayo ngqo amathani ayi-10 liqala ukudlula. Phakathi nendlela, izimpungushe lifika ophahleni lwekabhu. Kungani ibulo lingawi?

correctAnswer: Iloli lashisa uphethiloli olwaneleyo ngokushayela ngaphakathi nangaphakathi kwebulo ukunciphisa isisindo sezimpungushe

question: Isiboshwa senziwa ubuso nobuso nezimbewu ezimbili ezifanayo kanye nezimbewu ezimhlophe ezingama-50 nezimbewu ezimnyama ezingama-50. Umthumeli wezijeziso uzokhetha ngokungahleliwe imbiza eyodwa, bese ekhetha ngokungahlelekile imbewu eyodwa. Uma imhlophe, isiboshwa sikhululwa; uma imnyama, siyashiswa. Isiboshwa kufanele sihlele izimbewu kanjani ukuze sandise amathuba okuphila?
options: Beka imbewu emhlophe eyodwa ku-Urn A, bese bonke abanye abangu-99 (49 emhlophe, 50 emnyama) ku-Urn B
Beka 25 emhlophe no-25 emnyama kuzo zombili izimbiza
Beka zonke izimbewu ezimhlophe ezingama-50 ku-Urn A nezimbewu ezimnyama ezingama-50 ku-Urn B
Beka izimbewu ezimnyama ezingama-50 ku-Urn A nezimbewu ezimhlophe ezingama-50 ku-Urn B
correctAnswer: Beka imbewu emhlophe eyodwa ku-Urn A, bese bonke abanye abangu-99 (49 emhlophe, 50 emnyama) ku-Urn B
explanation: Lokhu kunikeza: 0.5 * (1/1) + 0.5 * (49/99) = 0.5 + 0.247 = cishe 74.7% amathuba okuphila, uma kuqhathaniswa no-50% uma ukuhlukaniswa ngokulinganayo.

question: Kungani ama-aqueducts amadala aseRoma akhiwe ngamatshe angaqinisiwe esekhona usasebenza ngemva kweminyaka eyizinkulungwane ezimbili, kuyilapho amabhuloho esimanjemanje ensimbi edinga ukupeyintwa njalo nokuqapha ukuguga?

question: Udokotela wezifo zomzimba uyaphawula ukuthi umzimba otholakele egumbini elingenawo ukufudumala ebusika awunazo izimpawu zokubopha kwemisipha (ukubamba), kodwa izinga lokushisa lomzimba langaphakathi lingu-18°C (lilingana nezinga lokushisa legumbi). correctAnswer: Cishe izinsuku ezintathu ezedlule, ngoba ukubopha kwemisipha kuqala phakathi kwamahora ambalwa, kufinyelela phezulu emahoreni angu-12, bese kuncipha ngokuphelele phakathi kwamahora angu-36-72.

question: Isela sishintsha upende obalulekile egalari yomnyuziyamu ngesithombe esiphindiwe. Umvikeli wegalari uyayibona ngokushesha le ndawo ephindwe kabili ukusuka kumamitha angama-6 ngaphansi kokukhanya okujwayelekile ngaphandle kokusebenzisa izibuko zokukhulisa. Yini eyayiyiveza?

correctAnswer: Ukugqama kwe-specular phezu kobuso bepende lamafutha iziqephu zobuciko zaziyisisekelo futhi zifanayo ngokuphelele esithombeni esiprintwe
explanation: Amapendi afanele ama-impasto enza uhlaka olunezicucu ezintathu olukhombisa ukukhanya ngendlela eguquguqukayo; izithombe eziyindilinga zikhombisa ukukhanya okungashintshi, okupendwe phezu kwesithombe.

question: Umhlanzi we-snorkeli uphonsa ijazi lengilazi elivaliwe eligcwele umoya echibini elijulile. Ebudeni obuyi-10 amamitha (cishe izimo zomoya ezi-2 zokucindezela), kwenzekani kumoya wangaphakathi enclosed ebhodleleni lengilazi eliqinile elivaliwe?

question: Isikhwama semali siyashumeka izikhathi eziyi-9 futhi siyaqhubeka sishumeka ebusweni ngaso sonke isikhathi. Yini inani eliqondile lesibalo sokuthi isikhwama semali seshumi sizoshumeka ebusweni, uma sithathwa njengesikhwama semali esithembekile, esifanele?

question: Kungani izitsha zokugoqa insimbi ezindala ziba zingenamgudu futhi zibe mnyama ngokwemvelo futhi ziqhakazile emva kweminyaka yokusetshenziswa kahle ekuphekeni?

question: Iwashi elisemqedeni lisishaya ihora lesi-6 ngesikhathi esingu-15 imizuzwana (kusukela ekuqaleni komsindo wokuqala kuze kube sekupheleni komsindo wesithupha). Lithatha imizuzwana emingaki ukushaya ihora lesi-12?
correctAnswer: 33 imizuzwana
explanation: Ukushaya ihora lesi-6 kuhlanganisa izikhawu ezi-5 phakathi kokushaya okungu-6: 15 / 5 = imizuzwana emi-3 ngesikhawu ngasinye. Ukushaya ihora lesi-12 kuhlanganisa izikhawu ezi-11: 11 * 3 = imizuzwana engu-33.

question: Kungani umuntu obuka isikrini sekhompyutha esikhanyisiwe egumbini elimnyama ngokuphelele ezwa ukucindezeleka okukhulu emehlweni uma kuqhathaniswa nokuba nelambu elifudumele emuva?

question: Kungani iwashi lendandatho elidala lithola isikhathi futhi ligijime ngokushesha uma lithwalwa ekuqongeni kwentaba ephakeme?

question: Kungani i-tsunami yasolwandle ihamba kuyo yonke i-olwandle evulekile ejulile ngesivinini esimangalisayo senqola yezindiza (500 mph) ngaphandle kokubonakala okuphezulu komfutho wamagagasi?

question: Kungani izinyoni ezihlala kumalandi kagesi aphakeme zibhakabhaka ziphephile zingalimali, kodwa isikhova esikhulu esithinta izintambo ezimbili ezihambisana ngasikhathi sinye sishiswe ugesi ngokushesha?

question: Kungani iqhwa lolwandle liqukethe cishe amaphesenti angama-90 amasayizi alo amakhulu afihliwe ngaphansi komugqa wamanzi?

question: Esigodlweni esikude, umshayi-boya uyasika bonke amadoda, futhi kuphela labo madoda, abangazisiki bodwa. Ubani osika umshayi-boya?

question: Uma ushiya ifriji ejwayelekile yasekhaya isebenza ngokuqhubekayo nenhlangano yayo ivulekile egumbini elivalwe ngokuphelele, elihlala lingena moya, kwenzekani ekushiseni kwegumbi?

question: Uma ijubane lokujikeleza kwePlanethi yomhlaba liphindeka kabili ngokushesha, kuyokwenzekani ngosayizi womzimba womuntu okhalwe esikalini e-equator?

question: Uma ukhipha ukukhanya kwe-flashlight phambili kusuka ku-bumper yangaphambili yesikhathi-sikhathi esihamba nge-99 ekhulwini yesivinini sokukhanya, ukukhanya kuthuthuka ngesivinini esingakanani?

question: Kungani ikhosi yomoya wenukliye yakhanyisa ngenkanyezi eluhlaza engavamile ngaphansi kwamanzi (Cherenkov radiation)?

question: Kungani osomkhathi abase-Inthanethi Space Station behamba bephezu kokungabi nesisindo, noma amandla adonsela phansi omlilo wePlanethi emkhathini wabo (400 km) angena cishe u-90 ekhulwini wamandla adonsela phansi ongaphezulu komhlaba?

question: Kungani isibambo esijikelezayo esibumum-bumuni noma irakethi yetennis sishintsha ukuhleleka kwaso ngezikhathi ezithile lapho sijikelezwa ngakho okuphakathi kwe-axis enkulu ku-zero gravity (umphumela ka-Dzhanibekov)?

question: Kungakanani ukuthi i-mantis shrimp encane ingasheka kanjani ngesivinini esishubile ngaphansi kwamanzi ukuze yephule odongeni lwengilazi olunzima lwesilwanyana?

question: Kungani isipuni esisigubuzelwe ngaphansi komthombo wamanzi ogijima kahle sihudulwa ngamandla kakhulu emanzini esikhundleni sokudonswa kude?

question: Kungani iqembu lebhola likabhola eliqhumayo liphenduka ngokumangalisayo eceleni phakathi nomoya lapho liqhutshelwa ngokushesha okukhulu noma ngokujikeleza eceleni?

question: Yimuphi isimiso esiyingqayizivele sezinguquko zamandla esivumela amanzi acocekile ukuba akhona ngesikhathi esifanayo ekulinganisweni komzimba njengesiqandisi esiwuqiniso, amanzi asensimini, kanye nomusi wamanzi efleshini elilodwa?

question: Kungani i-helium-4 ewuketshezi epholiswa ngaphansi kuka-2.17 Kelvin (isigaba soketshezi esikhulu) ikhuphuka ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi idlule odongeni zeglasi zefriji yayo bese iphuma ngaphandle?

question: Kungani i-superconductor eshisa kakhulu ikhupha wonke umugqa wensimu kazibuthe ngaphakathi kwayo futhi iphakamise ngaphezu kwe-magnet yaphakade (umthelela we-Meissner)?

question: Kungani ukucubungula ikhekhe le-wintergreen Lifesaver noma ikristalu kashukela owomileyo ngamapleyersi ebumnyameni obumnyama kudala ukukhanya okubomvu okuluhlaza okubonakalayo?

question: Kungani i-piezo-electric gas grill igniter ikhiqiza ukudubula okukhulu kwamandla kagesi ngokuma nje nje lapho ihama elinamandla elithwalwa umsongo lishaya ukhakhayi lwe-ceramic?

question: Kungani u-Albert Einstein ewinile iNobel Prize ye-Physics ngonyaka wango-1921 ngokuchaza i-Photoelectric Effect kunokuthi ngenxa yeTheory yakhe edumile ye-Relativity?

question: Ekuhloleni okudumile kwe-quantum double-slit, ukudubula ama-electron angu-odwa ngakunye ngesikhathi ngamunye ngezimbobo ezimbili ezihambisanayo kusakha ikhathuni elifana namagagasi esibukweni sokuthola. Kungani?

explanation: I-quantum mechanics icacisa ukuthi izinto zisabalala njengamawaves wokukhula kwamathuba (psi); i-electron eyodwa iyangqubuzana nayo ngaphandle kokuba ukukalwa kuhlakazela isimo.

question: Kwenzekani ekuhlolweni kwe-quantum double-slit uma abacwaningi bebhala isitholi somzimba kwelinye lama-slits ukuze babone ngokunembile ukuthi i-electron idlula kuphi?
options: Iphethini yokuphazamiseka kwamagagasi iyanyamalala ngokushesha, ithathelwe indawo yimigqa emibili elula yamaphutha e-particle
correctAnswer: Iphethini yokuphazamiseka kwamagagasi iyanyamalala ngokushesha, ithathelwe indawo yimigqa emibili elula yamaphutha e-particle
explanation: Isenzo sokukala siphoqa ukuwa komsebenzi wamaza, kubhujiswa ukuvumelana kwesigaba se-quantum futhi kususwa ukuphazamiseka kwe-superposition ye-quantum.

question: Kungani u-Albert Einstein edume ngokwenqaba izincazelo zefilosofi zokuxhumana okungaqondakali kwe-quantum, ebiza lokhu ngokuthi 'isenzo esimangalisayo kude'
options: Ukulinganisa i-particle eyodwa exubene ngokushesha kunquma isimo senye kudlula eminyakeni yokukhanya, kubonakala kuphula indawo yendawo yokuhlala kwe-relativity
Ubufakazile ukuthi ukuxhumana kwezinhlayiya kwephula ukugcinwa kwamandla
correctAnswer: Ukulinganisa i-particle eyodwa exubene ngokushesha kunquma isimo senye kudlula eminyakeni yokukhanya, kubonakala kuphula indawo yendawo yokuhlala kwe-relativity
explanation: U-Einstein wayekholelwa ekwenyeleni kwendawo; ithiyorema ka-Bell kanye nezivivinyo ezalandela zafakazela ukuthi imvelo ayilendawo, iqinisekisa ukuthinteka kwe-quantum.

question: Kungani umthetho wokungaqiniseki kaWerner Heisenberg uthinta ukuthi awusoze wazi ngokugcwele kokubili indawo eqondile kanye nesisindo esiqondile sempahla yesubatomic ngesikhathi esisodwa?
options: Indawo nesisindo yiziguquko ze-Fourier ezenzakalayo ezilawulwa izisebenzi ze-quantum ezingahambelani (Delta x * Delta p >= h-bar / 2)
correctAnswer: Indawo nesisindo yiziguquko ze-Fourier ezenzakalayo ezilawulwa izisebenzi ze-quantum ezingahambelani (Delta x * Delta p >= h-bar / 2)
explanation: Umthetho wokungaqiniseki awuyona imingcele yamathuluzi okulinganisa, kodwa uyimpawu eyisisekelo yegagasi lezinto: iphakethe legagasi elibekiwe liqukethe ububanzi obukhulu bemigqa yamagagasi.

question: Izindlela zokugcina idatha zombane zokugcina zekhompyutha zesimanje nezinqwaba zedatha eziqinile (ama-SSD) zigcina kanjani idatha kagesi ngokusebenzisa izithiyo ezifihlekile ngokuphelele zokufaka i-oxide?
options: Ama-electron adlula esithiyeni ngokusebenzisa i-quantum mechanical tunneling naphezu kokungabi namandla okudlula intaba kagesi ngezinga elijwayelekile
I-voltage ephakeme ishisa izimbobo ezincane ku-oxide
correctAnswer: Ama-electron adlula esithiyeni ngokusebenzisa i-quantum mechanical tunneling naphezu kokungabi namandla okudlula intaba kagesi ngezinga elijwayelekile
explanation: I-Fowler-Nordheim tunneling ivumela ukusabalala kwamathuba okuba khona kwe-electron okufana namagagasi ukuba kungene ezithiyeni ezincane ze-silicon dioxide (~10 nm).

question: Kungani izitsha ezimbili zensimbi ezingashajwanga, ezicwebezelisiwe ezibekwe ngamamitha amancane kulo msebenzi womoya ogcwele zithandana ngokwemvelo ngeforce engalinganiswa (umthelela we-Casimir)?
options: Ukuguquguquka okuncane kwesikhala esingenalutho se-quantum kungakwazi ukufakwa phakathi kwezitsha ezincane kunendawo ezungezile, kudala ingcindezi yokukhanya engaphakathi
correctAnswer: Ukuguquguquka okuncane kwesikhala esingenalutho se-quantum kungakwazi ukufakwa phakathi kwezitsha ezincane kunendawo ezungezile, kudala ingcindezi yokukhanya engaphakathi
explanation: Umthelela we-Casimir uqinisekisa ukuthi isikhala asingenalutho; izimo zokumisa zinciphisa izindlela ze-zero-point zamandla kagesi phakathi kwezitsha, kudala amandla angenayo F ~ 1/d^4.

question: Kungani uStephen Hawking wabikezela ukuthi izimbobo ezimnyama azimnyama ngokuphelele, kodwa zinciphisa kancane kancane isisindo futhi ekugcineni zincipha ngokushisa kwesikhathi sonke somkhathi (ukukhanya kukaHawking)?
options: Ama-particle-antiparticle angokoqobo akude nendawo yomkhawulo we-event ahlukaniswa, elinye liwela ngaphakathi kanti elinye liphunyuka njengokukhanya kwangempela okushisayo
Izimbobo ezimnyama zikhupha izinto zenuzi ngama-jeti
Umoya welanga ushaya phansi izinto zembobo emnyama
correctAnswer: Ama-particle-antiparticle angokoqobo akude nendawo yomkhawulo we-event ahlukaniswa, elinye liwela ngaphakathi kanti elinye liphunyuka njengokukhanya kwangempela okushisayo
explanation: Imfundiso ye-quantum field kumkhathi ogobile ikhipha amandla amabi embobeni ngokuhlukaniswa kwamapara e-vacuum ahlangene, ikhupha amandla amahle ngaphandle.

question: Iyiphi ukuguqulwa komzimba okujwayelekile okungavamile okungenzeka kumuntu osendleleni yokwehla phansi ngera-mass emnyama yomkhathi (spaghettification)?
options: Amandla awumhlaba omkhulu kakhulu adonsela umkhumbi osendleleni ye-astronaut uqonde phezulu abe yintambo ende encane ngenkathi ecindezelwa ngokuqondile
correctAnswer: Amandla awumhlaba omkhulu kakhulu adonsela umkhumbi osendleleni ye-astronaut uqonde phezulu abe yintambo ende encane ngenkathi ecindezelwa ngokuqondile
explanation: Ibanga lokuhlukahluka kwe-tidal d F/d r ~ 1/r^3. Udonswa komzimba ngezinyawo kuphezulu kakhulu kunentamo, ukudonsa umzimba ku-axis ye-radial.

question: Kungani iqoqo elikhulu lamagagasi elisebenza njengengilazi enkulu yokukhulisa yezinkanyezi, ligoba futhi likhuphule ukukhanya kwamagagasi akude angemuva kwalokho (ukubukiswa kobulsizini bokudonsa)?
options: Isisindo sigoba ujometri wesikhathi-sendawo ngokwaso, siphoqa amafothoni okukhanya ukuthi ahambe endleleni ezigobileyo zegiyojezi
correctAnswer: Isisindo sigoba ujometri wesikhathi-sendawo ngokwaso, siphoqa amafothoni okukhanya ukuthi ahambe endleleni ezigobileyo zegiyojezi
explanation: Ukulingana Okuvamile kusho ukuthi ukudonsa kuyisigobe sesikhathi-sendawo (G_uv = 8*pi*T_uv). Ukukhanya kulandela imigudu engenalutho egobile emizimbeni enkulu.

question: Kungani izulu lobusuku lihlaba mnyama kunokuba libe liqaqambile njengendawo yeLanga, nakuba kunemithala engamawillioni wonke umkhombandlela (i-Olbers' Paradox)?
options: Izulu lineminyaka emkhawulelwe (iminyaka eyizigidigidi eziyi-13.8) futhi liyakhula, elibangela ukukhanya kube bomvu futhi lilethe umkhawulo wombono wokubona
Uhlobo lukathuli phakathi kwezinkanyezi luvimba wonke ukukhanya kwezinkanyezi
Izinkanyezi zikhanya kuphela phakathi nezikhathi zosuku
Izinto ezimnyama zimunca yonke ukukhanya okude
correctAnswer: Izulu lineminyaka emkhawulelwe (iminyaka eyizigidigidi eziyi-13.8) futhi liyakhula, elibangela ukukhanya kube bomvu futhi lilethe umkhawulo wombono wokubona
explanation: Uma umkhathi wawumile, wahlala njalo, futhi ungapheli, yonke umugqa wombono wawungaphetha enkosini yezinkanyezi. Iminyaka emkhawulelwe nokubomvu kokubuka kwenkanyezi kusombulula lo mbono ongemuhle.

question: Usosayensi we-Physics u-Enrico Fermi wabuza ngokudumile: 'Uma ukuphila okuphezulu kwabantu abangaphandle komhlaba kungenzeka ngokwezibalo emhlabeni wonke, bonke abantu bakuphi?' Leli qiniso libizwa ngokuthi yini?
correctAnswer: I-Fermi Paradox
explanation: I-Fermi Paradox ibonisa ukuphikisana okubonakalayo phakathi kwezingqikithi eziphakeme zokuba khona kwezakhamuzi zangaphandle komhlaba kanye nokuntuleka ngokuphelele kobufakazi obubonakalayo.

question: Kungani izinkanyezi ezikude zibonakala zihamba ziye kude neMhlaba ngemuva kokukhanya okubomvu kuyo yonke imikhakha, ngaphandle kokuthi iMhlaba ibe yisona sikhungo somkhathi?
options: Isikhala ngokwaso sikhula ngokulinganayo kuwo wonke umkhathi njengamazingwe esinkwa esikhulayo
IMhlaba iyawuphikisa omanye ama-galaxy ngamandla adonsa phansi
correctAnswer: Isikhala ngokwaso sikhula ngokulinganayo kuwo wonke umkhathi njengamazingwe esinkwa esikhulayo
explanation: Ukukhula kwesilinganiso somkhathi kwezomkhathi kusabalalisa isikhala phakathi kwezinto ezingaxhumene ngokudonselana; wonke umuntu obukayo ubona wonke ama-galaxy akude ehamba kude endaweni abhekene nayo.

question: Kungani izinkanyezi ezinhlangothini zangaphandle zama-galaxy ezibuyela ngokumjikeleza ngokuphindaphindiwe ngokwesivinini esiphakeme ngokufanayo nezinkanyezi eziseduze nenkabazwe ye-galaxy, okuyephula imithetho ye-Kepler yokujikeleza?
options: Ama-galaxy avaliwe ngamahlawu amakhulu anobukhulu obuhle be-Dark Matter engabonakali enikeza ukubopha okwengeziwe kwesibuthe
Izimbobo ezimnyama ezisemaphakathi zijikeleza izandla ngomshini
correctAnswer: Ama-galaxy avaliwe ngamahlawu amakhulu anobukhulu obuhle be-Dark Matter engabonakali enikeza ukubopha okwengeziwe kwesibuthe
explanation: Amagrafu ajikeleza flat e-galaxy (ukutholakala kuka-Vera Rubin) akhombisa ukuthi ijubane lokujikeleza aliweli ngokubekezelelana nendawo (v != 1/sqrt(r)), okukhombisa ama-halo amakhulu angenamandla okukhanya obumnyama.

question: Kungani ubuso obufanayo beNyanga buhlale bukubhekela uMhlaba, kushiya uhlangothi olulodwa lufihlakele kwababukeli bomhlaba?
options: Ugesi wokudonsa kwamandla okuheha udilize amandla okujikeleza kuze kube isikhathi sokuzungeza kweNyanga sikhononda nesikhathi sokujikeleza kwayo emkhathini (ukuvalwa kwamagagasi)
Uhlangothi olude luyisindo kakhulu ukuze lujikele
Ipoli lensimu kagesi likaMhlaba libopha iNyanga
correctAnswer: Ugesi wokudonsa kwamandla okuheha udilize amandla okujikeleza kuze kube isikhathi sokuzungeza kweNyanga sikhononda nesikhathi sokujikeleza kwayo emkhathini (ukuvalwa kwamagagasi)
explanation: Amagagasi kaMhlaba adonse amandla adonsela phansi kuNyanga eminyakeni eyizigidi, ehlehlisa ukujikeleza kwayo kuze kube yisikhathi sayo sokuzungeza saba yileso sokujikeleza kwayo (i-1:1 resonance).

question: Kungani ama-telescope esikhala afana ne-James Webb Space Telescope ebekwe e-Lagrange Point L2 (amakhilomitha ayi-1.5 million ukusuka eMhlabeni) kunokubekwa esikhaleni esiphansi somhlaba?
options: Amandla adonsela phansi eMhlabeni naseLanga alinganisa amandla okujikeleza, okuvumela isikhala sezindiza ukuthi sigcine ukujikeleza okuzinzile okuvikelwe ilanga endaweni emnyama njalo
I-L2 ayinawo amandla adonsela phansi avela kunoma yiliphi iplanethi
Izimpawu zomsakazo zidlula ngokushesha ukusuka e-L2
correctAnswer: Amandla adonsela phansi eMhlabeni naseLanga alinganisa amandla okujikeleza, okuvumela isikhala sezindiza ukuthi sigcine ukujikeleza okuzinzile okuvikelwe ilanga endaweni emnyama njalo
explanation: E-L2, amandla adonsela phansi elanga nawomhlaba ahlangana ukuze alingane nesivinini sokujikeleza, agcina i-telescope ihlala embumbini weMhlaba ukuze igcine ukupholisa okukhulu kwe-infrared okushisayo obandayo.

question: Kungani uthuli olukhanyayo lwekhemete kanye nomkhondo we-ion uhlale ubheke ngqo kude neLanga, noma ikhemete lihamba liya kude neLanga libuyele emkhathini ojulile?
options: Ingcindezi yokukhanya evela elangeni nomoya welanga oqhubekayo kuphonsa uthuli negesi e-ionized ngokuthe nkqo kude nenkemba yelanga
Amakhemete ashiya umphumela wokudubula ngemuva kwawo
Ukuklwebheka nomoya ongenalutho emkhathini kuphonsa umkhondo
correctAnswer: Ingcindezi yokukhanya evela elangeni nomoya welanga oqhubekayo kuphonsa uthuli negesi e-ionized ngokuthe nkqo kude nenkemba yelanga
explanation: I-momentum yephethini yelanga (ingcindezi yokukhanya) kanye ne-protons yomoya welanga osheshayo kuphonsa izinto ezincane ezixazululekayo ngokuthe nkqo, kungakhathalekile ukuthi isivinini sekhemete sikhona kanjani.

question: Yini evimbela inkanyezi emhlophe enobukhulu obukhulu kakhulu ekuqhekekeni ngokuphelele ibe yimbobo emnyama ngaphansi kwesisindo sayo esibuhlungu somhlaba?
options: Ucindezelo lwe-degeneracy lwama-elektroni oludalwe umthetho we-Pauli Exclusion Principle okuvimbela ama-fermions afanayo ekwabeleni izimo ze-quantum
correctAnswer: Ucindezelo lwe-degeneracy lwama-elektroni oludalwe umthetho we-Pauli Exclusion Principle okuvimbela ama-fermions afanayo ekwabeleni izimo ze-quantum
explanation: I-quantum mechanics iyalawula ukuthi ama-elektroni awakwazi ukuhlala ezikhungweni zesiteji esifanayo; ukuwacindezela kudala ucindezelo olukhulu lwe-degeneracy olungahambi ngokushisa kuze kufike emkhawulweni wesisa sama-1.4 solar.

question: Kungani isitofu sokufaka amandla sishisa ipani lensimbi ukuya ezingeni lokubhaka ngemizuzwana, kuyilapho ingaphezulu leglasi ngaphansi kwayo lisapholile ngokwanele ukuthintwa ngokuphepha?
options: Izinkambu zikamoya eziguquguqukayo ezinemvamisa ephezulu zidala ama-eddy currents ajikeleza nengcindezi yensimbi ngqo ngaphakathi epanini lensimbi
correctAnswer: Izinkambu zikamoya eziguquguqukayo ezinemvamisa ephezulu zidala ama-eddy currents ajikeleza nengcindezi yensimbi ngqo ngaphakathi epanini lensimbi
explanation: I-coil yethusi ikhiqiza i-magnetic flux enezinga eliphezulu lokuguquguquka (24 kHz); ukufakwa kukagesi kukhiqiza ukushisa okukhulu kwe-Joule (I^2 * R) ngokuqinile ngaphakathi kwezitsha zokupheka ze-ferromagnetic.

question: Kungani inyoni ingahamba ngokuphepha edlula esakhiweni eside sengilazi ngaphandle kwezinkinga, kodwa ivame ukubhujiswa ngamandla ngokuma ngqo engilazini ehlanzekile ebonakalayo yasensimini?
options: Ingilazi ebonakalayo isibuka izulu nezihlahla ezizungezile, idala umgwaqo wokundiza oqhubekayo ongabonakaliame emehlweni eenyoni
Ingilazi ikhipha imvamisa yezwi ephazamisa eenyoni
correctAnswer: Ingilazi ebonakalayo isibuka izulu nezihlahla ezizungezile, idala umgwaqo wokundiza oqhubekayo ongabonakaliame emehlweni eenyoni
explanation: Ienyoni zibona izitshalo zangaphandle ezibukwayo nezibuko zesibhakabhaka njengendawo yangempela yomoya, azinawo amasignali okuqonda ukuthi kukhona ukuzivikela okufanele ebusweni obungenambala.

question: Kungani umphakathi wonke ozama ukonga imali engaphezulu ngesikhathi sezomnotho esiphansi ngokuphambene kubangela ukuwa kwezimali eziphelele zikazwelonke kanye nemali engenayo (i-Paradox of Thrift)?
options: Ukonga okwengeziwe kwehlisa isidingo sabathengi jikelele, okunciphisa imali engenayo yamabhizinisi futhi kwehlise imali engenayo kazwelonke ephelele kanye nokonga
Amabhange athatha ukonga okwengeziwe ngesikhathi sokuncipha komnotho
Ukuncipha komnotho kuguqula ukonga kube ukukhuphuka kwezindleko
correctAnswer: Ukonga okwengeziwe kwehlisa isidingo sabathengi jikelele, okunciphisa imali engenayo yamabhizinisi futhi kwehlise imali engenayo kazwelonke ephelele kanye nokonga
explanation: UJohn Maynard Keynes wafakazela ukuthi nakuba ukonga kuyigolide kumuntu ngamunye, ukubamba obhande ndawonye ngomphakathi kunciphisa ukudla jikelele, kudonsa phansi ukukhiqizwa komnotho kanye nokonga okuphelele okuqinisekisiwe.

question: Kungani ukuvota ngaphezulu kweningi ngokuhlanganyela kungaholela emiphumeleni ejikelezayo, engalandeli, lapho Umfakisicelo A edlula uB, uB edlula uC, kodwa uC edlula uA (iCondorcet Paradox)?
options: Ukuthanda okubanzi komuntu ngamunye okulandela umthetho akukho nqobo ukuthi kuhlanganyele kube ukuthanda okuhlakaniphile, okulandelanayo kwesigungu somphakathi ngaphansi komthetho wokuvota ngaphezulu
correctAnswer: Ukuthanda okubanzi komuntu ngamunye okulandela umthetho akukho nqobo ukuthi kuhlanganyele kube ukuthanda okuhlakaniphile, okulandelanayo kwesigungu somphakathi ngaphansi komthetho wokuvota ngaphezulu
explanation: IMarquis de Condorcet yafakazela ngo-1785 ukuthi noma ngabe wonke umvoti unokuthanda okuhlakaniphile okungaguquki, ukuvota ngobabili okwedlula iningi kungajikeleza ngokungenamkhawulo (itshe-iphepha-iskizo), kungabi nomnqobi ozinzile.

question: Yini iTheoremu yeGibbard-Satterthwaite efakazela mayelana nanoma yiliphi uhlelo lokuvota olulawula ngezibalo olunezikhonzi ezintathu noma eziningi ezihlukile?
options: Wonke umthetho wokuvota ongaholi uyakwazi ukuhlaselwa ngokuvota ngomkhankaso wamasu, lapho abavoti bethola inzuzo ngokuphika izinto abazithandayo ngempela
correctAnswer: Wonke umthetho wokuvota ongaholi uyakwazi ukuhlaselwa ngokuvota ngomkhankaso wamasu, lapho abavoti bethola inzuzo ngokuphika izinto abazithandayo ngempela
explanation: Le theorem ifakazela ukuthi ngaphandle kokuba ukhetho luyuholi, kunaso isimo esisodwa okungenzeka ukuthi umvoti afinyelele umphumela awuthandayo ngokubonakalisa ngenhloso umuntu angakuthandi kumphakeli ongayithandiyo uphakame ngaphezulu.

question: Enethiwekhi yezintambo zomshini ezihlelwe njenge-diamond, kungani ukusika ngokomzimba intambo ephakathi exhuma izintambo ezimbili kudala isisindo esisindayo esiboshiwe ukuba SIKHULE esikhundleni sokwehla (i-Braess's Spring Paradox)?
options: Ukusika intambo ephakathi kushintsha izintambo zisuka kumumo othambile we-series ziye kumumo oqinile we-parallel
correctAnswer: Ukusika intambo ephakathi kushintsha izintambo zisuka kumumo othambile we-series ziye kumumo oqinile we-parallel
explanation: Lena yisibonelo somshini se-paradox ka-Braess. Intambo ixhuma inethiwekhi ku-series (ikhipha kakhulu). Ukusika lesi sixhumanisi kuphoqa bobabili ubhasikidi bezintambo ukuba babe ngaphansi kokulingana kwe-parallel, kwandisa ukuqina futhi kuphakamise umthwalo.

question: Kungani abathengisi ababili be-ayisikhilimu abancintisana olwandle olude olungamamitha ayi-1 besaba babonakala behlala bemisa amakhasethi abo eduze komunye nomunye phakathi nendawo (Umthetho ka-Hotelling)?
options: Ukuvumelana kuka-Nash kokuncintisana kwesikhala: ukuhamba uye phakathi kwendawo kukhulisa isabelo semakethe somthengisi ngamunye uma kuqhathaniswa nendawo yomphikisi
correctAnswer: Ukuvumelana kuka-Nash kokuncintisana kwesikhala: ukuhamba uye phakathi kwendawo kukhulisa isabelo semakethe somthengisi ngamunye uma kuqhathaniswa nendawo yomphikisi
explanation: UHarold Hotelling wakhombisa ukuthi izinkampani zinciphisa umehluko womkhiqizo noma wesikhala. Uma Umthengisi A esetha indawo ku-25%, Umthengisi B esetha ku-26% ukuze athole i-74% yolwandle, okudonsa womabili ukuya ku-50% womphakathi we-Nash.

question: Kungani umbono wezwi womculo obizwa ngokuthi 'Shepard Tone' uzwakala njengeskala yomculo eqhubeka ikhuphuka ngaphezu kwezinye njalo ngaphandle kokuthi ikhuphuke ngempela?
options: Umjikelezo oqhubekayo wamathoni e-othava ahlukene lapho amafrekhwe e-aphezulu eshela kancane ngenkathi amafrekhwe aphansi engena ngokuphumelelayo
Isipikha sidlala amafrekhwe angaphezu kwamandla okuzwa
correctAnswer: Umjikelezo oqhubekayo wamathoni e-othava ahlukene lapho amafrekhwe e-aphezulu eshela kancane ngenkathi amafrekhwe aphansi engena ngokuphumelelayo
explanation: Isikali sikaShepard siqukethe ama-sinusoid ahlukaniswe ngamawthava ahlelwe ngendlela yesitayela sephethini esinqunyiwe, sakha umbono wezwi womculo obonakalayo obizwa ngokuthi i-barberpole.

question: Kungani umuntu omele egumbini le-Ames ebonakala njengomkhulu kwikona eyodwa futhi ehlelela abe yisidumbu esincane ekhoneni eliphambene?
options: Igumbi lakhiwe njengokungalingani kwetrapezoid elinephansi elijikile nophahla, kuyilapho ukubuka ngepuleti lokubheka kuphoqa umbono ongethembekile wokuma okungenamaphutha
correctAnswer: Igumbi lakhiwe njengokungalingani kwetrapezoid elinephansi elijikile nophahla, kuyilapho ukubuka ngepuleti lokubheka kuphoqa umbono ongethembekile wokuma okungenamaphutha
explanation: Igumbi le-Ames liyaphazamiseka ekujuleni nasebuphakathini; ukubuka ngepuleti lokubheka elilodwa kususa umehluko wamehlo amabili, kuphoqe ubuchopho ukuthi buqonde igumbi elinelayini elingelona iqiniso ukuze kube khona ukuqagela usayizi womlingisi.

question: Ekuhlanekezelweni kuka-Edward Adelson kwe-Checker Shadow Illusion, kungani izikwele A no-B zinokukhanya okufanayo kwe-photometric, kodwa ababukeli bomuntu babona isikwele A simnyama nsomi kanti isikwele B cishe simhlophe?
options: Ubuchopho buzenzakalelayo bulungisa imithunzi edlalwayo nokungafani kwe-checkerboard yendawo, buhlukanisa ukukhanya ukuze kugcinwe ukubonakala kokubonakaliswa kwento
correctAnswer: Ubuchopho buzenzakalelayo bulungisa imithunzi edlalwayo nokungafani kwe-checkerboard yendawo, buhlukanisa ukukhanya ukuze kugcinwe ukubonakala kokubonakaliswa kwento
explanation: Izindlela zokugcina ubuhlungu bokukhanya zisusa umthunzi wesilinda oluhlaza obonakalayo bese kuqhathaniswa isikwele B nabamelene baso abamnyama, okuholela ekubonakaleni okuphezulu kokubuyisa.

question: Emphumeleni we-McGurk, ukubuka ividiyo yomuntu ophonsa umlomo wakhe uthi 'ga-ga' ngenkathi ithrekhi yomsindo idlala 'ba-ba' kubangela abalaleli abantu ukuze bezwe isiqu esisha ngokuphelele: 'da-da'. Kungani?
options: Ubuchopho buhlanganisa izimpawu zokukhuluma eziphikisanayo ezivela ekuzweni nasekuboneni zibe umbono owodwa womsindo owahlangene kahle
Izindlebe zomuntu ziyahluleka ngaphansi kokukhanya kwevidiyo
correctAnswer: Ubuchopho buhlanganisa izimpawu zokukhuluma eziphikisanayo ezivela ekuzweni nasekuboneni zibe umbono owodwa womsindo owahlangene kahle
explanation: Ukuqonda inkulumo kuyindlela eminingi; i-superior temporal sulcus ihlanganisa izithombe zokunyakaza kwemlomo nezimpawu zomsindo, ihlanganise isixazululo sempikiswano esiphakathi kwephonetic ('da').

question: Ku-Hermann Grid Illusion, kungani izindawo ezimnyama ezimhlophe ezinokukhanya okuncane zivele emiphambanweni yomugqa omhlophe, kodwa zinyamalale ngokuphelele uma ubheka ngqo kuzo?
options: Ukuvalwa kwama-lateral kwe-cell ye-ganglion esigcawini sangaphandle sokubona kudala ukuncipha kombala okukhawulelwe emiphambanweni emine
Imigqa emhlophe ibonisa ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
correctAnswer: Ukuvalwa kwama-lateral kwe-cell ye-ganglion esigcawini sangaphandle sokubona kudala ukuncipha kombala okukhawulelwe emiphambanweni emine
explanation: Izinkambu zokuzwa zangaphandle zinezakhiwo ezigxile emaphakathi/zizungeze ezivaliwe. Imiphambanweni inokukhanya okukhudlwana okujikeleze okumhlophe, okukhiqiza ukuvinjelwa okwengeziwe nezindawo ezibukeka zimnyama.

question: Kungani ukubuka ngokungashintshi endaweni encane ebomvu ezungezwe yindilinga eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka esicashile kubangela ukuthi indilinga eluhlaza iphele ngokuphelele emva kwemizuzwana engu-20 (Ukufiphala kuka-Troxler)?
options: Izinto ezingashintshi, ezinganyakazi emikhakheni ye-retinal yokwamukela izimpawu zihamba phambili ekuzivumeleni kwemizwa, zifiphele zingene emuva kokugcwalisa umbono.
correctAnswer: Izinto ezingashintshi, ezinganyakazi emikhakheni ye-retinal yokwamukela izimpawu zihamba phambili ekuzivumeleni kwemizwa, zifiphele zingene emuva kokugcwalisa umbono.
explanation: Abatholi bemibono bavumelana nezimpawu zasendaweni ezingashintshi; izinyakatho ezincane ngokujwayelekile zivuselela imingcele, kodwa ama-gradients athambile awanayo imiphetho, okudala ukujwayela okuphelele kobuchopho.

question: Kungani ukubuka ngokushesha isandla sesekhondi sesikhathi esijikelezayo sekhalenda ye-analog kukunika umbono ocacile wokuthi isandla sesekhondi sime isikhathi eside kunesekhondi esisodwa (Chronostasis)?
options: Ukufihla kwe-saccadic kunciphisa ukufakwa kombono ngesikhathi sokuhamba kwamehlo, futhi ubuchopho buhlela isithombe esilandela ukuhamba kwamehlo ukubuyisela igebe lesikhathi
correctAnswer: Ukufihla kwe-saccadic kunciphisa ukufakwa kombono ngesikhathi sokuhamba kwamehlo, futhi ubuchopho buhlela isithombe esilandela ukuhamba kwamehlo ukubuyisela igebe lesikhathi
explanation: Ngesikhathi sokuhamba okusheshayo kwamehlo (saccades), ubuchopho bufihla umbono ocashile; buyakhipha emuva isithombe sokuqala esicacile somgomo ngesikhathi esizamile.

question: Kungani ukufutha kwegala elishisayo eliwela emanzini abandayo (i-Prince Rupert's Drop) kusinda uma luqukethe izikulufo zesikhumba esikhulu, kodwa luphume libe ufulawa uma umsila waso omncane usinqanyuliwe?
options: Izimo eziphakeme kakhulu zokucindezela ebusweni zigoqela inhliziyo ebandakanya ukungezwani okukhulu; ukuphuka komqolo kukhulula i-wave yokuphuka esakazeka ku-1.5 km/s
Umsila uqukethe i-asidi elinehlobo lokudubula eliyingozi
correctAnswer: Izimo eziphakeme kakhulu zokucindezela ebusweni zigoqela inhliziyo ebandakanya ukungezwani okukhulu; ukuphuka komqolo kukhulula i-wave yokuphuka esakazeka ku-1.5 km/s
explanation: Ukupholisa okusheshayo kwangaphandle kuvimba ingilazi yangaphandle ekucindezelekeni kwe-gigapascal kuyilapho ingaphakathi elincibilikile licwila ngaphansi kwengcindezi yokudonsa enkulu; ukuphuka komgogodla kukhulula ukukhishwa kwezigxobo ezibhubhisayo.

question: Kungani intambo egobekile eyenziwe ngeNitinol (i-alloyi ye-nickel-titanium) ibuyela emuva ekubunjweni kwayo okuyinkimbinkimbi yokuqala uma ifakwe emanzini ashisayo?
options: Ukushintsha kwesimo se-crystalline esivela ku-martensite ukuya ku-austenite esivuselelwayo sobushushu kubuyisela ukulungiswa kwe-lattice yengqimba ye-athomu yokuqala
Insimbi iyanyibilika bese ipholile futhi ibuyele esimweni sokungqinelana
Amanzi ashisayo enza i-nickel ibe yisigubhu
Ukuqinisa komhlaba wamanzi kubeka intambo ilele
correctAnswer: Ukushintsha kwesimo se-crystalline esivela ku-martensite ukuya ku-austenite esivuselelwayo sobushushu kubuyisela ukulungiswa kwe-lattice yengqimba ye-athomu yokuqala
explanation: I-Nitinol idlula ekubunjweni kabusha komngcele oyiziwombe ngaphandle kokuhamba: i-martensite ephansi-temperatha ebhekiwe ishintshela ku-austenite yomzali enesimiso esiphezulu ngaphezu kwamazinga okushintsha.

question: Indlela igobolondo legwalo elincane lingagijima ngayo phansi kwepulasitiki ehlanzekile, engaphukile ngaphandle kokusebenzisa iglu elimanzi, izinkomishi zokulsula, noma amakhokho?
options: Izigidi zamaspatula amancane e-keratin ezinqeni zalo zenza amandla e-van der Waals aqoqayo neglasi
Izinyawo zalo zakha ugesi omkhulu wokudonsa
Amafutha obumnandi akhipha uwoyela wemvelo okhonza njengamakhanda
correctAnswer: Izigidi zamaspatula amancane e-keratin ezinqeni zalo zenza amandla e-van der Waals aqoqayo neglasi
explanation: Ama-setae ahlukanisa abe izigidi zamaspatula amancane; ukuxhumana okusondele kakhulu kwenza izigidigidi zezinhlayiyana zibe ngaphakathi kwamayini we-nanometer seglasi, okudala ukunamathela okukhulu okomile.

question: Kungani amanzi ehamba phezu kohlaza lwe-lotus ngendlela yamabala ayindilinga ephelele, ethwele udaka futhi esala engenawo mhlahlandlela (Umphumela we-Lotus)?
options: Amakhekhe angaphansi kwesikhumba amancane agcwele ama-crystal kawoyela angamanzini anciphisa indawo yokuxhumana, edala i-engeli yokuxhumana engaphezu kuka-150°
Amahadi e-lotus akhipha ukushisa okubilisa amanzi
correctAnswer: Amakhekhe angaphansi kwesikhumba amancane agcwele ama-crystal kawoyela angamanzini anciphisa indawo yokuxhumana, edala i-engeli yokuxhumana engaphezu kuka-150°
explanation: Isimo se-Superhydrophobic Cassie-Baxter: amashubhu amanzi ahlala phezulu kumaphakethe omoya amancane abambeke phakathi kwamapapilla kawoyela, egeleza kalula futhi eqoqa izinto ezihambisanayo.

question: Kungani i-Aerogel (intuthu eqandisiwe)—equkethe ngaphezu kuka-99 ekhulwini komoya okungenalutho—ikwazi ukuvikela isikhumba somuntu emlilweni oqondile we-blowtorch ngaphandle kokuba shisa?
options: Inethiwekhi yayo ye-silica nanopore enokugoqa kakhulu ivimbela ukudluliswa kokushisa, kanti ububanzi bamaphora (20 nm) buncane kunendlela evamile yomoya (umthelela kaKnudsen)
Umoya ngaphakathi kwe-aerogel uguquka ube i-helium egeleza
correctAnswer: Inethiwekhi yayo ye-silica nanopore enokugoqa kakhulu ivimbela ukudluliswa kokushisa, kanti ububanzi bamaphora (20 nm) buncane kunendlela evamile yomoya (umthelela kaKnudsen)
explanation: Umphumela ka-Knudsen: ama-athikili egesi asemaphakathi emi-20-nm angqubana nezindonga zobuningi kunokuhlangana omunye nomunye, okuvimba ngokuphelele ukudluliswa okushisayo kwegesi ngokudluliswa kokushisa nokusakazeka.

question: Kungani ukwengeza umgwaqo omusha osheshayo kunethiwekhi yomgwaqo yomuzi esivele ifakwe kakhulu kuvame ukwenza isikhathi sokuhamba sabahambi sonke sibe side (I-Paradox kaBraess)?
options: Izinketho zokuhamba ezenzelwe ukuzithokozisa ngomgwaqo omusha zifika ku-Nash equilibrium engcono engakafinyeleli, okuvimba amaphuzu avelele angaphansi.
correctAnswer: Izinketho zokuhamba ezenzelwe ukuzithokozisa ngomgwaqo omusha zifika ku-Nash equilibrium engcono engakafinyeleli, okuvimba amaphuzu avelele angaphansi.
explanation: Lapho umshayeli ngamunye ekhetha ukuzimela umgwaqo omfushane kakhulu ngaphandle kokuhleleka, i-Nash equilibrium ephumayo inikeza isikhathi eside kunanoma ngaphambili inethiwekhi yonke.

question: Kungani ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle kwamandla (njengokwakha izinjini zezimoto ezisebenzisa uphethiloli kahle) ngokomlando kuholela ekwandeni kokusetshenziswa kwepetroli kazwelonke esikhundleni sokuncipha (iJevons Paradox)?
options: Ukusebenza kahle okwandisiwe kwehlisa izindleko zomsebenzi, okuholela ekukhuleni okukhulu kwesidingo nokusetshenziswa okuphelele.
Izinjini ezisebenzisa uphethiloli kahle zishisa uphethiloli ngendlela engcolile.
correctAnswer: Ukusebenza kahle okwandisiwe kwehlisa izindleko zomsebenzi, okuholela ekukhuleni okukhulu kwesidingo nokusetshenziswa okuphelele.
explanation: U-W.S. Jevons uqaphele ukuthi ukusebenza kahle kwezimoto ze-steam kwehlise izindleko zekhole, kwakhuthaza ukwamukelwa kabanzi kwezimboni nokuphindaphinda ukusetshenziswa kwekhole.

question: Kungani uhulumeni wakoloni ezinikele ekukhokheni imali kuzo zonke izinyoka ezibulawa ezilethwa ngabantu ekugcineni kwaholela ekwandeni ngokweqile kwabantu bezinyoka zasendle (Umphumela we-Cobra)?
options: Abantu abanamakhono baqala ukubalungisa izinyoka ezibanjwe ukuze bathole izinzuzo; lapho uhlelo luphela, bazikhulula emahlathini
Imbuyiselo yaholela izinyoka ezivela kwezinye izwekazi
correctAnswer: Abantu abanamakhono baqala ukubalungisa izinyoka ezibanjwe ukuze bathole izinzuzo; lapho uhlelo luphela, bazikhulula emahlathini
explanation: Izikhuthazo ezimbi zidala imiphumela emibi: umnotho wemivuzo wakhuthaza ukufuya izinyoka. Ukukhanselwa kwemivuzo kwabhubhisa imakethe, okuholela ekukhululweni ngobuningi.

question: Kungani umzamo wendumiso yokuzama ngokomthetho ukuvimba nokususa isithombe esithathwe emoyeni sendlu yakhe yasogwini sabangela ukuthi izigidi zabantu zilandela futhi zibuke isithombe emhlabeni wonke (Umphumela kaStreisand)?
options: Ukuzama ukuvimba ulwazi lomphakathi kudonsa intshisekelo enkulu yezindaba, kukhuphule ukunakwa okusheshayo
Icala liqukethe isithombe esigcwele ngaphakathi kwamafayela enkantolo
Umlingisi wesithombe wathenga onke amaphrinta ezindaba
correctAnswer: Ukuzama ukuvimba ulwazi lomphakathi kudonsa intshisekelo enkulu yezindaba, kukhuphule ukunakwa okusheshayo
explanation: Umphumela kaStreisand ubonisa ukuphendula kwengqondo: imizamo enonya yokucindezela uguqula irekhodi elingaziwa libe yindaba yomhlaba wonke edumile.

question: Uma zonke izinkuni zesikebhe sikaTheseus zishintshwa enye ngenye emashumini eminyaka kuze kube sengathi awekho amaqembu omsuka asele, ngabe siseyisikebhe esifanayo?
options: I-paradox eyisisekelo ye-metaphysical yobunikazi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi engenawo umphumela owodwa wezibalo
Kodwa kuphela uma umkhumbi uqhubeka unomphathi oyedwa
correctAnswer: I-paradox eyisisekelo ye-metaphysical yobunikazi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi engenawo umphumela owodwa wezibalo
explanation: Isikebhe sikaTheseus sixoxa ngokubaluleka kwe-mereology kuqhathaniswa nokuqhubeka kwesikhathi nesikhala. Uma izingxenye zihlanganiswa ukwakha esinye isikebhe, ubunikazi buya phikiswa.

question: Uma umhambi wesikhathi ehamba emuva esikhathini futhi ngaphandle kokuhlosile evimbela ugogo wakhe wezifo zokuzalwa ukuthi angahlangani nomkhulu wakhe, kanjani umhambi angabe ekhona ukuhamba emuva esikhathini?
options: Isiyingi somzuzu esiphikisana naso esaziwa ngokuthi i-Grandfather Paradox
Izwe liguqula kabusha i-DNA yezakhi zofuzo
correctAnswer: Isiyingi somzuzu esiphikisana naso esaziwa ngokuthi i-Grandfather Paradox
explanation: Imijikelezo yesikhathi evalekile (CTCs) iphakamisa inselele ekuzinzeni kokubangela. Umgomo wokuzinza kaNovikov usho ukuthi amathuba esikhathi esedlule azilungisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuvimbela ukuphikisana.

question: Kungani i-One-Time Pad (i-Vernam cipher) ifakazelwe ngokwezibalo ukuthi ayinakuphulwa ngokuphelele ngisho nasomkhonyovu onamandla okucubungula angenamkhawulo?
options: Uma usebenzisa ukhiye ongahleliwe ngokuphelele okude njengombhalo ocacile oyisebenzisile kanye kuphela ngokuphindiwe, umbhalo ocashuniwe awudaluli lutho lolwazi lweShannon (ubumfihlo obuphelele)
correctAnswer: Uma usebenzisa ukhiye ongahleliwe ngokuphelele okude njengombhalo ocacile oyisebenzisile kanye kuphela ngokuphindiwe, umbhalo ocashuniwe awudaluli lutho lolwazi lweShannon (ubumfihlo obuphelele)
explanation: UClaude Shannon ubonisile ukufihla kolwazi okusezimiso zolwazi: H(M | C) = H(M). Ngoba noma yimuphi umbhalo ocacile onobude obulinganayo unamathuba alinganayo, ukuqhuma ngokusebenzisa amandla wonke kudala wonke imibhalo engenzeka.

question: Kungani ukubethela kwezokuphepha zesimanje okusekelwe kuzihluthulelo zomphakathi (njenge-RSA-2048) kungavezwa ngemizuzwana ngokusebenzisa isihluthulelo esiyimfihlo, kodwa kuthatha eminyakeni eyizigidigidi ukukuphula ngaphandle kwaso?
options: Ukwandisa izinombolo ezimbili ezinkulu eziyiziphrime akunzima ngokwekhompyutha, kodwa ukuthola lezi zinombolo eziyiziphrime ngokumkhiqizo wazo kuyinkinga engaxazululeki.
Izihluthulelo eziyimfihlo ziqukethe amakhodi ama-quantum ayimfihlo.
correctAnswer: Ukwandisa izinombolo ezimbili ezinkulu eziyiziphrime akunzima ngokwekhompyutha, kodwa ukuthola lezi zinombolo eziyiziphrime ngokumkhiqizo wazo kuyinkinga engaxazululeki.
explanation: I-RSA ithembele ekunzima okungalingani kokubala ukuhlukaniswa kwezinombolo eziyisi-Integer: O(1) ukuphindaphinda kuqhathaniswa nokuhlukaniswa kwe-sub-exponential general number field sieve.

question: Kungani i-Algorithm yakwa-Shor esebenza kukhompyutha ye-quantum ebonakalayo ibeka ingozi enkulu ekufihleni okhiye womphakathi we-RSA?
options: Ithola izici eziyiziphambano zenombolo enkulu ngesikhathi se-polynomial sisebenzisa ukuguqulwa kwe-quantum Fourier
correctAnswer: Ithola izici eziyiziphambano zenombolo enkulu ngesikhathi se-polynomial sisebenzisa ukuguqulwa kwe-quantum Fourier
explanation: Ukuhlukaniswa kwenombolo kwendabuko kukhula ngokukhula okufanayo, kodwa i-algorithm yakwa-Shor isebenzisa ukuxubana kwe-quantum nokuthola isikhathi ukusinikeza isixazululo ngesikhathi se-polynomial O((log N)^3).

question: I-Algorithm ye-Quantum ka-Grover isheshisa kanjani ukufuna ku-database engahleliwe enezinto ezi-N?
options: Inikeza ukukhuphuka okulinganiselwe ngokwe-quadratic, ukuthola okuhloswe ngakho cishe esinyathelweni esiyimphakathini we-N
correctAnswer: Inikeza ukukhuphuka okulinganiselwe ngokwe-quadratic, ukuthola okuhloswe ngakho cishe esinyathelweni esiyimphakathini we-N
explanation: Ngenkathi amandla esintu adinga izicelo ze-O(N) ngokuvamile, i-algorithm ka-Grover ikhuphula amandla we-quantum wokuba sesimweni esifanele ku-O(sqrt(N)) izikhathi.

question: Kwimfundiso yamathuba, kungani kudingeka abantu abangama-23 kuphela egumbini ukuze kube nethuba elingaphezu kuka-50 ekhulwini lokuthi abantu ababili babelane ngosuku lokuzalwa olufanayo (i-Birthday Paradox)?
options: Uqhathanisa iziphetho zabantu (izinhlanganisela ezihlukanisiwe ezingama-253) kunokuhlanganisa abantu ngabanye nosuku olulodwa
Iminyaka enonyaka ongamashumi amathathu namahlanu (leap years) inezinsuku ezingama-366
Abantu bakhohlwa izinsuku zabo zangempela zokuzalwa
correctAnswer: Uqhathanisa iziphetho zabantu (izinhlanganisela ezihlukanisiwe ezingama-253) kunokuhlanganisa abantu ngabanye nosuku olulodwa
explanation: Ngabantu abangama-23, inani lezihlanganiso ezihlukanisiwe lifinyelela ku-23*22/2 = 253. Ithuba eliphambene lokungabi khona ukuhlangana lehla ngaphansi kuka-0.5.

question: Iyiphi inkohliso yezibalo eyenzeka ku-Simpson's Paradox, lapho ukwelashwa kubonakala kudlula kuzo zonke izigaba zomuntu ngamunye kodwa kuba ngaphansi lapho idatha ihlanganisiwe?
options: Into engaziwa ephazamisa ikhulisa isisindo nosayizi wesampula wezigaba ezingaphansi
correctAnswer: Into engaziwa ephazamisa ikhulisa isisindo nosayizi wesampula wezigaba ezingaphansi
explanation: I-simpson's paradox ivela lapho into ephazamisa engabonwa ithinta kokubili ukwabiwa kwezibalo nezindlela zokuphuma, iphinde ishintshe indlela yokuhlangana marginal.

question: NgokweMthetho kaBenford (Umthetho Wesibalo sokuqala), kungani inombolo ethi '1' ivele njengezinombolo eziqala kuqala kudatha yemvelo (efana nobude bemifula nezincwadi ze-akhawunti) ngaphezu kuka-30 ekhulwini kwesikhathi?
options: Izingozi zemvelo zidlula izigaba eziningi zosayizi ngokokusatshalaliswa kwe-logarithmic nokungashintshi kwesikali
correctAnswer: Izingozi zemvelo zidlula izigaba eziningi zosayizi ngokokusatshalaliswa kwe-logarithmic nokungashintshi kwesikali
explanation: Idatha engashintshi ngesikali ilandela ukusatshalaliswa kwe-logarithmic P(d) = log10(1 + 1/d), okusho ukuthi ukukhula kusuka ku-1 kuya ku-2 kudinga ukwanda okungu-100%, kuyilapho okukuka-8 kuya ku-9 kudinga kuphela okungu-12.5%.

question: Kungani UGabriel's Horn (i-Torricelli's Trumpet)—eyakheka ngokujikeleza u y = 1/x lapho x >= 1 ku-x-axis—ibizwa ngokuthi 'i-Paradox Yomdwebi'?
options: Inenhlaka yangaphakathi enqunyelwe ngokuphelele engu-pi cubic units, kodwa indawo yayo yangaphandle ayinamkhawulo
correctAnswer: Inenhlaka yangaphakathi enqunyelwe ngokuphelele engu-pi cubic units, kodwa indawo yayo yangaphandle ayinamkhawulo
explanation: I-integral engafanele yokuthola ivolumu iphuma ku-pi, kuyilapho i-integral yendawo ephumelelayo iphambuka iye ku-infinity; ngokwesayensi ungasigcwalisa ngopendi we-pi, kodwa awukwazi ukufaka ungaphandle.

question: Kungani iBanach-Tarski Paradox ithi ibhola eliqinile lezibalo linganqunywa libe izingcezu ezi-5 ezingaxhumani futhi liqoqwe kabusha libe amabhola amabili afanayo ngokobukhulu obufanayo nalobuqale?
options: Ukuwohloka kuncike kwizethi ezingalinganiswanga ezidalwe kusetshenziswa i-Axiom yokukhetha engakha lutho
correctAnswer: Ukuwohloka kuncike kwizethi ezingalinganiswanga ezidalwe kusetshenziswa i-Axiom yokukhetha engakha lutho
explanation: Izingcezu ziqhakazile ngokungenamkhawulo, iziqephu ezingalinganiswa ezinovolumu ye-Lebesgue engachazwanga. Ukuzijikeleisa kwezi ziqephu ezingalinganiswa ku-3D kukhiqiza amasondo amabili agcwele.

question: Ekuhlanganiseni kwe-Coastline Paradox, kungani umjikelezo womhlaba okalwa ngezwe owaziwayo waseGreat Britain ukhula kakhulu uma isibalo sakho sokukala siba sincane?
options: Izintaba zasogwini zibonisa ukufana okufana ne-fractal, okusho ukuthi izikhali zokukala ezincane zibamba amabhayisi nezimbobo ezincane endlessly
Izimo zasolwandle zandisa umhlaba njalo ngehora
correctAnswer: Izintaba zasogwini zibonisa ukufana okufana ne-fractal, okusho ukuthi izikhali zokukala ezincane zibamba amabhayisi nezimbobo ezincane endlessly
explanation: UBenoit Mandelbrot wakuqinisekisa ukuthi izintaba zasogwini zinefomula ye-fractal engaphezu kuka-1. Njengoba ubude besibalo epsilon busondela ku-zero, umjikelezo wonke uyanyuka uye ku-infinity.

question: Esigubheni sikaZeno se-Achilles kanye neTortoise, kungani u-Achilles osheshayo edlula i-tortoise esehla kancane ngokwe-mathematisi emhlabeni wangempela nakuba umehluko wesikhala ungekho ngokungenamkhawulo?

question: Ku-Paradox kaZeno we-Bhulesi, ibhulesi elisuka endaweni libonakala linganyakazi kuyo yonke imizuzwana ngayinye ngesikhathi. Kungani lisahamba ngokuhamba kwesikhashana?

question: Enkinga ka-Newcomb, umphrofethi ongeke aphoxe ushiya ibhokisi A ($1,000) neBHokisi B ($1,000,000 uma ekubike ukuthi uthatha iB kuphela; lingenalutho uma ekubike ukuthi uthatha womabili). Kungani ithiyori yokwenza izinqumo ihlukanisa phakathi kokuthatha ibhokisi elilodwa noma womabili?

question: Esimweni se-Sleeping Beauty, uBeauty ulala bese evuswa ngoMsombuluko (futhi futhi ngoLwesibili uma imali iwela kuTails, lapho inkumbulo yakhe isusiwe). Lapho evuka, yini inkolelo yakhe yomuntu siqu yokuthi imali iwela ku-Heads?

question: Enkinga Yama-Envelope Amabili, I-Envelope A iqukethe u-$X kanti I-Envelope B iqukethe noma u-$2X noma u-$X/2. Kungani inzuzo ebukekayo okulindeleke ukuthi uthole ngokushintsha (1.25 * X) ingamanga?

question: Epharadesi likaHempel elibizwa ngokuthi i-Raven Paradox, kungani ukubona i-apula eliluhlaza etafuleni lakho lasekhishini kungaba ubufakazi beBayesian ngomqondo wokuthi 'Zonke izimpungushe zimnyama'?

question: Kwisigameko sikaNelson Goodman esibizwa ngokuthi 'Grue' Paradox, kungani ukuchaza isimo esibizwa ngokuthi 'grue' (okuluhlaza ngaphambi konyaka ka-2050, okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka emva kwalokho) kunselela isisekelo sokufingqa kwesayensi?

question: Ku-Paradox ye-Unexpected Hanging, ijaji liphonsa isigwebo sokuthi isigwili sizopha ngosuku lwamasonto phakathi naphakathi nosuku, kodwa lithembisa ukuthi lolu suku luzoba isimanga esiphelele. Kungani ukubuyela emuva kwesiphetho kwehluleka ukusindisa isigwili?

question: E-Dilemmani Yecala Lomgibeli, kungani abadlali ababili abanengqondo bagcina behlukana futhi bethola umphumela ongcono kunalokhu okuhle kakhulu uma bebebethethile ngokuthule?

question: Emdlalweni we-Centipede, ukubuyekezwa kokuhola emuva kubikezela ukuthi abadlali abanolwazi bazophela umdlalo ku-turn yokuqala. Kungani?

question: Iyiphi iphutha lokucabanga kwabantu ekhombiswa yi-Allais Paradox, lapho abantu bekhetha imali eqinisekisiwe engu-$1 million kunokubheja okungu-89% kwemali engaphezu kwalokho, okuphula umthetho wokulindela inzuzo?

question: Kungani ukukholwa ukuthi isondo le-roulette eliqale ku-Red izikhathi eziyi-10 ezilandelanayo selikulungele ukuwela ku-Black kubizwa ngokuthi i-Gambler's Fallacy?

correctAnswer: Amaqhinga azimele angenawo umqondo; amathuba okuthi uwile ku-Bomvu noma ku-Mnyama ahlala engu-50 ekhulwini kuzo zonke izikhathi zokujikeleza ngakunye

question: Kungani ukuhlolwa kwezokwelapha okungu-99 ekhulwini okunembile ngokugula okungavamile okuthinta umuntu oyedwa kwabangu-10,000 kukhombisa kuphela cishe amathuba angu-1 ekhulwini okuba nengqondo yokuthi umuntu unegciwane uma umphumela uphume uhlehlela phezulu?

correctAnswer: Ukunganaki isilinganiso sokuqala: iningi elikhulu lokuhlolwa okuhle kwabantu abanempilo kungamanga okuhle

question: Kungani umathematici u-Abraham Wald wacebisa amasotsha ase-US ukuthi engeze isikhali esisindayo ezifundeni ezingakalinyazwa zezindiza zokulwa ezibuya esikhundleni sezindawo lapho kutholakale khona izibhamu?

explanation: U-Wald wabona ukuthi izindiza ezibuya zingamasampula anokukhetha kwabaphilile. Izindawo ezingenazo izimbobo zezibhamu kubaphilile (injini, inkundla yomshayeli) kwakuyizindawo lapho ukushaywa bekubulala khona.

question: Emsebenzini Wokukhetha ka-Wason, kungani abantu abangaphezu kuka-80 ekhulwini behluleka ukuhlola umthetho othi 'Uma ikhadi libonisa isivumelwano ngomunye uhlangothi, kumele libonise inombolo ephindwe kabili kolunye' namakhadi akhombisa [A, K, 4, 7]?
options: Ukukhetha ukuqinisekisa: abantu bayaphendula ikhadi '4' ukuze baqinisekise umthetho kunokuphendula '7' ukuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi awulungi (modus tollens)
correctAnswer: Ukukhetha ukuqinisekisa: abantu bayaphendula ikhadi '4' ukuze baqinisekise umthetho kunokuphendula '7' ukuzama ukuqinisekisa ukuthi awulungi (modus tollens)
explanation: Umthetho uthi P -> Q. Ukuwuhlola, umuntu kumele ahlole P (ikhadi 'A') futhi hhayi-Q (ikhadi '7'). Ukuphendula '4' (Q) kusho ukuqinisekisa umphumela futhi akukwazi ukuphikisa umthetho.

question: Ku-Prospect Theory, kungani abantu behluleka ukuthola ubuhlungu bokomqondo obuphindwe kabili cishe bokulahlekelwa yi-$100 uma kuqhathaniswa nenjabulo abayithola ngokuzuza i-$100?

correctAnswer: Ukugwema ukulahlekelwa: imisebenzi yexabiso lomuntu iphakathi kakhulu endaweni engemihle kunasemkhakheni omuhle
explanation: U-Kahneman no-Tversky bafakazele ukuthi inani lichazwa phezu kokuzuza nokulahlekelwa maqondana nephuzu lokubhekisela. I-coefficient yokugwema ukulahlekelwa u-lambda ngokuvamile iphakathi kuka-1.5 no-2.5.

question: Kungani Umthelela kaDunning-Kruger ubangela ukuthi abasaqalayo abanobuchwepheshe obuncane endaweni ethile bathande ukubona amakhono abo ngokweqile?

correctAnswer: Ukuntuleka kwamakhono okuzazi (metacognitive) adingekayo ukuze benze kahle futhi kuvimbela ukuthi bazi ukubona ubuthakathaka babo
explanation: UDunning noKruger bathole ukuthi abenze kabi bahlushwa isono esiphindwe kabili: ukungabi nalo ulwazi kuholela emaphutheni, futhi ukushoda kwabo kolwazi kubavimba ukuthi bahlolisise ikhwalithi ngendlela efanele.

question: Kungani ukusho inombolo yokuqala engahleliwe (njengokujikeleza kwe-roleti) kudala ukuphazamiseka okukhulu ekuhloleni kwezibalo okulandelayo kwabahluleli nabeluleki (Anchoring Bias)?
options: Ubuchopho buqina enanini lokuqala futhi benza ukulungiswa okunganele phakathi kwendlela yokubuka ngokomuzwa
correctAnswer: Ubuchopho buqina enanini lokuqala futhi benza ukulungiswa okunganele phakathi kwendlela yokubuka ngokomuzwa
explanation: UTversky noKahneman bakhombisile ukuthi abantu bayalungisa ukuhl估la kwabo kusuka ku-anchor kuze kufike emngceleni wokungenzeka, bephoqelela ukuphela kokulungiswa ngaphambi kwesikhathi.

question: Kungani ukufunda ukuthi umuntu muhle ngokomzimba noma unobungane kubangela abantu ukuba bacabange ukuthi futhi uhlakaniphile, uthembekile, futhi uyakwazi (Umphumela we-Halo)?

correctAnswer: Umbono omuhle esimisweni esisodwa ukhiqiza indlela yokucabanga yonke esibheka kahle zonke izilinganiso ezingahlangene
explanation: U-Edward Thorndike wathola umphumela we-halo njengokuthambekela kokuthi umbono jikelele ngomuntu uthinte indlela esizwa ngayo nokucabanga ngobuntu babo ezigabeni ezingahlangene.

question: Kungani abantu abaningi ababekhona bezehluleka ukuphazamisa noma ukubiza izinsiza eziphuthumayo ngesikhathi sezinkinga zomphakathi zokwelashwa (Umphumela Wababukeli)?
options: Ukusabalala komthwalo wemfanelo: ukuba khona kwabantu abaningi okubukelayo kunciphisa umuzwa womuntu ngamunye wokuzibophezela ukwenza okuthile
correctAnswer: Ukusabalala komthwalo wemfanelo: ukuba khona kwabantu abaningi okubukelayo kunciphisa umuzwa womuntu ngamunye wokuzibophezela ukwenza okuthile
explanation: U-Darley no-Latane bafakazele ukuthi ukungasebenzi kwabantu ababukelayo kuvela ekusabalaleni komthwalo wemfanelo nasekutheni abantu abaningi bengazi: ukubona abanye behlala bethule kubakhuthaza ukuthi izehlakalo aziphuthumi.

question: Ekuhloleni ukufana kukaSolomon Asch, kungani amaphesenti angama-75 wabahlanganyeli evumelana nempendulo yeqembu engalungile ngokusobala mayelana nobude bemigqa okungenani kanye?

correctAnswer: Umthelela wezenhlalo ojwayelekile nowolwazi: isifiso esinamandla sokwengamela engqondweni ukuvimbela ukwenqatshwa emphakathini noma ukungabaza imizwa yakho
explanation: U-Asch wakhombisa amandla engcindezi yokulingana nabanye. Abahlanganyeli besaba ukubonakala njengabahluke, kanti abanye babezingela ukuthenjwa kwabo ngokubona uma kuqhathaniswa nokuvumelana ngokuphelele komphakathi.

question: Kungani amaphesenti angama-65 wabahlanganyeli abajwayelekile kuhlolo lukaStanley Milgram ephathise okwakubhekwa njengokubulala ama-shock kagesi angu-450-volts kumuntu onganelungelo?

question: Ekuhloleni kuka-Leon Festinger ngokungavumelani kokucabanga, kungani izihloko ezakhokhelwa kuphela u-$1 ukukhohlisa zabika ngokuthi zangijabulela kakhulu umsebenzi odlulisa amaphini kunalezo ezakhokhelwa u-$20?

correctAnswer: Ukuxazulula ukungqubuzana kwengqondo ngaphakathi ngaphandle kokuqinisekisa kwezezimali, bashintsha umqondo wabo wangaphakathi ukuze basuse ubuqili

question: Kungani ngaphezu kuka-90 ekhulwini kwabashayeli bezimoto abanezincwadi zokushayela behlola amakhono abo okushayela njenge 'phezu kakhulu kwesilinganiso esiphakathi' (Umphumela we-Lake Wobegon)?

correctAnswer: Ubufulswane bokuzicabangela ukuthi ungcono: abantu bachaza izindlela zokuhlola ezingacacile besebenzisa amandla abo umuntu ngamunye.

question: Kungani abantu beqhubeka bekala ama-profiles wokuziphatha wamahoroscopes ajwayelekile njengohlukile futhi eshaya ngokumangalisayo eqinisweni kubo (Umphumela we-Barnum / Forer)?

correctAnswer: Abantu babeka incazelo ethile yomuntu siqu ezitatimendeni ezibambekayo, ezivumelana nomphakathi wonke eziphakamisayo
explanation: U-Bertram Forer wakhombisa ukuthi izihloko zazilinganisa umbhalo ocacile (‘unenkinga enkulu yokuba abantu bakuthande’) ngo-4.3/5 ngokunemba ngoba abantu ngokwemvelo bayavuma izitatimende ezijabulisayo ezijwayelekile.

question: Kungani abaphathi bezinkampani nohulumeni beqhubeka befafaza izigidigidi ezimaphrojekthi ezibhekene nokwehluleka kunokuyiyeka (iSunk Cost Fallacy)?
options: Ukuhlonipha okungakhethiyo izimali zomlando ezingeke zibuyiselwe ukuze kugwemeke ukuvuma ukuhluleka nokubona ukulahlekelwa kwengqondo
correctAnswer: Ukuhlonipha okungakhethiyo izimali zomlando ezingeke zibuyiselwe ukuze kugwemeke ukuvuma ukuhluleka nokubona ukulahlekelwa kwengqondo
explanation: Izimiso zokwenza izinqumo zomnotho ziphakamisa ukuhlaziywa kwezindleko-nezinzuzo ezibheke phambili. Izindleko ezilahlekile azibuyiselwanga futhi kufanele zingabi nesisindo ekwabeleni izimali ezizayo.

question: Engqondweni yemfundo, kanjani ukukhuluma ngenkani kubafundisi ukuthi abafundi abathile bangama-'intellectual bloomers' kubangela ukuthi labo bafundi bakhule ngobuhlakani obukhulu (umthelela we-Pygmalion)?

correctAnswer: Okulindelwe othisha kuthinta ngendlela ethambile ulimi lomzimba wabafundisi, ubuningi bokuphendula, ukufudumala, kanye nenselelo yokucabanga
explanation: U-Robert Rosenthal waveza isibusiso esizigcina ngokwawo: othisha abanikezwa okulindelwe okuphezulu banikeza abafundi isikhathi esengeziwe sokuphendula, impendulo ecacile, nokukhuthazwa okukhulu.

question: Kungani abasebenzi befektri e-Western Electric bethuthukisa ukukhiqiza kwabo njalo ngesikhathi izibani zishintshwa—kungakhathalekile ukuthi izibani zazikhanya kakhulu NOMA zincipha (Umphumela we-Hawthorne)?

Ukushisa kwe-bulb kwanika amandla amathuluzi efektri
correctAnswer: Izihloko zaguqula ukuziphatha kwazo ngenxa yokwazi ukuthi zibhekwa futhi zithola ukunakwa kuwuhlelo
explanation: Ukuhlolwa kwe-Hawthorne kukhombise ukuthi izimo zenhlalo nezengqondo—ikakhulukazi ukunakwa okusha kwabacwaningi—kube nomthelela omkhulu ekukhiqizeni kunokuguquguquka kwemvelo yomsebenzi.

question: Kungani ukunikeza iphilisi le-shukela elingasebenzi nhlobo ocwaningweni lwezokwelapha kunciphisa ubuhlungu futhi kuvuselele ukukhululwa kwe-endorphin yangempela kwezokwelapha ezigulini (Umphumela we-Placebo)?
