Ishukela isebenza njengento yokubulala ubuhlungu ngokwemakhemikhali
Odokotela benza i-hypnosis ngesikhathi sokuthatha amaphilisi
correctAnswer: Ukulindela ngokwengqondo nokufundiswa kuwushayela imizila ye-analgesic ehlayo ebuchosheni, kukhulula ama-opioid endogeniangempela
explanation: Ukuhlaziywa kwabuchopho kuqinisekisa ukuthi i-placebo analgesia iveza ukuzibopha kwe-mu-opioid receptor yangempela esibindini sobuhlungu.

question: Ekuhlanekezeleni Isandla se-Rubber, kungani ukudlala okugqamile kwesandla se-rubber esibonakalayo nesandla sangempela esifihliwe kubangela abantu babe nomuzwa wokuzizwa ngezandla ze-rubber?
options: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezitho eziningi: ubuchopho buxazulula ukuvumelana okubukwayo nokuthintwayo ngokuvuselela uhlelo lwangaphakathi lomzimba ukuze lwamukele isandla se-rubber
Isandla sangempela siba nokuhlehla ngenxa yobanda
correctAnswer: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezitho eziningi: ubuchopho buxazulula ukuvumelana okubukwayo nokuthintwayo ngokuvuselela uhlelo lwangaphakathi lomzimba ukuze lwamukele isandla se-rubber
explanation: Lapho izimpawu zokuthinta ezibonakalayo zihambisana nemizwa yomzimba ehlelekile, i-parietal cortex yobuchopho idlula ukuqaphela umzimba, iphinde ibe nomthelela ebunikeni bomzimba entweni ebonakalayo.

question: Kungani isiguli esineCapgras Delusion siqhubeka sisho ukuthi umyeni wabo noma umama wabo uyinqaba noma ikhophi efanayo, nakuba bazi ubuso babo kahle kakhulu?
options: Indlela yobuchopho exh humanisa ukuqaphela ubuso nezimpendulo zomzwelo ezizimele iyonakele, idala ubujwayele bokubona ngaphandle kwemizwa yokuzwela
correctAnswer: Indlela yobuchopho exh humanisa ukuqaphela ubuso nezimpendulo zomzwelo ezizimele iyonakele, idala ubujwayele bokubona ngaphandle kwemizwa yokuzwela
explanation: U-V.S. Ramachandran wakhombisa ukuthi nakuba ukuhlonza ubuso obusezansi (i-fusiform gyrus) kusezingeni, ukuxhumana ne-amygdala kuseyekile, okubangela ukuntuleka okungajwayelekile kokushisa kwemizwa.

question: Kungani umuntu one-Cotard's Syndrome ekholelwa ngokuqinile ukuthi uyafela ngokomzimba, uyachitheka, noma akanawo amagciwane ngaphakathi?
options: Ukwehluleka okukhulu okuphindwe kabili kokucubungula imizwa yezinzwa kuhlanganiswa nokungaqondi kahle ngokuphelele kwengqondo nokudangala okukhulu okubangela ukuthi umuntu azizwe engapheli emhlabeni
Izinga lokushisa komzimba lehla laya ku-0 Celsius
correctAnswer: Ukwehluleka okukhulu okuphindwe kabili kokucubungula imizwa yezinzwa kuhlanganiswa nokungaqondi kahle ngokuphelele kwengqondo nokudangala okukhulu okubangela ukuthi umuntu azizwe engapheli emhlabeni
explanation: Umgomo we-Cotard umele ukuphela okukhulu kwe-Capgras: zonke izipiliyoni zenzwa zixhunywe ngokuphelele nokubaluleka kwemizwa, okuholela ekuzenzakaleni okungabikhona kobumnyama bokungabikho.

question: Umuntu ogulayo okuhlangenwe nakho ubuhlungu obukhulu besitho esisusiwe esandleni angathola kanjani ukukhululeka ngokushesha esebenzisa ibhokisi lesibuko lika V.S. Ramachandran?
options: Impendulo ebonakalayo yesandla esiphelele esibukweni ikhombisa ubuchopho bokunyakaza ukuthi kuphumule imisipha ebunjiwe yesitho esingekho
correctAnswer: Impendulo ebonakalayo yesandla esiphelele esibukweni ikhombisa ubuchopho bokunyakaza ukuthi kuphumule imisipha ebunjiwe yesitho esingekho
explanation: Imephu yokunyakaza yobuchopho iyaqhubeka ithumela imiqondo yokuziphendukela kumlenze owashiywe ngaphandle kokuthola impendulo yokuzwa. Ukubona isithombe esibukwayo 'sikhulula' ngokubonakalayo kuxazulula i-paralysis efundwe.

question: Kungani abantu abanalesi simo se-Synesthesia bezwa imibala ethile lapho belalela izingoma zomculo, noma izimnandi ezithile lapho befunda amazwi?

Izingane zezindlebe ziqukethe amapharamende okuzwa afihlakele

explanation: I-Synesthesia ivela ngenxa yokungapheleli kokuhlanza izinzwa phakathi nentuthuko yokuqala, kugcina ukuxhumana kokwakheka phakathi kwezindawo eziseduze (isb. indawo yemibala ye-V4 nendawo yama-grapheme).

question: Kungani iziguli ezine-Cortical Blindness (Blindsight) zingakhomba ngokunembile izibani ezihambayo egumbini ngenkathi bethembisa ukuthi babona ubumnyama obugcwele?
options: Izindlela zokubona ezingaphansi kweshukela (superior colliculus) zisebenza indawo ngokuzimela kwe-primary visual cortex (V1) engaguquki
correctAnswer: Izindlela zokubona ezingaphansi kweshukela (superior colliculus) zisebenza indawo ngokuzimela kwe-primary visual cortex (V1) engaguquki
explanation: Ukuvuvukala kwe-V1 kushabalalisa ukuqaphela ukubona, kodwa izindlela zakudala ze-retinotectal zidlula i-V1 ziya ngqo ebuchosheni obuphakathi, okuvumela ukuhamba kwegazi okungaqondi.

question: Kungani isiguli esine-Alien Hand Syndrome sithola isandla sabo sokunxele siguqa ishati kuyilapho isandla sabo sokudla sikhulula izinkinobho ngaphandle kokuvumelana kwengqondo yabo?

Amanethiwekhi ezinzwa engalweni akhula ubuchopho obuzimele
correctAnswer: Ukulimala kwe-corpus callosum noma i-medial frontal cortex kuhlukanisa izinhloso zomzimba phakathi kwezigaba, kukhiqiza ukuziphatha okuzimele okuqondiswe izinhloso emilenzeni
explanation: Ukuxhumana okuphakathi kwe-frontal supplementary motor areas nokuvinjelwa okuphambene kuvumela uhlangothi olulodwa ukuthi luqhube izindlela zomzimba ezifundwe ngaphandle kokuqaphela kolunye uhlangothi.

question: Ocwaningweni lwe-split-brain, lapho isithombe se-shovel yeqhwa sishiselwa kuphela kwicala elingakwesokudla elingakhulumi kanye ne-klaw yenkukhu kwicala elingakwesobunxele, kungani isandla sokunxele somguli sithatha i-shovel ngenkathi umlomo wakhe uthi uyithathe 'ukuhlanza izimpahla zenkukhu'?

correctAnswer: Icala lasekhohlo liyindlulamthi yokuchaza: liyadlala indaba ezingokoqobo ngemva kwesenzakalo ukuze lichaze izenzo ezenziwe ngaphandle kolwazi lwalo
explanation: UMichael Gazzaniga wathola 'umhumushi walecala lasekhohlo', i-module ehlanganisa izincazelo ezinengqondo zesikhathi esedlule zezenzo ezidalwe ama-module angaphansi kwe-subcortical noma aphukile.

question: Kungani isiguli esinesifo sokukhohlwa uClive Wearing singahlala esihlalweni sephiyano sidlale izingoma eziyinkimbinkimbi zikaBach ngokukhono okukhulu, kodwa sikhumbule ingxoxo eyenzeke imizuzwana eyi-10 edlule?
options: Umonakalo ku-hippocampus ubulala inkumbulo yokukhumbula izenzakalo, kuyilapho inkumbulo yokuhamba kwemisebenzi emzimbeni e-basali ganglia nasecerebellum ihlala iphelele ngokuphelele
Amathambo emisipha agcina amanothi omsindo womculo
Amapiyano akhipha amaza erediyo angezwa ngezandla
correctAnswer: Umonakalo ku-hippocampus ubulala inkumbulo yokukhumbula izenzakalo, kuyilapho inkumbulo yokuhamba kwemisebenzi emzimbeni e-basali ganglia nasecerebellum ihlala iphelele ngokuphelele
explanation: Inkumbulo ye-episodic (ukukhumbula izenzakalo neqiniso) incike ezakhiweni zesifunda sesikhathi esiphakathi nendawo, kanti inkumbulo yemoto yezinhlelo (amakhono afana nokudlala ipiyano) itholakala ku-cerebellum nakwi-striatum.

question: Lapho induku yensimbi yokucindezela yadlula ngokuphelele ekhanda lomsebenzi wesitimela uPhineas Gage ngo-1848, wahamba wakhuluma ngokushesha, kodwa abangane bakhe bamemezela ukuthi 'uGage akasenamanga uGage'. Kungani?
options: Ukubhujiswa kwe-ventromedial prefrontal cortex kwaphula ukulawulwa kwakhe kwemizwa, ukuqonda kwakhe kwezenzo ezinhle, nobuntu bakhe bokuphatha emphakathini
Amakhothikhodi akhe okuvula amazwi aba mabi
correctAnswer: Ukubhujiswa kwe-ventromedial prefrontal cortex kwaphula ukulawulwa kwakhe kwemizwa, ukuqonda kwakhe kwezenzo ezinhle, nobuntu bakhe bokuphatha emphakathini
explanation: UGage wanikeza ubufakazi bokuqala obuqinile bokuthi i-prefrontal cortex ilawula ukuhlela kwemisebenzi yokuphatha emphakathini, ukuvinjelwa kokuziphatha ngokweqile, kanye nokwahlulela okuhle kwezenzo ezinhle.

question: Kungani umuntu onomgogodla wakhe oxhunywe ngohlelo lokuhlinzwa (ubuchopho obuhlukaniswe) ehluleka ukubiza ngomlomo into ebekwe esandleni sakhe sokunxele ngesikhathi efihliwe amehlo?
options: Ukufakwa kolwazi ngensayo esandleni sokunxele kuhamba uye emqondweni wesobunxele, ongakwazi ukufinyelela ngqo esikhungweni sokukhuluma esiseceleni sobunxele

correctAnswer: Ukufakwa kolwazi ngensayo esandleni sokunxele kuhamba uye emqondweni wesobunxele, ongakwazi ukufinyelela ngqo esikhungweni sokukhuluma esiseceleni sobunxele
explanation: Ukuthinta esandleni sokunxele kuhamba uye ku-somatosensory cortex yesokudla. Njengoba izikhungo zokukhuluma (Broca/Wernicke) zitholakala kuphela kwelingxenye yesobunxele, umqondweni wesokudla ongekho ukubiza izinto ngomlomo awukwazi ukuveza into.

question: Kungani abafundi abanezempilo engqondweni abebeqokwe njengabaphathi eStanford Prison Experiment bashintsha ngokushesha baba nobudlova nokuhlukumeza (i-Lucifer Effect)?
options: Ukuphelelwa ubuntu nokulandela indima yesimo: okulindelwe kakhulu kohlelo nezimpawu zamandla enhlangano kudlula umoya wokuziphatha komuntu ngamunye
correctAnswer: Ukuphelelwa ubuntu nokulandela indima yesimo: okulindelwe kakhulu kohlelo nezimpawu zamandla enhlangano kudlula umoya wokuziphatha komuntu ngamunye
explanation: UPhilip Zimbardo wakhombisa ukuthi izimo kanye nezindima ezinikelwe enhlanganweni zisebenzisa ingcindezi enkulu, zisusa ukuzibophezela komuntu ngamunye ngokugqoka izimpahla, izibuko zelanga, kanye negunya eliphelele elingahlolwa.

question: Kungani u-Albert Einstein ebiza i-Quantum Entanglement ngokuthi 'isenzo esimangalisayo kude' ku-Paradox ye-EPR?
options: Ukukala i-athikili eyodwa exhumene ngokushesha kuthatha isimo se-quantum sesibili esixhumene nayo emhlabeni wonke ngaphandle kwezimpawu zomzimba
correctAnswer: Ukukala i-athikili eyodwa exhumene ngokushesha kuthatha isimo se-quantum sesibili esixhumene nayo emhlabeni wonke ngaphandle kwezimpawu zomzimba
explanation: U-Einstein, uPodolsky, noRosen baphikisana ukuthi i-realism yendawo kufanele ibekhona; nokho, izimo zokujikeleza ezixhumene zibonisa ukuhlobana kwe-quantum okungaqondi indawo ngokushesha.

question: Yini ifomula yezibalo kaJohn Bell kanye nezilingo zikaAlain Aspect ezifakazele ngayo ngobunjalo beqiniso lethu lezinto zomzimba?
options: I-uniiverse ayikwazi ukuba yendawo eseduze futhi eqinile ngasikhathi sinye; iziguquko ezifihliwe ezingendawo azilawuli imishini ye-quantum
correctAnswer: I-uniiverse ayikwazi ukuba yendawo eseduze futhi eqinile ngasikhathi sinye; iziguquko ezifihliwe ezingendawo azilawuli imishini ye-quantum
explanation: Ukungalingani kukaBell kubeka umkhawulo ophezulu wezibalo kunoma iyiphi ithiyori yeziguquko ezifihliwe ezindaweni. Ukwephulwa kokuhlolwa kufakazele ukuthi imvelo iveza ukuxhumana kwe-quantum okungendawo kweqiniso.

question: Iyini i-Quantum Zeno Effect, futhi kanjani ivimbela i-athikili engekho esimweni esizinzile yerediyokhtivu ukuthi ingabhujiswa?

correctAnswer: Ukuhlola nokubuka ohlelweni lwe-quantum njalo kuyaphinda kusethe umsebenzi walo we-wavefunction, okwenza kube sengathi umile esimweni sokuqala sawo
explanation: Ngoba amathuba okudlulisa isikhathi esifushane akhula kabili ngokwesikhashana (Delta t)^2, izilinganiso ezivamile zokuphrojektha zibuyisela uhlelo esimweni sawo esingakakhanyi esingakhonjiwe.

question: Ekuhlolweni kuka-John Archibald Wheeler kwe-Delayed-Choice, ukukhetha ukuthi ungalinganisa kanjani iphotoni njengamanje kubonakala kuthinta kanjani umlando wayo odlule eminyakeni eyizigidi eziyizinkulungwane ezimbili edlule?
options: Iphothoni ayitholi umlando ocacile odlule (indlela yamaza noma ye-pharticle) kuze kube ukukhethwa kokumiswa kokulinganisa okukhulu kokugcina
Iphothoni ihamba ibuye emuva ngesikhathi ngomzimba

Ama-lensi agcina ama-photoni ema-cavity amash kristalu
correctAnswer: Iphothoni ayitholi umlando ocacile odlule (indlela yamaza noma ye-pharticle) kuze kube ukukhethwa kokumiswa kokulinganisa okukhulu kokugcina
explanation: U-Wheeler wakhombisa ukuthi ama-photoni avela kuma-quasars akude agobelelwe yi-gravitational lensing ahlala esesimweni sokuhlanganiswa kwezindlela kuze kube yilapho isazi sezinkanyezi sikhetha ukuthi sifaka i-beam splitter namuhla.

question: Kuhlolweni lwe-Quantum Eraser, kwenzekani kumaphethini wokusangana lapho abacwaningi bebhubhisa noma bedida ulwazi lwe-'which-way' lwama-photon?
options: Ama-wave interference fringes aphinde avele ngokuphelele, kufakazela ukuthi ubuhlobo be-wave-particle bulawulwa ukutholakala kolwazi
correctAnswer: Ama-wave interference fringes aphinde avele ngokuphelele, kufakazela ukuthi ubuhlobo be-wave-particle bulawulwa ukutholakala kolwazi
explanation: Lapho ukuphakanyiswa komaki 'which-way' kususwa ngopholisa oluyi-diagonal ngaphambi kokutholwa, ukuhlangene kwe-quantum kuvumela amaphethini wokusangana kwe-wave ukuthi abuyiselwe ngokusebenzisa ukuhlangana.

question: Kungani kungenzeki ngokomzimba ukwakha umshini ophelele wokuphrinta i-quantum okopisha izimo ze-quantum ezingaziwa ngokungenamkhawulo (i-No-Cloning Theorem)?
options: Ukuqondana kwe-quantum unitary operators kuvimbela ukukopisha izimo zesuperposition ngaphandle kokulimaza noma ukuwa kwesimo sokuqala
Amalensi omshini wokuphrinta awanalo izinga elanele lokubona
Ama-molecule enkampani ansizi kakhulu nge-quantum spin
correctAnswer: Ukuqondana kwe-quantum unitary operators kuvimbela ukukopisha izimo zesuperposition ngaphandle kokulimaza noma ukuwa kwesimo sokuqala
explanation: U-Wootters, Zurek, no-Dieks bafakazele ukuthi i-operator unitary U ehambisana no-U(|psi>|0>) = |psi>|psi> ayinakusebenza kuzo zonke izimo zesuperposition |psi> = a|0> + b|1> ngenxa ye-linear quantum.

question: I-Quantum Teleportation idlulisa kanjani isimo esiqondile se-quantum se-photon endaweni ekude ngaphandle kokuthumela i-photon uqobo emkhathini?
options: Ngokusebenzisa iphini elihlanganyelwe elivuthiwe, ukwenza isilinganiso sesimo se-Bell, nokudlulisa ama-bits amabili esintu ukuze kwakhiwe kabusha isimo
correctAnswer: Ngokusebenzisa iphini elihlanganyelwe elivuthiwe, ukwenza isilinganiso sesimo se-Bell, nokudlulisa ama-bits amabili esintu ukuze kwakhiwe kabusha isimo
explanation: UBennett nabanye bakhombise ukuthi ukukala isimo esihlangene se-qubit yokufaka kanye nengxenye ye-EPR kuhlikihla kokubili, kuvumela otholayo ukuthi ajikele i-qubit ye-EPR yokunye ngokulandela imiyalelo yesintu.

question: Kungani u-Erwin Schrödinger ephakamisile umcabango wakhe owaziwayo ohilela ikati ebhokisini elivaliwe elinezinye izinto ezibulala abantu (Schrödinger's Cat)?
options: Ukuveza ububhali bokusebenzisa i-Copenhagen quantum superposition ezintweni ezibonakalayo zosuku nosuku
correctAnswer: Ukuveza ububhali bokusebenzisa i-Copenhagen quantum superposition ezintweni ezibonakalayo zosuku nosuku
explanation: USchrödinger wayecabanga le pharadesi njengokugxeka: uma incazelo ye-Copenhagen iqina ngaphandle komkhawulo, ikati elingabonwa umuntu elikhulu kumele libe lifile futhi liphile ngasikhathi sinye, okuphikisana nokuqonda komzimba.

question: Epharadeshi lika-Eugene Wigner elithi 'Umngani ka-Wigner', kungani ukuwa komsebenzi we-wave quantum kuba okuzimele futhi okuhlobene nombukeli?
options: Kumngane ongaphakathi elabhorethri isimo siwe lapho sikubona, kodwa kuWigner olindile ngaphandle, umngane nelabhorethri kuhlala kuse-superposition ehlangene
correctAnswer: Kumngane ongaphakathi elabhorethri isimo siwe lapho sikubona, kodwa kuWigner olindile ngaphandle, umngane nelabhorethri kuhlala kuse-superposition ehlangene
explanation: UWigner ukhombise ukuthi imishini ejwayelekile yaseCopenhagen ayinayo imngcele engokoqobo yokuwiswa: okungumphumela ocacile owehlisiwe kumhloli oyedwa kuyisimo esingakahlulwa esixhumene komunye.

question: Indlela i-'Many-Worlds Interpretation' ka-Hugh Everett esixazulula ngayo inkinga yokukala kwe-quantum ngaphandle kokufuna ukuwa komsebenzi we-wave:
options: Ukukalwa ngakunye kwe-quantum kuhlukanisa umhlaba waba yizigaba ezihlukene ezingaxhumani zomhlaba zimele yonke imiphumela engaba khona
correctAnswer: Ukukalwa ngakunye kwe-quantum kuhlukanisa umhlaba waba yizigaba ezihlukene ezingaxhumani zomhlaba zimele yonke imiphumela engaba khona
explanation: UEverett waphakamisela ukuthuthukiswa kwe-pure unitary Schrödinger: esikhundleni sokuwa komsebenzi we-wave, umsebenzi we-wave womhlaba wonke uqhubeka uhlukanisa, ufeza wonke amathuba we-quantum angaxhumani ezindaweni eziphindaphindwayo.

question: Kungani izinto ezinkulu njengamamesele nezimoto zingakaze zibonise ukuphazamiseka kwamagagasi we-quantum empilweni yansuku zonke yabantu (Quantum Decoherence)?
options: Izigidigidi zokushayisana okungapheli nezibani zemvelo ezizungezile namamolekyuli omoya zibhubhisa ngokushesha ukuvumelana kwesigaba se-quantum
Izinto ezinkulu zibonisa imali ye-magnetic eningi kakhulu
Amandla adonsela phansi afudumeza izinto kuze kube yilapho amaza encibilika
correctAnswer: Izigidigidi zokushayisana okungapheli nezibani zemvelo ezizungezile namamolekyuli omoya zibhubhisa ngokushesha ukuvumelana kwesigaba se-quantum
explanation: Itheory ye-quantum decoherence (Zurek, Zeh) ikhombisa ukuthi ukusebenzisana namabhafu okushisa aphakathi nemvelo kukhipha ulwazi lwezigaba ezikhathini ezingama-10^-20 imizuzwana, kuphoqa imatrix yobuningi ukuba iveze amathuba avamile.

question: Ku-Aharonov-Bohm Effect, kanjani i-beam ye-elekthroni ingashintsha isigaba sayo somsakazo we-quantum lapho ihamba endaweni lapho inkambu kagesi ilawula iphume ngokuphelele?
options: I-elekthroni ixhumana ngqo ne-vector potential kagesi A, engahlali ingenalutho ngaphandle kwenkambu kagesi esivalwe
correctAnswer: I-elekthroni ixhumana ngqo ne-vector potential kagesi A, engahlali ingenalutho ngaphandle kwenkambu kagesi esivalwe
explanation: Ngisho noma inkambu kagesi B = curl(A) = 0, i-vector potential kagesi A endleleni ye-elekthroni inika ushintsho lwesigaba olungekho ngaphansi kwe-gauge olulingana nokugeleza kagesi okuvalwe.

question: Kungani ukumelana kwe-Hall ku-Quantum Hall Effect kulinganiswa ngokunembile kakhulu kwezibalo kuze kube sezikhuphukeni eziqondile ze-h / (n * e^2)?
options: Ama-topological invariants (amanani e-Chern) avikela iziteshi zokuhambisa eziseceleni kwe-chiral kukho konke ukungcola kanye nokungafaneleki komumo
I-nitrojeni yamanzi eqandayo ipholisa amaphutha wesikhumba se-copper
correctAnswer: Ama-topological invariants (amanani e-Chern) avikela iziteshi zokuhambisa eziseceleni kwe-chiral kukho konke ukungcola kanye nokungafaneleki komumo
explanation: UThouless, uKohmoto, uNightingale, no den Nijs (TKNN) bakhombise ukuthi ukuhamba kwe-Hall kuhlobene ngqo nenani lokuqala le-Chern, inani le-topological elingathintwa yizinguquko eziqhubekayo nokungabi nemephu.

question: Yiziphi izinhlayiya ezingajwayelekile eziphuma ku-Fractional Quantum Hall Effect eziphethe ugesi ongaphelele we-1/3 noma i-1/5 ye-elekthroni?
options: Ama-Anyons: ukujwayela kwesiphetho sobukhulu okuqoqiwe okwakhiwa ngama-elekthroni aboshwe emivuthwandleni yokugeleza kwe-magnetic esunguliwe
correctAnswer: Ama-Anyons: ukujwayela kwesiphetho sobukhulu okuqoqiwe okwakhiwa ngama-elekthroni aboshwe emivuthwandleni yokugeleza kwe-magnetic esunguliwe
explanation: URobert Laughlin wachaza ukuthi ukuhlobana kwama-elekthroni ku-2D ngaphansi kwezinkambu zikamagnethi ezinzima kudala ama-quasiparticles aqoqekayo anokushaja okungaphelele e/3 kanye nezibalo zokuphendukisa ezingaphelele (ama-anyons).

question: Kwenzekani lapho igesi ye-rubidium ehlanjululwe iphonsa ukufudumala ibe ngaphansi kwezigidi ezincane zedegree ngaphezu kwalokho okungu-zero okuphelele ukuze kwakheke i-Bose-Einstein Condensate (BEC)?
options: Amazinga e-atomic de Broglie afana, okubangela ukuthi izigidi zama-athomu wehle esigabeni esiphansi kakhulu se-quantum futhi zenze njengendlela eyodwa enkulu ye-super-atom
Ama-athomu egesi akhula abe yi-dayimane eqinile
correctAnswer: Amazinga e-atomic de Broglie afana, okubangela ukuthi izigidi zama-athomu wehle esigabeni esiphansi kakhulu se-quantum futhi zenze njengendlela eyodwa enkulu ye-super-atom
explanation: Lapho i-thermal de Broglie wavelength lambda_dB idlula ubude phakathi kwama-athomu, ama-bosons angene ekusetshenzisweni kwesimo esiphansi esikhulu, kwakha i-wavefunction eyodwa ebonakalayo enkulu.

question: Kungani i-supercurrent ihamba ngokuqhubekayo phezu kwebhuleki elincane elivimbela phakathi kwezinto ezimbili ezihamba ngogesi ngaphandle kokufakwa kwe-voltage (i-DC Josephson Effect)?
options: Ama-Cooper pairs ama-electron adlula ngokuhlanganyela ngokwe-quantum ngebhuleki ngenxa yokwehluka kwezigaba ezinkulu
correctAnswer: Ama-Cooper pairs ama-electron adlula ngokuhlanganyela ngokwe-quantum ngebhuleki ngenxa yokwehluka kwezigaba ezinkulu
explanation: UBrian Josephson wabikezela ukuthi ukuvumelana kwesigaba esikhulu phezu kwebhuleki kuvumela ama-Cooper pairs ukuthi adlule ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa: I = I_c * sin(Delta phi).

question: Indlela i-athomu ye-alpha engaphunyuka ngayo emugqeni omkhulu wombane we-Coulomb webhuloho lenayukliya uma amandla ayo e-kinetic ephansi kakhulu kunezamandla adingekayo ukuphunyuka?
options: Ukuqubuka kwe-Quantum: umsebenzi we-wave we-athomu ye-alpha wandisa ngaphesheya komgoqo ongaguquki wamanani, okuvumela amathuba okuphuma angabi nane-zero
correctAnswer: Ukuqubuka kwe-Quantum: umsebenzi we-wave we-athomu ye-alpha wandisa ngaphesheya komgoqo ongaguquki wamanani, okuvumela amathuba okuphuma angabi nane-zero
explanation: UGeorge Gamow wacacisa ukuwohloka kwe-alpha ngokusebenzisa ukuqubuka kwe-quantum: isilinganiso sokudlulisela T ~ exp(-2 * integral(sqrt(2m(V - E))) dx) sivumela ukuphunyuka nakuba E < V_coulomb.

question: Kungani ukutholakala kukaStephen Hawking kweHawking Radiation kuholela ku-'Black Hole Information Paradox' ejulile?
options: Ukukhanya okushisayo akulethisi lutho olunolwazi ngento edliwayo, okusho ukuthi ukuwohloka ngokuphelele kungaphula umthetho we-quantum unitarity
correctAnswer: Ukukhanya okushisayo akulethisi lutho olunolwazi ngento edliwayo, okusho ukuthi ukuwohloka ngokuphelele kungaphula umthetho we-quantum unitarity
explanation: I-quantum mechanics icacisa ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwesimo se-quantum kufanele kube ngokuqinile unitarity (ulwazi lugcinwa). Ukuwohloka okuphelele kwezimbobo ezimnyama kube ukukhanya okushisayo kungaguqula izimo ezihlanzekile zibe izimo ezixubekile, kubhubhise ulwazi.

question: Yiliphi igama eliyingqayizivele lomkhakha wesayensi yezinkanyezi eliphakanyiswa yiHolographic Principle (ukuhambisana kwe-AdS/CFT)?
options: Wonke amaphenomena emzimbeni ezenzeka ngaphakathi kobukhulu be-3D besikhala nesikhathi angachazwa ngokwezibalo emngceleni wawo ophandle we-2D
correctAnswer: Wonke amaphenomena emzimbeni ezenzeka ngaphakathi kobukhulu be-3D besikhala nesikhathi angachazwa ngokwezibalo emngceleni wawo ophandle we-2D
explanation: U-Gerard 't Hooft, u-Leonard Susskind, no-Juan Maldacena babonise ukuthi amandla ezinto eziyi-quantum ku-Anti-de Sitter bulk ahambisana ne-conformal field theory ophahleni laso, okukala i-entropy ngobubanzi besikhala.

question: Ingabe kanjani isizwe esithuthukile singase sicabange ngokwe-theoretical sithole amandla ahlanzekile esuka ku-Kerr emnyama egijima (Inqubo kaPenrose)?
options: Ngokwehlisa into ku-ergosphere ehlukanayo, ithumele amandla amabi ngaphakathi kwegiladi ngenkathi enye ingxenye iphunyuka namandla amathile
Ngokukhanyisa izibuko ezinkulu ukuvezela umhlaba wonke
correctAnswer: Ngokwehlisa into ku-ergosphere ehlukanayo, ithumele amandla amabi ngaphakathi kwegiladi ngenkathi enye ingxenye iphunyuka namandla amathile
explanation: URoger Penrose wakhombisa ukuthi ngaphakathi kwe-ergosphere (ngaphandle kwe-event horizon), ukuhambisa izindilinga kuvumela izindiza zamandla amabi maqondana nokungenamkhawulo, kunciphisa ukujikeleza kwe-black hole futhi kukhuphule amandla emigqomo ekhayeni.

question: Kungani iwashi le-athomu elifakwe phezulu entabeni ephakeme lishayela ngokushesha okubonakalayo kuneiwashi le-athomu elifana nalo elisezingeni lolwandle (Ukudonsa kwesikhathi ngenxa kwamandla adonsela phansi)?
options: Amasimu anamandla okudonsa phansi aphansi ezindaweni eziphansi andisa isikhathi uma kuqhathaniswa namasimu awenangqondo aphezulu
Umoya wentaba unezinga eliphansi lokucindezela komoya
Izibani zasezulwini zinikela amandla kumangqamuzana e-cesium
Iwashi lentaba lihamba ngokushesha endaweni yesikhala
correctAnswer: Amasimu anamandla okudonsa phansi aphansi ezindaweni eziphansi andisa isikhathi uma kuqhathaniswa namasimu awenangqondo aphezulu
explanation: U-Einstein's General Relativity uthi amawashi asemandla adonsela phansi ajulile asebenza kancane: t_0 = t_f * sqrt(1 - 2GM / (rc^2)). Ucwaningo luka-Pound-Rebka luqinisekise le nguquko ngokunembile.

question: Uhlelo lokuhlola lwe-NASA lwe-Gravity Probe B luqinisekisile kanjani ngokomzimba umphumela we-'Frame-Dragging' (Lense-Thirring) owabikezelwa yi-General Relativity ka-Einstein?
options: Ngokulinganisa ukugeleza okuncane kwe-gyroscope okubangelwa umhlaba ukutshela indwangu yesikhathi nolwazi lwesikhala ngokuzungezisa kwawo
Ngokulinganisa isikhathi sokukhanya kwe-laser okuthunyelwe eNyanga
Ngokubuka ukuthi izibani zelanga zigoba kanjani
correctAnswer: Ngokulinganisa ukugeleza okuncane kwe-gyroscope okubangelwa umhlaba ukutshela indwangu yesikhathi nolwazi lwesikhala ngokuzungezisa kwawo
explanation: Isisindo esijikeleza sidonsa isikhathi nolwazi lwesikhala ukuzungeza sona njengoshizi oxutshwe ngesipuni. I-Gravity Probe B's ultra-precision superconducting gyroscopes ilinganise ukuhamba kwesigaba sokudonsa kweMhlaba esingu-37 milliarcseconds ngonyaka.

question: U-LIGO wathola kanjani amaza adonsela phansi akhishwe amahole amnyama amabili exubene eminyakeni eyizigidigidi eziyi-1.3 ekude ngesibani somkhathi ngo-2015?
options: Ngokuthola ukushintshwa kokuphazamiseka kwe-laser okuncane okungaphansi kwe-1/10,000 kobubanzi be-protoni emacksoni angama-kilomitha angu-4 ema-vacuum
correctAnswer: Ngokuthola ukushintshwa kokuphazamiseka kwe-laser okuncane okungaphansi kwe-1/10,000 kobubanzi be-protoni emacksoni angama-kilomitha angu-4 ema-vacuum
explanation: Amaza adonsela phansi aguqula izilinganiso zendawo (Delta L / L ~ 10^-21). Izixazululo ze-Michelson ze-LIGO zathola lo mgudu wezilinganiso ngokukala umehluko wezigaba phakathi kocingo lwe-laser olwahlukaniswe okukodwa ngokumelene.

question: Kungani Inkinga Ye-Cosmological Constant ibhekwa njengokuhumusha okubi kakhulu kwe-theoretical emlandweni we-physics?
options: I-quantum field theory ibikezela ukudlula kwamandla okungenalutho kwesibalo esilingana cishe nama-120 orders of magnitude kunalokho okubonwe empeleni
Izinga lokwanda lidlula isivinini sokukhanya ngokungapheli
correctAnswer: I-quantum field theory ibikezela ukudlula kwamandla okungenalutho kwesibalo esilingana cishe nama-120 orders of magnitude kunalokho okubonwe empeleni
explanation: Ukuhlanganisa amandla angenalutho e-quantum zero-point kuze kufike esikalini se-Planck kunikeza rho_vac ~ 10^112 erg/cm^3, kanti ukubona kwezinkanyezi kukala rho_lambda ~ 10^-8 erg/cm^3, umehluko we-10^120.

question: Uhlobo LweCosmic Inflation luka-Alan Guth luxazulule kanjani 'Inkinga YeHorizon' yeCosmic Microwave Background (CMB)?
options: Ukudubula okuncane kokukhula kwe-exponential kwandise isifunda esincane esixhumene ngendlela yokubangela esimisweni sokushisa kuwonke wonke umkhathi obonakalayo.
Amafoton adlula kuwo wonke umkhathi ngezivinini ezingapheli.
correctAnswer: Ukudubula okuncane kokukhula kwe-exponential kwandise isifunda esincane esixhumene ngendlela yokubangela esimisweni sokushisa kuwonke wonke umkhathi obonakalayo.
explanation: Ohlangothini oluphambene lomkhathi banezinga lokushisa elifanayo (2.725 K) kodwa namuhla abakaxhumani ngendlela yokubangela. I-Cosmic inflation ichaza ukuthi babelana ngesimo sokushisa ngaphambi kokuthi bandiswe ngokuphindwe ngo-10^26.

question: Enkinga ye-Baryon Asymmetry, kungani umhlaba wethu wakhiwe cishe ngokuphelele yimatter kunokulingana phakathi kwesibindi nematter?
options: Izimo zikaSakharov: ukuphulwa kwe-CP, ukuphulwa kwesibalo se-baryon, nokuphuma ekuvumelaniseni okushisayo kwakuthanda kakhulu ukwanda okuncane kwematter (1 kwabangu-bili)
I-Antimatter inomthwalo ophikisana nomthwalo wenhlangano futhi yawela
correctAnswer: Izimo zikaSakharov: ukuphulwa kwe-CP, ukuphulwa kwesibalo se-baryon, nokuphuma ekuvumelaniseni okushisayo kwakuthanda kakhulu ukwanda okuncane kwematter (1 kwabangu-bili)
explanation: Ngesikhathi sokudala i-baryogenesis ekuqaleni, kuzo zonke izingxenye eziyi-1,000,000,000 ze-antimatter ezabhujiswa nematter, izingxenye eziyi-1,000,000,001 zematter zakhiwa, zishiya ngemuva i-matter esele eyakha izinkanyezi zethu.

question: Kungani i-Bullet Cluster (1E 0657-56) ijabulela kakhulu njengobufakazi obuqinile bokuba khona kwento engabonakali i-Dark Matter?
options: Ukulenzwa kwe-gravitational kukhombisa ukuthi isisindo esiphakathi sahlukana negesi eshisa kakhulu ekhipha i-X-ray phakathi kwamagalaxi ngemva kokushayisana komkhathi
Izinto ezimnyama zikhipha ukukhanya okuluhlaza okukhazimulayo
correctAnswer: Ukulenzwa kwe-gravitational kukhombisa ukuthi isisindo esiphakathi sahlukana negesi eshisa kakhulu ekhipha i-X-ray phakathi kwamagalaxi ngemva kokushayisana komkhathi
explanation: Lapho amaqembu amabili ehlangana, igesi evamile ye-baryonic yahlangabezana nokudonswa kukagesi futhi yema maphakathi nendawo, kanti izinto ezimnyama ezingenawo ukushayisana zadlula zingaphazanyiswa, ziphethe isisindo esikhulu sokudonswa komhlaba.

question: Abacwaningi bezinkanyezi abasebenzisa i-Type Ia supernovae ngo-1998 baphetha kanjani ukuthi ukunwetshwa kwezulu akunciphi, kodwa empeleni kuyashesha?
options: Ama-Type Ia supernovae akude ayebabuthakathaka futhi embi kakhulu kunalokho okwakulindelwe eMhlabeni owayehamba kancane, oqhutshwa yi-Dark Energy
Uthuli lwezulu lwenza izinkanyezi ziguquke zibe mnyama ophuzi
correctAnswer: Ama-Type Ia supernovae akude ayebabuthakathaka futhi embi kakhulu kunalokho okwakulindelwe eMhlabeni owayehamba kancane, oqhutshwa yi-Dark Energy
explanation: U-Perlmutter, u-Riess, no-Schmidt bakala amakhandlela ajwayelekile (i-Type Ia supernovae). Ukukhanyiselwa kwawo okungaphansi Kokubonakala ezingeni eliphezulu le-redshift z kufakazela ukuthi izulu belisheshayo eminyakeni eyizigidigidi ezi-5 edlule.

question: Kungani inyanga ezungeza eduze kakhulu nephlanethi yayo yokusingqongileyo yaphuka yaba uhlelo lwamasongo wezinsalela zamatshe (Umkhawulo weRoche)?
options: Amandla edonsela phansi olwandle adlulisa umkhathi weplanethi ephathelene kudlula ukuzibamba ngokwakho komkhathi wenyanga
Izinkambu zikagesi ziyaphikisa inhliziyo yensimbi yenyanga
correctAnswer: Amandla edonsela phansi olwandle adlulisa umkhathi weplanethi ephathelene kudlula ukuzibamba ngokwakho komkhathi wenyanga
explanation: Amandla ahlukene okudonsela phansi kulo lonke ububanzi benyanga aphumelela phezu kwamandla ayo okuzibamba ngezifiso: d = R_planet * (2 * rho_planet / rho_moon)^(1/3), okuhlanganisa kube izindandatho zomhlaba.

question: Yiphi into ye-quantum evimbela inkanyezi emhlophe ye-dwarf ekuwohlokeni ngaphansi komthamo wayo omkhulu wezulu ufike ku-1.44 amasosha elanga (Umkhawulo kaChandrasekhar)?
options: Ingcindezi yokwehliswa kwama-electron okubangelwa yiPauli Exclusion Principle
correctAnswer: Ingcindezi yokwehliswa kwama-electron okubangelwa yiPauli Exclusion Principle
explanation: Ama-electron awakwazi ukuhlala ezimweni ze-quantum ezifana. Ukucindezela ama-electron kudala ingcindezi ye-quantum degeneracy. Ngaphezu kuka-1.44 M_sun, ama-electron aba yi-ultra-relativistic futhi awakwazi ukumelana nokuwela komhlaba obangelwa ukhulu.

question: Kwenzekani enkanyezini eshonayo lapho ubukhulu bayo bedlula umkhawulo we-Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff (TOV) cishe u-2.17 imandla elanga?
options: Ukucindezelwa kwe-neutron degeneracy kuwela phansi, okubangela ukuthi inhliziyo ihlale ingena ebumnyameni bemass black hole yesintela
Ibuyela emuva ibe yinkanyezi ebomvu ekhula
correctAnswer: Ukucindezelwa kwe-neutron degeneracy kuwela phansi, okubangela ukuthi inhliziyo ihlale ingena ebumnyameni bemass black hole yesintela
explanation: Ngenkathi izinkanyezi ze-neutron zixhaswa ukucindezelwa kwe-neutron degeneracy nokuphikisana okunamandla kwezomele nuclear, ukudlula umkhawulo we-TOV (~2.17 M_sun) akushiyi amandla omzimba owaziwayo okuvimbela ukuwa ukuya ku-singularity.

question: Kungani ama-pulsar ajikeleza ngokuvamile ehamba ngezikhathi ezithile enza "iziphazamiso" ezinzima lapho isivinini sawo sokujikeleza sishesha ngokuzumayo?
options: Ama-vortices e-superfluid ngaphakathi kwengqimba yangaphakathi ye-neutron star akhululwa futhi adlulisele umuzwa wokujikeleza ku-crust eqinile
correctAnswer: Ama-vortices e-superfluid ngaphakathi kwengqimba yangaphakathi ye-neutron star akhululwa futhi adlulisele umuzwa wokujikeleza ku-crust eqinile
explanation: Ingqimba yangaphakathi ye-superfluid inama-vortices ayizigidigidi aseqiniswa kumalattice enukleya. Lapho i-crust icishe kancane ngenxa yokukhanya, ukucindezela kwakha kuze kube ama-vortices akhululwa ngokungalindelekile, asheshise i-crust.

question: Kwenzekani lapho 'i-starquake' ikhihliza ungqimba lwensimbi oluqinile kakhulu lweMagnetar enensimu kagesi engu-10^11 Tesla?
options: Iphonsa ukuqhuma okukhulu kwe-gamma rays ne-X-rays okungaphazamisa i-ionosphere yaseMhlabeni esengceleni ezinkulungwaneni zeminyaka yokukhanya kude
correctAnswer: Iphonsa ukuqhuma okukhulu kwe-gamma rays ne-X-rays okungaphazamisa i-ionosphere yaseMhlabeni esengceleni ezinkulungwaneni zeminyaka yokukhanya kude
explanation: I-crack engu-millimeter engu-1 enqolobaneni ye-magnetar igoba imigqa yensimu kagesi, ikhulula amajoule angu-10^39 wamandla. Ngo-2004, i-flare evela ku-SGR 1806-20 (ekude neminyaka yokukhanya engu-50,000) yenza i-atmosphere yaseMhlabeni ibe ne-ionized.

question: Kungani ama-relativistic astrophysical jets aqhumayo avela ezindongeni ezinkulu ezingama-black holes ezinkulu ezibukeka ehamba esibhakabhakeni ngesivinini esidlula esikhanyeni (Ukunyakaza Okubonakalayo Okungaphezu Kwezinga Lokukhanya)?
options: Ubungozi bokubuka be-optical obudalwe yi-jet esondela eMhlabeni cishe ngesivinini sokukhanya, ilandelela ama-photons ayo akhishwe yona
Ama-athikili e-Tachyon adlula isivinini sokukhanya endaweni engaphezulu komoya
correctAnswer: Ubungozi bokubuka be-optical obudalwe yi-jet esondela eMhlabeni cishe ngesivinini sokukhanya, ilandelela ama-photons ayo akhishwe yona
explanation: Uma i-jet ihamba nge-engeli theta eduze kuka-0 kumugqa wethu wokubuka ku-v ~ c, umehluko wesikhathi phakathi kwamaphulasi atholwe Delta t_obs = Delta t * (1 - beta * cos theta) uncishiswa kakhulu, okwenza i-v_app ibonakale > c.

question: Kungani i-relativistic beaming yenza i-jet yezinkanyezi ebheka ngqo eMhlabeni ibonakale ikhanya izikhathi ezingu-1,000 kune-jet efanayo ebheke kude?
options: Izinguquko zeLorentz zigxila ekukhipheni amafothoni zibe ikhona eliqinile elibheke phambili futhi zishintsha imvamisa zibe yibhulueru (ukukhuthazwa kweDoppler)
Amandla adonsela phansi akhuphula ikhoni esondela
correctAnswer: Izinguquko zeLorentz zigxila ekukhipheni amafothoni zibe ikhona eliqinile elibheke phambili futhi zishintsha imvamisa zibe yibhulueru (ukukhuthazwa kweDoppler)
explanation: Ngenxa yokuphambuka kwe-relativistic kanye nokushintsha kwe-Doppler, ukuminyana kokukhanya okubhekiwe kukhula njenge S_obs = S_0 * delta^(3 + alpha), kukhuphula imisebe iye komubukeli kuyilapho kwehlisa i-jet ehambele kude.

question: Kungani ama-muons amancane adalwe ama-ray e-cosmic phezulu emkhathini efinyelela kumadivayisi aphesheya ngenani elikhulu yize enesikhathi sokuphila kuphela esimiswe ku-2.2 microseconds?
options: I-Relativity Ekhethekile: ukwelula kwesikhathi kwehlisa iwashi langaphakathi le-muon kanti ukufitshana kobude kunciphisa ibanga lomoya kusukela embonweni we-muon
Ama-muons ahamba phansi ngokulandela imigqa yensimu kazibuthe
Ama-ray e-cosmic aphonsa ama-muons phansi njengomoya
correctAnswer: I-Relativity Ekhethekile: ukwelula kwesikhathi kwehlisa iwashi langaphakathi le-muon kanti ukufitshana kobude kunciphisa ibanga lomoya kusukela embonweni we-muon
explanation: Ngokushesha okungu v = 0.9997c, i-gamma ~ 40. Embonweni lomhlaba, i-muon iphila izikhathi ezingama-40 isikhathi eside (~88 microseconds); embonweni we-muon, umoya ongu-10-kilomitha uphishekela ku-250 meters.

question: Ku-Twin Paradox ye-Special Relativity, kungani umzalwane osendleleni wendlwana engcono kunomzalwane ohleli eMhlabeni lapho ebuya?
options: Umlingani ohambayo ubone ukuqina komzimba nokujika, okuqhekeka ubulungiswa be-inertial frame nokushintsha izinkomba zokubuka
Ukuhamba esikhala kupholisa amaseli omzimba womuntu
correctAnswer: Umlingani ohambayo ubone ukuqina komzimba nokujika, okuqhekeka ubulungiswa be-inertial frame nokushintsha izinkomba zokubuka
explanation: Umlingani ohambayo ushintsha izikhala ze-inertial lapho echithisa ijubane nokuhlehla ukuze abuyele emuva. Ukungalingani komugqa wesikhathi nezikhala zomhlaba kushaya isikhathi esifanele esifushane.

question: KuLadder Paradox (Barn-Pole Paradox), ingabe ilebula ye-20-mitha esheshayo ededela eduze kwesivinini sokukhanya ingangeniswa ngokuphelele ebharnini elingu-10-mitha kuwonke amangqamuzana avaliwe ngesikhathi esisodwa?
options: Yebo kumjikelezo webharn ngenxa yokuncipha kwe-Lorentz, kodwa cha kumjikelezo welebula lapho ukuvalwa kweminyango kungahambisani ngesikhathi
Cha, ilebula iyadabula uma ithinta umoya
Yebo, iminyango ibamba ukukhanya ngaphakathi kwezibuko
correctAnswer: Yebo kumjikelezo webharn ngenxa yokuncipha kwe-Lorentz, kodwa cha kumjikelezo welebula lapho ukuvalwa kweminyango kungahambisani ngesikhathi
explanation: Ubuhlobo bokuhambisana kwesikhathi: ebharnini, ilebula iyancipha iye kumamitha angu-8 futhi womabili iminyango uvala ngesikhathi esisodwa. Elebula, iminyango uvala ngezikhathi ezihlukene.

question: Kwi-Bell's Spaceship Paradox, izikhala ezimbili ezifanayo zisheshisa ngokufanayo futhi kukhona intambo ebuthakathaka exhunywe phakathi kwazo. Kungani intambo iphuka?
options: Ibanga phakathi kwezikhala liyanda kumafreyimu wazo wokuphumula okusheshayo, kanti intambo iyancipha ngenxa yokwehla kwe-Lorentz
correctAnswer: Ibanga phakathi kwezikhala liyanda kumafreyimu wazo wokuphumula okusheshayo, kanti intambo iyancipha ngenxa yokwehla kwe-Lorentz
explanation: Kumfutho wokwethulwa, ibanga liba njalo, kodwa intambo izama ukuncipha ngenxa ye-Lorentz. Kumfutho wezikhala, ukuvumelana kwesikhathi kwe-relativistic kubangela ukuthi isikhala esiholayo sisheshise ngaphambi kwesikhathi, sikhulise futhi saphule intambo.

question: Yisiphi isimangalo uPaul Ehrenfest asithola mayelana ne-geometry yesikhala somjikelezo oqinile ojikeleza ngokushesha ku-Special Relativity?
options: I-circumference yangaphandle ye-Lorentz-iyancipha kuyilapho i-radius yebanga inganciphi, kufakazela ukuthi izinto eziqinile azikwazi ukuba khona ku-relativity
correctAnswer: I-circumference yangaphandle ye-Lorentz-iyancipha kuyilapho i-radius yebanga inganciphi, kufakazela ukuthi izinto eziqinile azikwazi ukuba khona ku-relativity
explanation: Ngoba ukuhamba okukhemisi kudala ukuncipha kobude ngaphalongi kwe-circumference (2*pi*r < ejwayelekile) kuyilapho i-radius r ime qeda endleleni futhi ayithinteki, i-geometry yesikhala iba non-Euclidean.

question: NgokweMphumela ka-Unruh, yini umhloli osheshisa edlula egumbini elingenalutho le-quantum aqaphela esikhundleni sokuba isikhala esibandayo esingenalutho?
options: Ibha yokushisa efudumele yokukhishwa komzimba omnyama enezinga lokushisa elilingana nokushesha kwabo ngokomzimba
Ukukhanya okuhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okubangelwa umthwalo wamandla adonsela phansi
correctAnswer: Ibha yokushisa efudumele yokukhishwa komzimba omnyama enezinga lokushisa elilingana nokushesha kwabo ngokomzimba
explanation: UWilliam Unruh wakhombisa ukuthi isitholi esisheshayo sihlangabezana nomkhawulo we-Rindler. Ukushintsha kosikompilo kufana namaseli angempela okushisa ngezinga lokushisa T = hbar * a / (2 * pi * c * k_B).

question: Yisiphi isimiso esiyisisekelo u-Albert Einstein asikhulumayo njengokuthi 'umcabango ojabulisa kakhulu empilweni yami' (i-Equivalence Principle)?
options: Umhloli owehla ngokukhululeka endaweni yomhlaba oyibamba uthola isisindo esingu-zero, okwenza umhlaba kuwubunzima bendawo ungabonakali ekuqhamukeni okuvamile
correctAnswer: Umhloli owehla ngokukhululeka endaweni yomhlaba oyibamba uthola isisindo esingu-zero, okwenza umhlaba kuwubunzima bendawo ungabonakali ekuqhamukeni okuvamile
explanation: Ngaphakathi kwebhokisi evaliwe, akukho ukuhlolwa kwendawo okungahlukanisa phakathi kokuma ngaphansi komhlaba noma ukusheshiswa ngo-9.8 m/s^2 endaweni engenalutho, kuhambisana nomhlaba nomumo wesikhala esijikajikayo.

question: Kungani isignali ye-radar ekhuphuka kuVenus ithatha imizuzwana embalwa emikhulu ukuyobuya uma idlula eduze komhlaba weLanga (i-Shapiro Delay)?
options: Isisindo esikhulu seLanga sigoba futhi sandise isikhala nesikhathi, sandise ubude bemigwaqo yesiginali yokukhanya
Umphefumulo welanga ushaya indlebe ye-radar emuva
correctAnswer: Isisindo esikhulu seLanga sigoba futhi sandise isikhala nesikhathi, sandise ubude bemigwaqo yesiginali yokukhanya
explanation: U-Irwin Shapiro waphakamisa ukuhlolwa kwesine kwe-General Relativity: ukudlulisa ama-photon nge-geometry yesikhala nesikhathi esigobile eduze kwesisindo kulethela ukubambezeleka kwesikhathi kwe-logarithmic.

question: Iyiphi imikhawulo ephezulu yezibalo ekuthwaleni ulwazi lomzimba echazwe yiBekenstein Bound?
options: Ubuningi obukhulu kakhulu be-entropy noma ulwazi olungagcinwa endaweni encane yesikhala ene-energi emincane
Isikhala esikhulu kakhulu se-hard drive esidayiswa ezitolo
correctAnswer: Ubuningi obukhulu kakhulu be-entropy noma ulwazi olungagcinwa endaweni encane yesikhala ene-energi emincane
explanation: UJacob Bekenstein wathola ukuthi S <= 2 * pi * k * R * E / (hbar * c). Ukudlula kule mikhawulo kungavumela umuntu ukwephula Umthetho Wesibili weThermodynamics ngokudonsela ulwazi ngaphakathi koMthunzi omnyama.

question: Kungani ingxenye edlula ekugobeleni kwama-quantum ingaveza sengathi idlula isithiyo ngokushesha okwedlula ukukhanya (iHartman Effect)?
options: Ukubambezeleka kweqembu kuba ngokuzimela kwithikithi lesithiyo esibanzi, okubangela iphiko lewave ukuphuma ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngokuguqulwa kwewave
correctAnswer: Ukubambezeleka kweqembu kuba ngokuzimela kwithikithi lesithiyo esibanzi, okubangela iphiko lewave ukuphuma ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngokuguqulwa kwewave
explanation: UThomas Hartman wakhombisa ngo-1962 ukuthi isikhathi sokudlula ngesikhala sithatha isikhathi esilinganayo njengoba ukujiya kukhula. Iphakethe eliphuma alihambi ngokushesha okwedlula ukukhanya, kodwa liyingxenye ephucuziwe neyashintshwe yokuhamba ngaphambili.

question: Kungani i-electron edutshulwe phakathi kwamapleyiti amabili alinganayo angabonakali ibona izinga lokukhishwa okuzimele kushintshile (Umphumela kaPurcell)?
options: Ukuguqula ubukhulu bamaseli kagesi emhlabeni eduze kwe-athomu kusheshisa ngqo noma kunciphisa izinga lalo lokukhishwa kwemitha.
correctAnswer: Ukuguqula ubukhulu bamaseli kagesi emhlabeni eduze kwe-athomu kusheshisa ngqo noma kunciphisa izinga lalo lokukhishwa kwemitha.
explanation: U-Edward Purcell wathola ukuthi ukukhishwa okuzimele akuyona impahla ye-athomu, kodwa kuncike ekuxhumeneni kwe-athomu nesikhethu: F_p = 3/(4*pi^2) * (lambda/n)^3 * (Q/V).

question: Indlela i-photon eyodwa engahlukaniswa ngekhaladi enesiliva engaphuma kuyo emibili ngezikhathi ezihlukene, kodwa ibonakale kuphela ekunqamuleleni okukodwa kwikhamera ye-CCD?
options: Ubungako-banga-be-wave-particle: i-photon ihamba njenge-wave ye-probability engasendaweni, kodwa ukukalwa kwayo kuyayicindezela ibe yi-particle esendaweni ethile
correctAnswer: Ubungako-banga-be-wave-particle: i-photon ihamba njenge-wave ye-probability engasendaweni, kodwa ukukalwa kwayo kuyayicindezela ibe yi-particle esendaweni ethile
explanation: Umlingana kaSchrödinger uthuthuka iphakethe le-wave endaweni yonke ngokuqhubekayo kuzo zombili izindlela. Umthetho kaBorn ubeka ukuthi ukusebenzisana okungaguquki nomtholi okhona endaweni kudonsa iphakethe libe iphuzu.

question: Kungani umgibeli wesikhala somkhenkethi edonsa izandla zakhe ezibanzi ngaphakathi emlenzeni wakhe ehlelela ngokushesha kakhulu?
options: Ukulondolozwa Kwe-Angular Momentum: ukunciphisa umzuzu wobunzima kudinga ukuthi ijubane lokujikeleza likhule ngokulinganayo
correctAnswer: Ukulondolozwa Kwe-Angular Momentum: ukunciphisa umzuzu wobunzima kudinga ukuthi ijubane lokujikeleza likhule ngokulinganayo
explanation: Umzuliswano we-angular L = I * omega ugcinwa uma kungekho amandla angaphandle. Ukudonsa izandla ngaphakathi kwehlisa umzuzwana wokumelana I = sum(m*r^2), okubangela ijubane lokujikeleza omega likhuphuke.

question: Kungani ijubane lesondo lebhayisikili elijikeleza ukumelana nokugoba eceleni uma uzama ukusiphakamisa ngenkathi ulibamba (Gyroscopic Precession)?
options: Ukusebenzisa amandla angenayo kwenza ushintsho lwamandla wokujikeleza okuqondile kokubili amandla nokujikeleza komzimba
Irabha yesondo idonsa phansi ngomthamo wamanje ozinzile
correctAnswer: Ukusebenzisa amandla angenayo kwenza ushintsho lwamandla wokujikeleza okuqondile kokubili amandla nokujikeleza komzimba
explanation: I-gyroscopic torque tau = dL/dt = omega x L imisa ukuthi ukuhlose ukuphakamisa isondo eceleni kubangela amandla okuphendula angama-90 degrees ngaphandle kwesigaba, okukhiqiza ukuhamba okujwayelekile kunokugoba.

question: Kungani isiphongolo esisindayo esijikeleza noma igirosikopu singawi phansi ngokushesha, kodwa esikhundleni salokho sishukuma kancane emjikelezweni uzungeze i-axis eqondile?
options: I-torque yomhlaba esebenza esikhungweni esingaphansi konga i-mass idala i-gyroscopic precession eqhubekayo esikhundleni sokuphahlazeka
Umoya ophuma ngaphandle udonsa phezulu isiphongolo
correctAnswer: I-torque yomhlaba esebenza esikhungweni esingaphansi konga i-mass idala i-gyroscopic precession eqhubekayo esikhundleni sokuphahlazeka
explanation: Umhlaba udonsa phezulu phansi ngesiphongolo nge-torque tau = r x mg. Ngoba isiphongolo sine-angular momentum L, dL = tau * dt iphoqa i-vector yokujikeleza ukuthi ilandele i-cone uzungeze i-axis eqondile.

question: Kungani amanzi agobhoza phansi emgodini womhlinzeki wendlu engajikeli ngokuthembekile ezindaweni eziphambene eNyakatho naseNingizimu hemispheres?
options: Ukuhambisana kweCoriolis kumgodini wengilazi yokugeza kubuthakathaka izikhathi ezigcwele amathuneni okuhlanza, ukungafani kwesitsha, nokugeleza kwamanzi okugcwalisa
correctAnswer: Ukuhambisana kweCoriolis kumgodini wengilazi yokugeza kubuthakathaka izikhathi ezigcwele amathuneni okuhlanza, ukungafani kwesitsha, nokugeleza kwamanzi okugcwalisa
explanation: Amandla e-Coriolis abalulekile kuphela ezindaweni ezinkulu zomhlaba (izivunguvungu). Ebhavini, a_coriolis ~ 10^-5 m/s^2 ahluleka ngokuphelele ekulinganisweni kokuhamba kwamanzi kokuqala.

question: Kungani amafu enyikima ajikeleza njalo ngokuphambene nendlela yezinsimbi eNyakatho ye-Hemisphere futhi ajikeleze ngendlela yezinsimbi eNingizimu ye-Hemisphere?
options: Ukugoba kwe-Coriolis yomhlaba kudonsa amaqembu omoya asheshayo kwesokudla eNyakatho nasekushiyeni eNingizimu ezungeze izindawo ezinomfutho ophansi
Amanzi enyikima alandela izikhukhula zikagesi zolwandle
Ukushisa kwelanga kucindezela amafu iye entshonalanga
correctAnswer: Ukugoba kwe-Coriolis yomhlaba kudonsa amaqembu omoya asheshayo kwesokudla eNyakatho nasekushiyeni eNingizimu ezungeze izindawo ezinomfutho ophansi
explanation: Umoya osheshayo obheke enkabeni yamehlo anezinga eliphansi uguqulwa kwesokudla ngokusheshiswa kwe-Coriolis eNyakatho ye-Hemisphere, okukhiqiza ukujikeleza kwe-cyclonic okuphambene nezinsimbi.

question: Kungani umkhumbi wolwandle ohamba ngesivinini esikhulu esiteshini esincane, esimaphakathi esingejulile sodonsa ngokushesha uye ochibini lwesiteshi (Umphumela Wokudonswa Kwebhange)?
options: Umthetho kaBernoulli: amanzi acindezelwe phakathi kwehlaka lomkhumbi nomkhawulo webhange andisa ijubane, adale ingcindezi ephansi edonsa ihlaka lomkhumbi luye ogwini
Ithonya leqhwa lemfucuza lidala ukudonsa kukagesi
correctAnswer: Umthetho kaBernoulli: amanzi acindezelwe phakathi kwehlaka lomkhumbi nomkhawulo webhange andisa ijubane, adale ingcindezi ephansi edonsa ihlaka lomkhumbi luye ogwini
explanation: Ukugeleza kwamanzi okubucayi phakathi komkhumbi nebhange kukhuphula ijubane lokujiya kwamanzi (umthelela weVenturi). Ngokwe-equation kaBernoulli, lokhu okunyakazayo okungalingani okukhiqiza ukubalwa kwengcindezi okudonsa umqadelayo uye ebhange.

question: Kungani izikebhe ezimbili ezinkulu ezihamba eceleni komunye futhi ziseduze nolwandle olujulile zidonswa ngokungamelani ekuhlanganeni?
options: Amanzi adlula phakathi kokuncipha okuncane phakathi kwezinsika zombili anciphisa, ukudala indawo yokudonsa ingcindezi ephansi yamanzi endaweni ethile
correctAnswer: Amanzi adlula phakathi kokuncipha okuncane phakathi kwezinsika zombili anciphisa, ukudala indawo yokudonsa ingcindezi ephansi yamanzi endaweni ethile
explanation: Umphumela we-Venturi phakathi kwezikebhe ezimbili ukhuphula ijubane lamanzi phakathi kwazo, kwehlisa ingcindezi ye-hydrostatic. Ingcindezi yasolwandle yangaphandle icindezela zombili izikebhe ekuhlanganeni ohlangothini.

question: Kungani ibhola le-ping-pong elijikeleza ngokushayisana phezulu liwela ngokushesha kakhulu phansi liyohlala etafuleni kunokuthi amandla edijithali wedijithali kuphela angaba nawo (Umphumela kaMagnus)?
options: Umoya odonselwa phezulu uhamba ngokuphambene nomoya ophumayo kanti umoya ongaphansi uya nawo, okudala amandla omoya aphansi phansi
correctAnswer: Umoya odonselwa phezulu uhamba ngokuphambene nomoya ophumayo kanti umoya ongaphansi uya nawo, okudala amandla omoya aphansi phansi
explanation: Ukushayisana phezulu kudonsa umoya phambili phezu kwendawo engaphezulu, kudala iphuzu lokumisa phezulu kanye nesivinini esiphezulu ngaphansi. Ngokwe-theorem kaBernoulli, ingcindezi ephezulu iphusha ibhola phansi ngamandla kaMagnus F_M.

question: Kungani ibhola le-golf eligqokwe ngamadimbula lihamba cishe kabili kude emoyeni kune bhola elibushelelezi ngokuphelele elinobukhulu nobunzima obufanayo?
options: Amadimbula adala ungqimba lomoya oludidekile oluhlala isikhathi eside ebholeni, okunciphisa kakhulu ukumelana komoya
Amabhola abushelelezi akhiqiza ukushisa ngenxa wokuxubana
correctAnswer: Amadimbula adala ungqimba lomoya oludidekile oluhlala isikhathi eside ebholeni, okunciphisa kakhulu ukumelana komoya
explanation: Ungqimba lomoya oludidekile lune momentum ephakeme futhi lumelana kangcono nokucindezela okungekuhle kunemigqomo elandayo, libambelela ekuhlukaneni komoya futhi linciphise umsinga wokudonswa umfutho ophansi ngemuva kwebhola.

question: Kungani uchungechunge lwamanzi oluvela kwi-faucet yekhitshi luhudulela isipuni esingenalutho kuye lapho luthinta emuva okushelekile (umthelela we-Coandă)?
options: Amandla okubambisa kwamanzi adonsa uchungechunge olugelezayo ukuba lulandele ubuso obuphakelwe, kuphinde kuchithe amanzi futhi kudale ukudonsa okuphikisanayo
Isipuni siba nesimo esifana nomsakazo wamanzi asuka ku-faucet
Ukuhamba kombane okuvala kudonsa isipuni sensimbi
correctAnswer: Amandla okubambisa kwamanzi adonsa uchungechunge olugelezayo ukuba lulandele ubuso obuphakelwe, kuphinde kuchithe amanzi futhi kudale ukudonsa okuphikisanayo
explanation: U-Henri Coandă uthole ukuthi ijethi yamanzi iyanamathela ebusweni okushelekile obuseduze ngenxa yomfutho ophansi owenziwa ngamanzi agobile, eguqa ukugeleza futhi kudale amandla okuphakamisa aphikisanayo.

question: Indlela i-perfume atomizer esakaza ngayo noma i-carburetor yemoto idonsa kanjani uketshezi phezulu ngepayipi ngaphandle kwepampu yezobuchwepheshe (Umphumela we-Venturi)?
options: Umoya ocindezelwe ucindezeleka ngaphesheya kwesibopho esincane ukhuphula isivinini, okudala isicindezi esiphansi sendawo esidonsa uketshezi phezulu epayipini
Umoya ocindezelwe ushisa uketshezi kuze kube ukupheka
correctAnswer: Umoya ocindezelwe ucindezeleka ngaphesheya kwesibopho esincane ukhuphula isivinini, okudala isicindezi esiphansi sendawo esidonsa uketshezi phezulu epayipini
explanation: Uketshezi olugelezayo epayipini elifakwe esitsheni likhuphula ijubane ngokusho komthetho wokungaguquki, okwenza umfutho wesikhashana wehlela ngaphansi komfutho womoya bese ukutshezi kudonswa phezulu.

question: Kungani wamanzi omuncu ehamba, edansa, futhi ephila imizuzu eminingana epanini elishisayo kakhulu elingaphezu kuka-200°C esikhundleni sokubilika ngokushesha (Umthelela weLeidenfrost)?
options: Ingxenye engaphansi kuwamanzi iphenduka umusi ngokushesha okudala indwangu yokuvikela eshiya ingxenye engaphezulu ingenalo ukuxhumana okuqondile kokushisa nepani
Amanzi abiliswa abe yigelisha elibandayo ezingeni lokushisa eliphezulu
Insimbi eshisayo idonsela kude amangqamuzana wamanzi ngogesi
correctAnswer: Ingxenye engaphansi kuwamanzi iphenduka umusi ngokushesha okudala indwangu yokuvikela eshiya ingxenye engaphezulu ingenalo ukuxhumana okuqondile kokushisa nepani
explanation: Ngaphezu kwephuzu leLeidenfrost, ukugeza okusheshayo kwengxenye engaphansi kudala ifilimu yomusi enezinga eliphansi lokudlulisa ukushisa, evikela ukushisa kwayo yonke ingxenye esele yamanzi futhi isuse ukungqubuzana.

question: Ngaphansi kwezimo zokuhlola ezithile, kungani isitsha esivulekile samanzi ashisayo singaqanda sibe iqhwa eliqinile ngokushesha kunezitsha ezifanayo zamanzi abandayo (Umphumela ka-Mpemba)?
options: Ukuncibilika okusheshayo okuthuthukisiwe kwehlisa ubuningi bolwamanzi, imijikelezo ye-convection esheshayo, kanye nokukhulula ngokushesha kwezinto ezixutshiwe ezingamanzi
Amanzi ashisayo aqukethe ama-molecule amaningi abandayo
Amanzi abandayo ayanda kuze kuzihlanganise wona ngokwakhe
correctAnswer: Ukuncibilika okusheshayo okuthuthukisiwe kwehlisa ubuningi bolwamanzi, imijikelezo ye-convection esheshayo, kanye nokukhulula ngokushesha kwezinto ezixutshiwe ezingamanzi
explanation: U-Erasto Mpemba wabona ukuthi izinto ezifudumele ezixutshiwe zibanda ngokushesha. Izindlela ezinomthelela zihlanganisa ukulahleka okukhulu kwesikhwama ngokuqhuma kwamanzi, ukuthuthwa okukhulu kokushisa ngokudlulisela umoya, kanye nokushintshwa kwezixhumi ze-hydrogen.

question: Kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi amanzi ahlanzwe kakhulu angahlala esemanzini ngo -10°C noma -15°C ngaphandle kokubanda (Supercooling)?
options: Amanzi adinga iseli elincane lokuqala lokwenziwa kweqhwa (uthuli noma inhlokwana yeqhwa) ukuze kuqale ukuguquka kwe-lattice yeqhwa
Ubanda obukhulu buguqula amanzi abe amanzi asindayo
correctAnswer: Amanzi adinga iseli elincane lokuqala lokwenziwa kweqhwa (uthuli noma inhlokwana yeqhwa) ukuze kuqale ukuguquka kwe-lattice yeqhwa
explanation: Ukuqandeka kungukuguquka kwesigaba sokuqala okudinga ububanzi obubalulekile beseli lokuqala ukuze kudlule izigwebo zamandla ebusweni. Ngaphandle kokungcola, ukuqalwa okulinganayo kwenzeka kuphela ngaphansi kuka -48°C.

question: Iyiphi inkathi yokuziphatha komzimba ekhethekile eyenzeka ngaphakathi kwebhaktheriya encane yomsindo ewohlokayo emanzini (Sonoluminescence)?
options: Ukudilika kwe-adiabatic kucindezela amagesi kuye ezinkulungwaneni zezinga lomoya, kukhiqiza izinga lokushisa elishisa kunendawo yobuso boLanga futhi kukhipha ukukhanya okushashisayo
Amanzi ama-molecule ayahlangana abe i-helium plasma
Amaza omsindo abuyela emuva ukusuka kumakha wamabhavini
correctAnswer: Ukudilika kwe-adiabatic kucindezela amagesi kuye ezinkulungwaneni zezinga lomoya, kukhiqiza izinga lokushisa elishisa kunendawo yobuso boLanga futhi kukhipha ukukhanya okushashisayo
explanation: Amafu kagesi amile aphoqa ukuwohloka kwamabhamu ngesivinini esingaphezu komsindo. Amafu aphuphuma ngokulingana njengemibhobho ashisa amagesi anobuqotho avalelwe ngezinga lokushisa elingaphezu kuka-15,000 Kelvin, akhiqiza ukuqhuma kwe-picosecond kwe-photon.

question: Kungani umsindo wensimbi ophakeme, owonakalayo uvoza umsindo ezimpayini zamanzi endlini ngesikhathi kuvulwa noma kuvalwa ngokushesha i-valve (Umphumela weWater Hammer)?
options: Amanzi angakwazi ukujiya ahamba aqeda ngokushesha, aguqula amandla awo okunyakaza abe ngumthombo wokucindezela ophakeme ohamba emuva naphambili
Amaqabunga entuthu yamanzi abilisa aqhuma ngaphakathi kwama-valve
correctAnswer: Amanzi angakwazi ukujiya ahamba aqeda ngokushesha, aguqula amandla awo okunyakaza abe ngumthombo wokucindezela ophakeme ohamba emuva naphambili
explanation: Umzila wamanzi udala ukushayisana kwe-pressure kwe-Joukowsky Delta P = rho * c * Delta v. Le wave yokushayisana kwezwi ihamba ngesivinini sosizo emanzini, ivela ngokudumo ezindongeni ze-pipe.

question: Kungani ishidi lamanzi elithambile, elincane neliyindilinga lisakazeka libe yilifule flat evela ephumini lokugeza ekhishini bese lenza ngokuzumayo libe yiringi eqinile ephakeme (i-Hydraulic Jump)?
options: Ukugeleza okuphakeme kwe-laminar oku-supercritical kushintshela ngokuzumayo ekugelezeni okuncane, okujulile kwe-subcritical njengoba i-inertia yamanzi inokuma phansi ngesisindo kanye nengcindezi ye-hydrostatic
correctAnswer: Ukugeleza okuphakeme kwe-laminar oku-supercritical kushintshela ngokuzumayo ekugelezeni okuncane, okujulile kwe-subcritical njengoba i-inertia yamanzi inokuma phansi ngesisindo kanye nengcindezi ye-hydrostatic
explanation: Inani lika-Froude lehla lisuka ku-Fr > 1 (ukugeleza okuphakeme lapho ijubane lamagagasi lincipha kunomjikelezo wamanzi) lize ku-Fr < 1 (okuncane kwe-subcritical). Ukushintshashintsha kudala ukuphuma kwemile okuhlukanisayo kwe-dissipative.

question: Kungani ama-droplet abandayo ewavini agijima ngaphakathi kwezwekazi lewayini enza ama-beads akhuphuka phezulu aziwa ngokuthi 'Izinyembezi ZeWayini' (Umphumela kaMarangoni)?
options: Ukushabalala kwe-alikholo kukhuphula ukuqina kwamanzi ebusweni kummese oyindilinga, kudonsa uketshezi phezulu kuze kube umhlaba uwasheleza ema-droplet awelayo
Imigodi yeglasi iphakamisa uketshezi ngenqubo yokuhudula
correctAnswer: Ukushabalala kwe-alikholo kukhuphula ukuqina kwamanzi ebusweni kummese oyindilinga, kudonsa uketshezi phezulu kuze kube umhlaba uwasheleza ema-droplet awelayo
explanation: I-Alikholo iyashabalala ngokushesha kunamanzi kummese omncane, idala umehluko wokuqina kobuso. Uketshezi luhamba luya ezindaweni zokuqina kobuso okukhulu (ukungcikwana kweMarangoni) luphikisana nomthelela wokudonsa komhlaba.

question: Izihlahla ezinkulu ze-redwood zingayiphakamisela kanjani amanzi angaphezu kwamamitha angu-100 phezulu esihlahleni lapho ingcindezi yomoya ingaphakamisi amanzi kuphela ngamamitha angu-10.3?
options: I-Cohesion-Tension Theory: ukuhamba kwamanzi emakhoneni kudala ingcindezi yokunqaba enkulu kakhulu, ukudonsa ikholomu yamanzi eqhubekayo ngaphansi kwengcindezi
Amazwe asebenza njengepampu yemishini enengcindezi ephezulu
correctAnswer: I-Cohesion-Tension Theory: ukuhamba kwamanzi emakhoneni kudala ingcindezi yokunqaba enkulu kakhulu, ukudonsa ikholomu yamanzi eqhubekayo ngaphansi kwengcindezi
explanation: Ubuhlobo be-Hydrogen bunika amanzi amandla amangalisayo okudonsa (~-20 MPa). Ukuphuma kwamanzi emakhoneni kudala ingcindezi emibi edonsela phezulu amakholomu e-xylem angaphukile ukuze afinyelele phezulu esihlahleni.

question: Kungani ama-Cheerios ngamunye ahlehle emanzini ebhadebheni wendlovu emazombezini ephansi ahlangana ngokuzumayo abe amaqembu ahlephukayo (Umphumela we-Cheerios)?
options: Ukugoba kwe-meniskhu: izinto ezihleli phezulu ziyiguqula ingaphezulu liketshe, zibangele ukuthi zihlale zisondele komunye nomunye ngokuhamba okuqhubekayo phezulu
Izingcezu zesitambu ziphethe amashaji kagesi aphikisanayo
correctAnswer: Ukugoba kwe-meniskhu: izinto ezihleli phezulu ziyiguqula ingaphezulu liketshe, zibangele ukuthi zihlale zisondele komunye nomunye ngokuhamba okuqhubekayo phezulu
explanation: Amandla okumanzi adala ama-meniskhi aphindwe kabili azungeze isitambu esihleli phezulu. Izinto ezidonsela amanzi zikhuphuka ziye komunye nomunye ukuze zinciphise amandla amakhulu ebhekele kanye namandla endawo phakathi nendawo.

question: Kungani uchungechunge oluncane lwenethawe ye-shampu noma insipho yezandla ewuketshezi kwesinye isikhathi luphuma luphakamise phezulu ngokuzumayo (i-Kaye Effect)?
options: Ukuziphatha kwe-non-Newtonian okuncipha uma ku-sheara kuvumela uchungechunge olwehla ukuthi luhambe phezu kolwelwesi oluhambisa umoya oluthunjwe esitebele
Ukugeleza kukagesi ongashintshi kuphonsela phezulu ama-molecule nensipho
correctAnswer: Ukuziphatha kwe-non-Newtonian okuncipha uma ku-sheara kuvumela uchungechunge olwehla ukuthi luhambe phezu kolwelwesi oluhambisa umoya oluthunjwe esitebele
explanation: Alan Kaye wathola ukuthi ama-viscoelastic fluids anciphisa uma e-shear enza indawo egobekayo enethanjeni lohlobo lwamanzi. Ifilimu yomoya encane ilungisa i-jet, ivumela uchungechunge olungenayo ukuthi luhambe ngokuthambile bese luvuka luphinde luphakame phezulu.

question: Kungani isixazululo sepulima esine-viscoelastic siphakama PHAKATHI kwirhodi esibambekayo esijikelezayo esime mpo kunokudutshulwa ngaphandle ngamandla e-centrifugal (Umphumela ka-Weissenberg)?
options: Amandla ejwayelekile e-elastiki akhiqizwa ukwelula kwezinhlaka ze-polymer adala ingcindezi yephepha elicindezela uketshezi lwangaphakathi nangaphezulu ngaphansi kwerhodi.
Amandla e-centrifugal ashintsha indlela kuziqukathi eziminyene.
Ukuxubana kwerhodi kushisa uketshezi kuze kuphakamise.
correctAnswer: Amandla ejwayelekile e-elastiki akhiqizwa ukwelula kwezinhlaka ze-polymer adala ingcindezi yephepha elicindezela uketshezi lwangaphakathi nangaphezulu ngaphansi kwerhodi.
explanation: UKarl Weissenberg wakhombisa ukuthi ukugoqwa kwezinhlaka ezinde ze-polymer kubanwe buhlangothi ngohlu lwamanzi. Ithonsi lokucindezela okungalingani elikhona likhiqiza ingcindezi yangaphakathi eqhuba uketshezi phezulu koxhaxha.

question: Kungani upende odwaleni olunothile ugijima kahle futhi kancane ngaphansi kwesibambo somdwebi, kodwa uma ukudweba kumiswa uyakhala ngokushesha futhi awuvumele ukugeleza odwaleni oluyiqiniso (Thixotropy)?
options: Ukucindezelwa komshini kwehlisa inethiwekhi ye-colloidal gel eguqukayo, ephinde yakha ngokushesha ibe uhlaka oluqinile lapho iphumula
Umhlaba uwenza ukuthi ukujiya kwepende kungabi namphumela
correctAnswer: Ukucindezelwa komshini kwehlisa inethiwekhi ye-colloidal gel eguqukayo, ephinde yakha ngokushesha ibe uhlaka oluqinile lapho iphumula
explanation: Izinto ezine-thixotropic zibonisa ukuncipha kwesikhathi ngokuhamba. Amandla okucheba aphazamisa izakhi zangaphakathi ezihlanganiswe nge-hydrogen, anciphisa ukujiya; lapho kuphumula, isakhiwo sangaphakathi siyakhiwa kabusha, kuvimbela ukugeleza.

question: Kungani i-ferrofluid yensimbi ekhethekile yakha uhlaka lwemibambo ebukhali efana ne-hedgehog lapho ibhekene nensimu kazibuthe eqondile (i-Rosensweig Instability)?
options: Kuyibhalansi ebalulekile phakathi kwamandla omzimba kazibuthe adonsa ukuhamba kolwelo kulo mgqa wensimu, ukucindezela komhlaba okulwa nokuguqulwa, kanye nesisindo somhlaba
Ama-nanoparticles entsimbi ephakathi aba ngamaqungu aqinile
correctAnswer: Kuyibhalansi ebalulekile phakathi kwamandla omzimba kazibuthe adonsa ukuhamba kolwelo kulo mgqa wensimu, ukucindezela komhlaba okulwa nokuguqulwa, kanye nesisindo somhlaba
explanation: URonald Rosensweig waphawula ukuthi ngaphezu komkhawulo wesimo kazibuthe esinqunyiwe, izindawo ezimile ziba zingazinzi. Amandla akhululekile ancishiswa ngokwakha izinhlelo ezinamehlo eziyindilinga zamabhamuza aphakeme kulo mgqa wensimu.

question: Kungani insimbi engaguquguquki yokumagnetha ilahlekelwa ngokuphelele amandla ayo okumagnetha futhi ingakwazi ukunamathela ku-friji lapho ifudunyezwa ngaphezu kuka-770°C (Izinga Lokushisa le-Curie)?
options: Ukuvunguzela okushisayo kudlula ukushintshana kwe-quantum, kuguqule ukuvumelana kwezakhi ezincane zemagneti
Amapholo kagesi ayancipha ngenxa yensimbi egugile
correctAnswer: Ukuvunguzela okushisayo kudlula ukushintshana kwe-quantum, kuguqule ukuvumelana kwezakhi ezincane zemagneti
explanation: UPierre Curie wakhombisa ukuthi amandla okushisa k_B * T adlula amandla okushintshana kwe-quantum agcina ama-electron ephendukezela ngokuhambisana. Ukumagnetha okuzenzakalelayo kwehla kuze kufike ekulinganisweni okuyi-zero, kungena esigabeni se-paramagnetic.

question: I-thermocouple ikhiqiza kanjani i-voltage kagesi lapho izintambo zensimbi ezimbili ezingafani zixhunywe ndawonye futhi izixhumi zazo zigcinwa ezingeni lokushisa elihlukile (Umphumela we-Seebeck)?
options: Abaphakeli bamandla (ama-electron noma izimbobo) basakazwa ukusuka ku-junction eshisayo besiya ku-junction ebanda, bedala umehluko wesikh potential we-thermoelectric
Ukushisa kushisa insimbi yobhedu kube i-asidi yebhethri
correctAnswer: Abaphakeli bamandla (ama-electron noma izimbobo) basakazwa ukusuka ku-junction eshisayo besiya ku-junction ebanda, bedala umehluko wesikh potential we-thermoelectric
explanation: UThomas Johann Seebeck wathola ukuthi umehluko wokushisa nabla T ushukumisa ukuminyanisa kwezithwali zokushisa, ukudala insimu kagesi E = -S * nabla T, lapho u-S uyisici seSeebeck sezinto.

question: Kungani i-Peltier cooler esebenzisa isimo esiqinile ingakwazi ukufreeze ukwehla kwamanzi ngakolunye uhlangothi ngenkathi ikhipha ukushisa okukhulu ngakolunye uhlangothi isebenzisa ugesi oqondile kuphela (Umphumela we-Peltier)?
options: Ukudlulisa ugesi phezu kwesixhumi samasemiconductor ahlukene kuthwala amandla okushisa ngokusebenzisa abaphathi bamandla kusuka kolunye uhlangothi kuya kolunye
correctAnswer: Ukudlulisa ugesi phezu kwesixhumi samasemiconductor ahlukene kuthwala amandla okushisa ngokusebenzisa abaphathi bamandla kusuka kolunye uhlangothi kuya kolunye
explanation: UJean Peltier wakhombisa ukuthi ugesi I oqhuba ama-elekthroni ngaphesheya kwamabhande e-semiconductor utshala ukushisa esixhumaneni esisodwa (ukupholisa) futhi ukhulula ngakolunye isixhumi: Q_dot = (Pi_A - Pi_B) * I.

question: Ingabe i-Hall effect sensor ejwayelekile ikala kanjani amandla wensimu kagesi esebenzisa ugesi omncane?
options: Amandla ka-Lorentz akhomba abathwali bamandla kagesi ukudlula ngakolunye uhlangothi lomqhubi, kwakha ugesi we-Hall ongalinganiswa kuwela.
Izinkambu zikamagnethi zinciphisa intambo yokhuni yensimbi.
correctAnswer: Amandla ka-Lorentz akhomba abathwali bamandla kagesi ukudlula ngakolunye uhlangothi lomqhubi, kwakha ugesi we-Hall ongalinganiswa kuwela.
explanation: U-Edwin Hall wakhombisa ukuthi insimu kagesi ephambene B inika amandla F = q(v x B) kubakhokhi abahamba, iqokelela ukukhokha kumngcele owodwa kuze kube insimu kagesi evundla amandla kamagneti.

question: Kungani ukutholakala kwe-Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR) ngo-1988 kwabeka ukuqhuma okukhulu emandleni okugcina amadiskhi e-computer?
options: Izendlalelo ezincane kakhulu ze-magnetic nezingezona ezemicibisholo zishintsha ukumelana kukagesi ngamaphesenti amakhulu kuye ngokuthi ama-elektroni ajikeleza kanjani
Kwafakwa esikhundleni sezitsha ze-aluminium ngesigubhu sengilazi
correctAnswer: Izendlalelo ezincane kakhulu ze-magnetic nezingezona ezemicibisholo zishintsha ukumelana kukagesi ngamaphesenti amakhulu kuye ngokuthi ama-elektroni ajikeleza kanjani
explanation: U-Albert Fert no-Peter Grünberg bathola ukuthi ukusakazwa okuncike ekusinzeni kwe-spin ngokusebenzisa izendlalelo ezincane kakhulu kubangela ukuwa okukhulu kokumelana kukagesi lapho izendlalelo ze-ferromagnetic zinemagnetized ifana.

question: Kungani i-superconductor eshisayo ephakeme ebekwe ngaphezu kwe-magnet yaphakade ingamkhiphi nje, kodwa ihlale imisiwe ngokuzinza emoyeni kunoma yiluphi uhlangothi (Flux Pinning)?
options: Imigqa yensimu kagesi idlula ngeziteshi ezincane ezinemibimbi (vortices) kuma-Type-II superconductors, ibopha imigqa yensimu kagesi endaweni yayo
correctAnswer: Imigqa yensimu kagesi idlula ngeziteshi ezincane ezinemibimbi (vortices) kuma-Type-II superconductors, ibopha imigqa yensimu kagesi endaweni yayo
explanation: Kuma-Type-II superconductors phakathi kwe-H_c1 ne-H_c2, umugqa wensimu kagesi ungena njenge-Abrikosov vortices emayunithi. Ukungcola kwezinto kubopha lezi zikhungo zevortex, kuqinisa ukuhlukaniswa kwe-spatial okuqinile.

question: I-SQUID (Superconducting Quantum Interference Device) ingayithola kanjani imikhakha kagesi emincane engacabangeki ekhiqizwa ama-synapses obuchopho bomuntu (10^-15 Tesla)?
options: Isebenzisa izixhumanisi ezimbili ze-Josephson eziphambene emjikelezweni we-superconducting lapho ukuphazamiseka kwezigaba kwe-quantum kushintshela ngokucophelela ngamaflukhwe ayi-fractional
Ikala ukuwa kwe-beta okukhishwa yi-radioactive egazini
correctAnswer: Isebenzisa izixhumanisi ezimbili ze-Josephson eziphambene emjikelezweni we-superconducting lapho ukuphazamiseka kwezigaba kwe-quantum kushintshela ngokucophelela ngamaflukhwe ayi-fractional
explanation: I-flux kagesi idlula emjikelezweni iholela ekwehlukaneni kwesigaba Delta phi = 2*pi * Phi / Phi_0 phakathi kwezixhumanisi ezimbili ze-Josephson, okudala uku oscillation okwenzeka njalo kukhuculwe yokugcina okucophelela ku-10^-18 Tesla.

question: Ngokwe-BCS Theory, ama-electron amabili ahlaselana ngamandla afanayo kodwa anesimo esiphikisanayo ahlangana kanjani ukuze akhe 'Cooper Pair' etholakala ngaphakathi kwe-superconductor enezinga lokushisa eliphansi?
options: Ugesi ohambayo uguqula i-crystal lattice enenkokhiso enhle, ushiya umkhondo wokupholisa okuphindaphindayo okheha i-electron yesibili
Amandla esitshalo aqinile adlula ukwenqaba kwe-Coulomb
correctAnswer: Ugesi ohambayo uguqula i-crystal lattice enenkokhiso enhle, ushiya umkhondo wokupholisa okuphindaphindayo okheha i-electron yesibili
explanation: Bardeen, Cooper, noSchrieffer babonisa ukuthi ukusebenzisana kwe-electron-phonon kudala amandla adonsela phakathi kwama-electron anemomentum ne-spin ephikisanayo, kwakha ama-Cooper pairs e-bosonic ahlanganayo.

question: Kungani ukucindezela noma ukuphusha ngokomshini i-quartz evamile kukhiqiza ishaja kagesi enomthamo ophezulu ongalinganiswa ebusweni bayo (Umthelela we-Piezoelectric)?
options: Ukuguqulwa komshini kushintsha ama-ion e-silicon ane-positive kanye ne-oxygen ane-negative ema-crystals angabi nesimilo esisodwa, kudala umzuzwana wombane we-dipole.
correctAnswer: Ukuguqulwa komshini kushintsha ama-ion e-silicon ane-positive kanye ne-oxygen ane-negative ema-crystals angabi nesimilo esisodwa, kudala umzuzwana wombane we-dipole.
explanation: Amakristalu angenayo ukufana kokuguqula (njenge-alpha-quartz) athuthukisa ukuhlukaniswa kukagesi okukhulu P_i = d_ijk * sigma_jk lapho ebhekene nengcindezi yezinto, okubangela izikhawu eziphezulu zikagesi.

question: Kungani ukufukula ibhaluni lerabha ngokushesha phezu kwezinwele zomuntu kubangela ukuthi ibhaluni nimise kahle ophahleni olungenawo ugesi amahora ambalwa (Umphumela weTriboelectric)?
options: Ukuxhumana kokungqubuzana kuthuthela ama-electron kusuka ebunzimeni kuya ku-rabha yebhaluni, futhi ibhaluni elinekhala elibi likhanyisa ama-athomu angakhokhelwanga esilingini
correctAnswer: Ukuxhumana kokungqubuzana kuthuthela ama-electron kusuka ebunzimeni kuya ku-rabha yebhaluni, futhi ibhaluni elinekhala elibi likhanyisa ama-athomu angakhokhelwanga esilingini
explanation: Ukuxhumana kokudonsa phakathi kwezinto ezinezimisebenzi zokusebenza ezingafani kudlulisa ama-electron. I-insulator ephoqelekile idala izikweletu zesithombe kophahla lwe-dielectric, ikhiqiza amandla kagesi adonsayo.

question: Kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi umphakeli we-foil okhanyayo ongu-triangle uhambe endaweni engenazwi phakathi nomoya uma uxhumeke kumandla kagesi angu-30,000-volt (Umphumela we-Biefeld-Brown)?
options: Ukukhishwa kwe-corona okungalingani okuphakeme kwamandla kagesi kwenza ama-athomu omoya azungezile abe nama-ion, futhi umoya osheshayo wama-ion ushukumisela umphakeli ngokushintshaniswa kwe-momentum
Izinkambu zokumelana nesisindo ziqeda isisindo seMhlaba
Amandla aphakeme kagesi akhubaza inhliziyo kazibuthe yeMhlaba
correctAnswer: Ukukhishwa kwe-corona okungalingani okuphakeme kwamandla kagesi kwenza ama-athomu omoya azungezile abe nama-ion, futhi umoya osheshayo wama-ion ushukumisela umphakeli ngokushintshaniswa kwe-momentum
explanation: Intambo ehlanzekile enobuhlungu idala insimu kazibuthe eqinile eyonakalisa umoya (ukukhishwa kwe-corona). Ama-ion asheshisiwe ahluleka nama-athomu omoya angenabala, eqhuba umoya we-'ion' phansi ophusha umphakeli phezulu.

question: Kungani ingwenya ye-gecko ingagijima ngokuphambene kweplate yeglasi ehlanzekile, engena-uphuze uwoyela ngaphandle kokusebenzisa noma yiziphi izinto ezinamandla zokunamathela noma izinkomishi zokufaka umoya?
options: Izigaxa ezincane eziningi zihlukana zibe izigaxa ezincane kakhulu ezikhiqiza amandla okuheha e-Van der Waals aqoqiwe
Izinkomishi zokufaka umoya ezincane zidalela indawo engenawo umoya
Umlenze we-gecko ukhipha igluqhu elomisa ngokushesha
correctAnswer: Izigaxa ezincane eziningi zihlukana zibe izigaxa ezincane kakhulu ezikhiqiza amandla okuheha e-Van der Waals aqoqiwe
explanation: Umlenze we-gecko une-setae ezihlakazeka zibe ama-spatula (~200 nm ububanzi). Ukuxhumana okuseduze kwamangqamuzana kusenza sisebenzise amandla e-Van der Waals okudonsa ngamandla kagesi, okukwazi ukusekela cishe amakhilogremu angu-130.

question: Kungani umjovo wamanzi wakhe i-pearl ecishe ibe yindilinga egcwele esikhwameni se-lotus bese ukhwehlela phansi uthathe yonke uthuli (Umphumela we-Lotus)?
options: Amapapilla amancane kakhulu esikhumbeni agqoke i-wax engamanzi athwebula izikhala zomoya ngaphansi komjovo (isimo sokuthambisa i-Cassie-Baxter)
correctAnswer: Amapapilla amancane kakhulu esikhumbeni agqoke i-wax engamanzi athwebula izikhala zomoya ngaphansi komjovo (isimo sokuthambisa i-Cassie-Baxter)
explanation: Uhlaka olubekwe ngendlela ye-micro- ne-nano lubamba amabhakede omoya ngaphansi kwamanzi (isimo se-Cassie-Baxter). Amakona oxhumano adlula ku-160 degrees, okuvumela imijovo eshukumayo ukuba iqoqe uthuli ngokunamathela ebusweni.

question: Kungani ihluma elibekwe phezulu kwesiqongo esingu-2 millimeter se-silica Aerogel lingashi ngokuphelele futhi lihlale lihle ngesikhathi i-blowtorch engu-1,000°C ishisa ngqo ngaphansi kwalo?
options: Isakhiwo se-silica esinamagobolondo ema-nano e-Aerogel siqukethe umoya angu-99.8%, sibamba igesi ezikolweni ezincane kune-mean free path yamangqamuzana omoya (Umphumela ka-Knudsen)
I-gel ifaka ama-thermal photons ngokusebenzisa i-photosynthesis
correctAnswer: Isakhiwo se-silica esinamagobolondo ema-nano e-Aerogel siqukethe umoya angu-99.8%, sibamba igesi ezikolweni ezincane kune-mean free path yamangqamuzana omoya (Umphumela ka-Knudsen)
explanation: Ngosayizi wezenkowa (~20 nm) abancane kune-mean free path yamangqamuzana omoya (~70 nm), amangqamuzana egetsi awakwazi ukungqubuzana ukuhambisa amandla we-kinetic. Xubene nenethiwekhi ye-silica ecikizayo, ukufudumala okwedlulele kungu ~0.015 W/mK.

question: Kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi intambo ephukile kakhulu, egobile eyenziwe nge-Nitinol (isiliva sesinamoni-titaniyu) iphenduke ngokushesha ibe kwesimo sayo esiqondile ekujikelweni emanzini ashisayo?
options: Ukuguquka kwesimo esiphakeme sokushisa okuvela ku-martensitic kuya ku-austenitic esivumelana nesimo sivuselela i-crystal lattice ephakeme lokushisa
Amanzi ashisayo ashaja intambo ngamayeri okukhumbula isimo
correctAnswer: Ukuguquka kwesimo esiphakeme sokushisa okuvela ku-martensitic kuya ku-austenitic esivumelana nesimo sivuselela i-crystal lattice ephakeme lokushisa
explanation: Ukuguqula i-Nitinol ngaphansi kwezinga lokushisa lokushintsha kubuyisela izinhlobo ezimbili ze-martensite ngaphandle kokuqhekeza izibopho ze-athomu. Ukushisisa ngaphezu kwe-A_f kuguqula i-lattice yaba i-austenite yomzali, okuqhuba ukuphulukiswa okuphelele kwesimo.

question: Kungani amaphiko aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka akhanyayo weMorpho engapheli ekukhanyeni kwelanga njengemibala yekhemikhali noma upende?
options: Umbala udalwa ukungalungi kwesakhiwo esincane kakhulu: izakhiwo zebhodi yomuthi weKrisimesi ezenziwe nge-chitin zibuyisela kalula amawavelength aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
Izikali ziqukethe umbala wensimbi ye-cobalt ongapheli
Amaphiko enkukhu aphuza yonke imisebe ebonakalayo ngaphandle koluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
Ukukhanya kwelanga kushaja amaskwewula omaphiko nge-bioluminescence eluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
correctAnswer: Umbala udalwa ukungalungi kwesakhiwo esincane kakhulu: izakhiwo zebhodi yomuthi weKrisimesi ezenziwe nge-chitin zibuyisela kalula amawavelength aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka
explanation: Umbala weMorpho uwakha: ama-ridge amancane afana nezihlahla e-chitin adala izendlalelo zokuhlukahluka kwe-dielectric. Ukuphazamiseka okwakhiwe kukhulisa ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okungu-450 nm, okungapheli ngaphandle kokuthi isakhiwo somzimba sichitheke.

question: Kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi izinto zokufakelwa zokukhanya ze-Metamaterials zigobe ukukhanya ngendlela ephelele 'engeyiyo', kuvumele izembozo zokungabonakali ezibhekwa ngokwesayensi?
options: Zine-permittivity kagesi engemihle (epsilon) kanye ne-permeability kagesi engamamagnezi (mu) ngasikhathi sinye, zikhiqiza inkomba yokuphambuka engemihle
Zisebenzisa izibuko ezincane ezinkulungwaneni eziveza ukukhanya kwe-laser
Zimunca ukukhanya bese ziphinde zithumele imisebe yomsakazo
correctAnswer: Zine-permittivity kagesi engemihle (epsilon) kanye ne-permeability kagesi engamamagnezi (mu) ngasikhathi sinye, zikhiqiza inkomba yokuphambuka engemihle
explanation: UVictor Veselago wabikezela ukuthi izinto ezinenkomba engemihle (NIMs) ziphinde umthetho kaSnell: ukukhanya kugoba ohlangothini olufanayo lwenormal uma kudluliswe. Ama-resonator wesigaba se-split-ring angaphansi kwesilinganiso samaza aqondisa ama-wavefronts ngokuthambile ezungeze izinto.

question: Kungani ukukhanya okuhamba ngaphakathi kwekhebula lepulasitiki yefayibha okuhamba ngaphakathi kugcinwa ngaphakathi amakhilomitha ngaphandle kokuphuma eceleni (Ukuvezwa Okuphelele Ngokungaphakathi)?
options: I-engeli yokuphakama emngceleni we-glasi-cladding idlula i-engeli ebalulekile, ibuyisela u-100 ekhulwini wokukhanya ngaphakathi
Ngaphandle kwekhebula kugqoke izibuko zefoloko ye-aluminium
Amakhabeli e-fiber asebenzisa amapompo e-laser angaphansi kwengcindezi ephezulu
correctAnswer: I-engeli yokuphakama emngceleni we-glasi-cladding idlula i-engeli ebalulekile, ibuyisela u-100 ekhulwini wokukhanya ngaphakathi
explanation: Uma ukukhanya kuhamba kusuka ku-core ebanzi (n1 ephezulu) uya e-cladding enezinga eliphansi (n2) ngengeli theta > theta_c = arcsin(n2/n1), umthetho ka-Snell uchaza ukungadluliseli lutho, kutholakala ukuvezwa okuphelele ngaphakathi ngaphandle kokulahleka kokubonisa.

question: Kungani izibuko zelanga ezine-polarized cishe zisusa ngokuphelele ukukhanya okuqaqambayo okukhishwe emgwaqweni wensipho noma ebusweni bamanzi?
options: Ukukhanya okubuyiselwe emuva kuvame ukuba ne-polarized okuhambisana nezintambo, kuyilapho amalensi ezibuko zelanga anepolarized esetshenziswa ngezikhombisi zokusakaza okuvundlile ukuvimba lokhu
Izibuko zelanga zenza wonke ama-wave wavelength emafutheni ngokulinganayo
Ingilazi e-polarized ibuyisela emuva imisebe ye-UV esibhakabhakeni
correctAnswer: Ukukhanya okubuyiselwe emuva kuvame ukuba ne-polarized okuhambisana nezintambo, kuyilapho amalensi ezibuko zelanga anepolarized esetshenziswa ngezikhombisi zokusakaza okuvundlile ukuvimba lokhu
explanation: Ukukhanya okubuyiselwe ebusweni be-dielectric obuvundlile eduze kwe-engela ka-Brewster ngokuyinhloko ku-polarized s (inkambu kagesi elandelana nobuso, okusho ukuthi okuvundlile). Izihlunga zokupolarize eziqondile zivimba ngokukhethekile lokhu ukukhanya okuvundlile.

question: Kungani ukubuka umbhalo ngokusebenzisa i-crystal ecacile ebonakala ye-Iceland Spar calcite kubonisa izithombe ezimbili ezifana nephindwe kabili ezihlanganisiwe (Birefringence)?
options: I-calcite crystal inenani lokufanisa elingalinganiyo elihlukanisa ukukhanya okungaphelelanga okuvela kwamandla okujwayelekile nokukhethekile okuvele ku-polarized rays
correctAnswer: I-calcite crystal inenani lokufanisa elingalinganiyo elihlukanisa ukukhanya okungaphelelanga okuvela kwamandla okujwayelekile nokukhethekile okuvele ku-polarized rays
