explanation: Amakristalu e-Uniaxial abonisa amandla okwamukela okuncike endaweni. Ukukhanya okungena kuhlukaniswa kube yi-'ordinary ray' elandela umthetho kaSnell ne-'extraordinary ray' enesivinini esincike kwikona, esishintsha izithombe ezimbili.

question: Kungani izindlela zokucindezeleka ezinemibala yemisebe yelanga zivele ngaphakathi kwe-ruler epulasitiki ebonakalayo lapho zibukwa phakathi kwezihlungi ezimbili zokuhlunga eziphambene (Photoelasticity)?
options: Ukucindezeleka komshini kudala i-birefringence yesikhashana, kushintsha ijubane lesigaba phakathi kwezinto ezihlukaniswe ngokukhanya
correctAnswer: Ukucindezeleka komshini kudala i-birefringence yesikhashana, kushintsha ijubane lesigaba phakathi kwezinto ezihlukaniswe ngokukhanya
explanation: UBrewster wathola imiphumela yokucindezeleka kokukhanya: amashadi wokucindezela komshini adala ukungalingani kokuvezwa kokukhanya endaweni ngokwesilinganiso sokucindezela okuyinhloko (sigma_1 - sigma_2). Izihlungi eziphambene ziveza lezi zikhathi zokulibazisa kwesigaba njengezikhala zemibala yesigaba esifanayo.

question: Kungani ukudlula komthunzi wokukhanya okuhlangene ngokumugqa kwezwe ngokusebenzisa ingilazi efakwe ensimini yamandla kazibuthe eqinile kuvula indawo yokuhlukanisa umbala wokukhanya (Umphumela kaFaraday)?
options: Insimu kazibuthe ihlukanisa amazinga wamandla ama-athomu (umphumela weZeeman), okubangela ukuthi ukukhanya okuhlangene okuphambili nangakwesokudla kuhambe ngamazinga ahlukene wesigaba
correctAnswer: Insimu kazibuthe ihlukanisa amazinga wamandla ama-athomu (umphumela weZeeman), okubangela ukuthi ukukhanya okuhlangene okuphambili nangakwesokudla kuhambe ngamazinga ahlukene wesigaba
explanation: UMichael Faraday wathola i-magneto-optics: insimu kazibuthe ehambisanayo B idala ukuhlukaniswa okungokwesiyingi emigqeni yesikwele. I-engeli yokujikisa yi theta = V * B * L, lapho u-V engumlinganiso kaVerdet.

question: Kungani isibonisi se-liquid crystal (LCD) siba mnyama ngokuphelele ngokushesha lapho usibuka ngokugoba ikhanda ugqoke izibuko zelanga ezine-polarized?
options: Isihlungi esiphambili se-polarizing sesibuko sibekwe ngokuphambene nesihlungi se-polarizing sezibuko zelanga, sivimbe yonke imisebe ekudlula
Izikrini ze-LCD zivaliwe lapho amakhamera ezibuka
Ingilazi e-polarized idedela amandla ebhethri lesibuko
Izibuko zelanga zibuyisela ukukhanya okuyingqayizivele esibukweni
correctAnswer: Isihlungi esiphambili se-polarizing sesibuko sibekwe ngokuphambene nesihlungi se-polarizing sezibuko zelanga, sivimbe yonke imisebe ekudlula
explanation: Umthetho ka-Malus ukhomba ubukhona bokudlula I = I_0 * cos^2(theta). Lapho i-axis ye-polarizing yezibuko ijikeleza ngo-90 degrees uma iqhathaniswa nepolarizer ephumayo yesibuko, cos(90) = 0 futhi ukudlula kwehla kuya ku-zero.

question: Kungenziwa kanjani i-lens yeglasi ebukekayo ingaphenduki ngokugcwele ngokubeka ungqimba lwekhemikhali oluphakeme kakhulu (ukungqubuzana okubhubhisayo)?
options: Ubukhulu bongqimba buhlela kuyi-kwashi yomthombo wokukhanya, okubangela ukuthi izibuko ezivela phezulu naphansi ziqedeleka ngokuphambene
Ungqimba luthatha wonke ama-photon abuyele emuva
correctAnswer: Ubukhulu bongqimba buhlela kuyi-kwashi yomthombo wokukhanya, okubangela ukuthi izibuko ezivela phezulu naphansi ziqedeleka ngokuphambene
explanation: Ungqimba ngobukhulu d = lambda / (4 * n_film) udala umehluko womzila we-half-wavelength oya emuva naphambili (ukushintshela kwe-180-degree phase). Amaza amabili abuyiselwe aphikisana ngokuphelele, adlulisela amandla ku-100% transmission.

question: Kungani imikroskopu enama-optics eglasi evamile ifinyelela emkhawulweni oyisisekelo, ongadluleki wokulungiswa cishe ku-200 nanometers (Umkhawulo Wokuhlambalaza ka-Abbe)?
options: Ukuphambuka: ama-wave okuhlaza adlula ngaphesheya kwe-aperture encane asabalale, enza ama-Airydisk ahlangana ngokuxubile uma eduze kuno lambda / (2 * NA)
Amalensi eglasi anyibilika ngaphansi kwemalambu yemikroskopu
Amashidi emikroskopu ayashukuma ngenxa komsindo wasekamagumbini
correctAnswer: Ukuphambuka: ama-wave okuhlaza adlula ngaphesheya kwe-aperture encane asabalale, enza ama-Airydisk ahlangana ngokuxubile uma eduze kuno lambda / (2 * NA)
explanation: U-Ernst Abbe wafakazela ukuthi ukuphambuka kwamagagasi kubeka ibanga elincane elingaxazululeki d = lambda / (2 * n * sin alpha). Izici ezincane kunengxenye yesigaba sokukhanya okubonakalayo azikwazi ukuhlukaniswa kusetshenziswa ama-optics angaphandle.

question: Uhlobo lokubona izinto ngokucacile kwe-STED super-resolution microscopy (iNobel Prize kuChemistry ka-2014) lushaye kanjani umgoqo we-Abbe diffraction ukuze kubonwe amaprotheni ngabanye ngaphakathi kwezicubu eziphilayo?
options: Ngokusebenzisa i-laser beam elenziwe ngendlela ye-doughnut ukuze icime ukukhanya okukhanyayo eduze kwendawo egxile kuyo, kushiye kuphela isitshalo esincane esingaphansi kwe-diffraction esikhanyisa
correctAnswer: Ngokusebenzisa i-laser beam elenziwe ngendlela ye-doughnut ukuze icime ukukhanya okukhanyayo eduze kwendawo egxile kuyo, kushiye kuphela isitshalo esincane esingaphansi kwe-diffraction esikhanyisa
explanation: UStefan Hell waphula umgoqo we-Abbe ngokusebenzisa i-stimulated emission depletion (STED). I-laser elenziwe ngendlela ye-doughnut icindezela ukukhishwa kwesemvelo ngasemaphethelweni, inciphisa indawo ephuma ukukhanya ukuba cishe ama-nm angu-20.

question: Kungani iwashi le-atomic kumasathelayithi e-GPS lishukuma cishe imizuzwana engu-38 ngosuku uma liqhathaniswa namawashi angaphezulu komhlaba uma lingalungiswa?
options: I-Special Relativity icindezela amawashi esathelayithi ngo-7 microseconds (isivinini), kanti i-General Relativity iyawasheshisa ngo-45 microseconds (umthwalo wempi onzima kancane)
Umoya welanga ufaka amandla emijikelezweni yesathelayithi
correctAnswer: I-Special Relativity icindezela amawashi esathelayithi ngo-7 microseconds (isivinini), kanti i-General Relativity iyawasheshisa ngo-45 microseconds (umthwalo wempi onzima kancane)
explanation: Ukwehla kwesikhathi kwe-kinematic kunciphisa iwashi elihambayo: -7 microseconds/ngosuku. Ukushintsha kombala we-gravitational kukhuphula iwashi eliphakeme: +45 microseconds/ngosuku. Ukuhamba okuhlangene kungu +38 microseconds/ngosuku, okubangela amaphutha okuzulazula angama-11 km ngosuku uma kungenandaba.

question: Kungani iwashi likagogo eline-pendulum elihambayo ligijima kancane uma lidluliselwa ukusuka eNyakatho Polusi liye ku-equator?
options: Umhlaba uyisifophido esibanzi phakathi nendawo enesisindo esikhuphukayo kancane ekuqaleni, nokusheshisa okuphuma emuva, okwehlisa ukumelana komhlaba okusebenzayo g
Ukushisa okungaphakathi kwe-Equator kuyashisa amazinyo edreyini yebhrashi
Umoya oshisayo ongaphakathi kwezindawo ezifudumele wongeza isisindo kupendulum
correctAnswer: Umhlaba uyisifophido esibanzi phakathi nendawo enesisindo esikhuphukayo kancane ekuqaleni, nokusheshisa okuphuma emuva, okwehlisa ukumelana komhlaba okusebenzayo g
explanation: Isikhathi T = 2*pi * sqrt(L / g). Ukuzungeleka komhlaba kudala ukuncipha kwe-centrifugal Delta g_cent ~ 0.034 m/s^2, futhi izinga lolwandle eceleni kwe-equator likude ngamakhilomitha angama-21 ukusuka enkabeni yomhlaba, okwehlisa g futhi kwande isikhathi se-pendulum.

question: Kungani amawashi we-pendulum anamathela odongeni olulodwa noma amapayipi e-organ afakwe esikhwameni esisodwa ehlanganisa ukujikeleza kwawo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi (Ukuvumelanisa kukaHuygens)?
options: Ukuqhuma okuncane kwemishini okudluliselwa odongeni olusekela kuxhumanisa ama-oscillator, kubashayele ku-cycle elinganisiwe yokuphikisana
correctAnswer: Ukuqhuma okuncane kwemishini okudluliselwa odongeni olusekela kuxhumanisa ama-oscillator, kubashayele ku-cycle elinganisiwe yokuphikisana
explanation: UChristiaan Huygens wabona ngo-1665 ukuthi amawashi amabili olwandle avumelanisa izinga lawo lokuzwa. Amandla aguquguqukayo adluliselwa ngomaki wodlwana ovamile ahlanganisa izici ze-cycle engalingani.

question: Kungani isisindo esisindayo sensimbi esisendaweni ye-spring esibhekene nokuzamazama okuvame ukuphindaphindwa sifinyelela ama-amplitude amakhulu, awonakalisayo ngokweqile endaweni ethile yamazinyo (Mechanical Resonance)?
options: Ijubane lokushayela lihambisana nejubane lemvelo yokuzamazama kohlelo, lihambisa amandla amakhulu kakhulu okuphehla ngalinye esigabeni sokuzamazama
Ukumelana komoya kwehla kube ngu-zero ngezivinini eziphezulu
Umgudu wokuqhuba umhlabathi uyaphindeka ngesikhathi se-resonance
correctAnswer: Ijubane lokushayela lihambisana nejubane lemvelo yokuzamazama kohlelo, lihambisa amandla amakhulu kakhulu okuphehla ngalinye esigabeni sokuzamazama
explanation: Lapho ijubane lokushayela omega lilingana nejubane lemvelo omega_0 = sqrt(k/m), ukuhlukana kwesigaba kungama-90 degrees. Amandla okungena P = F(t) * v(t) ahlala engalungile, ephonsa amandla okuqhubeka kuze kube yilapho ukumiswa komzuliswano kukhawulela i-amplitude.

question: Kungani iTacoma Narrows Suspension Bridge yagoba yaze yephuka emoyeni ophakathi nendawo onomoya ongu-40 mph ngo-1940 kunokuba iphumelele ezikhukhulsini ezinzima?
options: I-Aeroelastic flutter: ama-vortices omoya aguquguqukayo ahambisana nomvamisa wemvelo wokulunqa kwebhuloho, edala i-loop yokuphindaphinda yokuzikhuthaza engazinzile
correctAnswer: I-Aeroelastic flutter: ama-vortices omoya aguquguqukayo ahambisana nomvamisa wemvelo wokulunqa kwebhuloho, edala i-loop yokuphindaphinda yokuzikhuthaza engazinzile
explanation: Ukudonswa kwe-von Kármán vortex kwakudala ukuklwebheka okuncane. Njengoba idekhi igobe, amandla okuphakamisa emoyeni ashintshe ngezigigaba, ekhipha amandla avela emoyeni omile aye ku-flutter yokuqhumisa okuqatha.

question: Kungani ukuthinta ibhodlela lesoda leglasi eligcwele amanzi kubangela ukuthi umsindo womculo wehle uma uphonsa amabhulebhu emanzini ngethuluzi (umthelela we-Hot Chocolate)?
options: Amabhulebhu omoya afakwa ngaphakathi athuthukisa kakhulu ukuguquguquka kwamanzi, kwehlisa ijubane lomsindo esixubeni solwamanzi nomoya
correctAnswer: Amabhulebhu omoya afakwa ngaphakathi athuthukisa kakhulu ukuguquguquka kwamanzi, kwehlisa ijubane lomsindo esixubeni solwamanzi nomoya
explanation: UFrank Crawford wachaza umthelela we-Hot Chocolate: ijubane lomsindo c = 1 / sqrt(rho * K). Ukwethula amaphesenti angu-1 wamabhulebhu omoya kukhuphula kakhulu ukuguquguquka K, kwehlisa ijubane lomsindo kusuka ku-1400 m/s kuya ku-300 m/s futhi kwehlisa umsindo.

question: Kungani izinto ezinemagneti eziqinile zikhipha umsindo owazwayo wokushisa noma uchungechunge lwezinduku eziphuka uma zinemagneti kancane (Umphumela we-Barkhausen)?
options: Izinhlangothi zokuma komagnetic ezingaphansi zamagumbi zokuma zinqoba ukuphazamiseka kwe-lattice ngomzuzu, kuwela ngokuzumayo, ngokweqile ngezinyathelo ze-quantum
Amanxeba esiliva ayaphuka ngokomzimba ngenxa kokucindezela
correctAnswer: Izinhlangothi zokuma komagnetic ezingaphansi zamagumbi zokuma zinqoba ukuphazamiseka kwe-lattice ngomzuzu, kuwela ngokuzumayo, ngokweqile ngezinyathelo ze-quantum
explanation: U-Heinrich Barkhausen wathola ukuthi izinkambu ezimile zensimbi zangaphandle zidala ukugeleza okungafanele njengoba izindonga zokuma komagnetic zikhulula ekuphazamisweni kwezitini, kukhiqize imisindo kagesi.

question: Kungani amafu amahle anjengezifundo zomoya olwandle enza emazulwini ngezinsuku ezinomoya (Kelvin-Helmholtz Instability)?
options: Ukushefa kwesivinini phakathi kwezendlalelo ezimbili ezisondele zomphunga onobuningi obuhlukile kubangela amafu okubangela amaza okuphenduka abe izintaba ezijikeleza
Izinsalela zezindiza zidonsa amafu abe amaza
Ukushisa kwelanga kushisa amaconsi amanzi abe ngamakhebula
Umthwalo wamafu ubuyela emuva ezindaweni eziphakeme
correctAnswer: Ukushefa kwesivinini phakathi kwezendlalelo ezimbili ezisondele zomphunga onobuningi obuhlukile kubangela amafu okubangela amaza okuphenduka abe izintaba ezijikeleza
explanation: Uma inombolo kaRichardson Ri < 0.25, ukushefa kwesivinini phakathi kwemicu emibili ehlukanisiwe kudlula ukubekwa obala kokuncenga, okubangela ukujikeleza okunamandla kwebhodi ekuphukeni kwama-vortex amafu.

question: Kungani ungqimba olunzima lwe-oyela olubandayo oluphumile phezu kwamanzi afudumele alula luvame ukuvela ngokuzuma lube iminwe efana namakhowe ewela phansi (Ukuqhekeka kwe-Rayleigh-Taylor)?
options: Ukuphazamiseka okuhambisana nokuhlangana phakathi koketshezi olusindayo oluxhaswa uketshezi olula kukhula ngokuphindaphindiwe ngaphansi komhlaba
correctAnswer: Ukuphazamiseka okuhambisana nokuhlangana phakathi koketshezi olusindayo oluxhaswa uketshezi olula kukhula ngokuphindaphindiwe ngaphansi komhlaba
explanation: Lapho uketshezi olunsundu lushesha oluya kokulula, noma iyiphi imithambeka emincane ibona umehluko wokuzikhululwa, ukhuphula amabhala amancane abe yiminwe ewela phansi namabhamuza akhuphukayo.

question: Kungani ukuzama ngokudlulele ukulwa esihlabathini esishisayo kubangela umuntu ukuba enyukele phansi kakhulu, kanti ukuhlala kuthule nokunyakaza kancane kuvumela ukuthi baphaphame?
options: Isihlabathi esishisayo siyisixazululo esinqamulelayo esinciphisa ubuningi esiguquka esimanjemeni uma sikhona ukuphazamiseka kodwa siba yisisindo esinzima uma sime.
Isihlabathi esishisayo sinika ukudonsa phansi okukhangayo.
correctAnswer: Isihlabathi esishisayo siyisixazululo esinqamulelayo esinciphisa ubuningi esiguquka esimanjemeni uma sikhona ukuphazamiseka kodwa siba yisisindo esinzima uma sime.
explanation: Ukugoba komshini kwephuka uhlaka lwezinhlayiya zesihlabathi, kuphahlaza ukuvuthwa okubonakalayo ngezinga le-10. Ubuningi besihlabathi esishisayo (~2 g/cm^3) budlula ubuningi bomuntu, buqinisekisa ukuphaphama uma ukubekezelela kuhlala kunganyakazi.

question: Ingakwazi kanjani 'ikhonkrithi ezelapheka yona' ukuvala ngokuzimela izicucu zalo zangaphakathi lapho amanzi emvula engena emqeleni wezindlu?
options: Amaspore agqunyiweyo ebhaktheriya (Bacillus pseudofirmus) adla izakhamzimba nomoya-mpilo ukuveza itshe eliqinile le-calcium carbonate
I-Khonkrithi iqukethe iglue yamanzi encane kakhulu
correctAnswer: Amaspore agqunyiweyo ebhaktheriya (Bacillus pseudofirmus) adla izakhamzimba nomoya-mpilo ukuveza itshe eliqinile le-calcium carbonate
explanation: U-Henk Jonkers waxuba amaspore ebhaktheriya avikela i-alkali ne-calcium lactate kukhonkrithi. Amanzi angenayo evusa ibhaktheriya, ekhipha itshe le-limestone (CaCO3) elivalela izicucu ezingafinyelela ku-0.8 mm ububanzi.

question: Kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi ukukhanya kwasendaweni eduze kudlule phakathi kwe-vacuum phakathi kwama-prism engilazi amabili ahlukaniswe ngamamitha amancane ngisho nasekuphindeni okuphelele kwangaphakathi (Evanescent Wave Coupling)?
options: I-wave ye-electromagnetic ephenduka kancane ikhula ngaphesheya komkhawulo, idlulisele ama-photon ema-gap angaphansi kwe-wavelength
correctAnswer: I-wave ye-electromagnetic ephenduka kancane ikhula ngaphesheya komkhawulo, idlulisele ama-photon ema-gap angaphansi kwe-wavelength
explanation: Noma ukuphenduka okuphelele kwangaphakathi kubuyisela u-100% wamandla okude, izibalo zika-Maxwell zidinga ukuqhubeka komkhawulo nge-field ye-evanescent ephenduka njenge-exp(-alpha * z), evumela ukuphikiswa kokuphenduka okuphelele kwangaphakathi.

question: Kungani i-optical Kerr shutter ijika i-polarization ye-pulse yokukhanya ngaphakathi koketshezi lapho inkambu kagesi ephezulu ivuswa (i-DC Kerr Effect)?
options: Insimu kagesi enamandla ihlela ama-molecule wamanzi ane-polar, idala ukuhlukana kwamehlo okwesikhashana okulingana nesikwele sensimu
Insimu kagesi ifudumeza uketshezi kuze kube khanya
Amandla kagesi aphezulu aguqula uketshezi lube isibuko
correctAnswer: Insimu kagesi enamandla ihlela ama-molecule wamanzi ane-polar, idala ukuhlukana kwamehlo okwesikhashana okulingana nesikwele sensimu
explanation: UJohn Kerr wathola ukuthi ama-dielectrics ane-isotropic (njenge-nitrobenzene) aphenduka abe ne-optical anisotropic ngaphansi kwe-voltage ephakeme: Delta n = lambda * B * E^2, okuvumela ukushintsha kwe-optical okusheshayo kakhulu kwe-picosecond.

question: Kungani i-Angle kaBrewster isetshenziswa kumalaza egasi anamandla kakhulu ukuze kutholwe ukudluliswa kokukhanya okuphelele (100%) ngokusebenzisa amawindi empahla ngaphandle kokulahlekelwa ukubonakaliswa?
options: Ukhanyiso oluqondiswe ngokulandelana neplanethi yokufika (p-polarized) alunabo ubuyekezwa ku-Angle kaBrewster, luthumela okuphelele (100%) endaweni
Ku-Angle kaBrewster ukukhanya kuyashesha kuze kube unomphela
correctAnswer: Ukhanyiso oluqondiswe ngokulandelana neplanethi yokufika (p-polarized) alunabo ubuyekezwa ku-Angle kaBrewster, luthumela okuphelele (100%) endaweni
explanation: Ku-theta_B = arctan(n2/n1), imisebe ebonakaliswayo neguquliwe ime ngaphezulu (amadegree angu-90). Ama-dipole kagesi akhuphuka ebusweni angeke akwazi ukukhanya ngokuhamba kwawo, okuholela ekubuyekezweni okungaphansi (zero reflection).

question: Kungani u-Alan Turing efakazele ukuthi akunakwenzeka ngokwezibalo ukubhala uhlelo lwekhompyutha oluyinhloko olungakwazi ukunquma ukuthi yiluphi uhlelo nganoma yisiphi isikhathi luzophela noma luzoqhubeka unomphela (Inkinga Yokuma)?
options: Ukuphikisana okusho ngokwakho: ukufaka uhlelo oluphikisiwe kulo uqobo kudala iphutha lengqondo elingagwemeki (i-diagonalization)
Imishini ka-Turing ayinayo ijubane lekhalenda elanele
correctAnswer: Ukuphikisana okusho ngokwakho: ukufaka uhlelo oluphikisiwe kulo uqobo kudala iphutha lengqondo elingagwemeki (i-diagonalization)
explanation: UTuring wasebenzisa i-diagonalization ka-Cantor: cabanga uhlelo H(P, i) oluthatha isinqumo sokuma. Yakha uhlelo D oluma uma u-H uthi luhamba, futhi luhambe uma u-H uthi luma. Ukuqhuba u-D(D) kukhiqiza ukuphikisana okuqondile.

question: Iyiphi iqiniso elibuhlungu mayelana nezibalo evezwe yiSaziso sokuqala sokuFaka kwezingaphelele sikaKurt Gödel ngo-1931?
options: Noma yiliphi uhlelo lwesibalo oluhlelekile nolusemthethweni olwazi ukufaka izibalo eziyisisekelo luqukethe izitatimende eziyiqiniso ezingasoze zafakazelwa ngaphakathi kohlelo.
correctAnswer: Noma yiliphi uhlelo lwesibalo oluhlelekile nolusemthethweni olwazi ukufaka izibalo eziyisisekelo luqukethe izitatimende eziyiqiniso ezingasoze zafakazelwa ngaphakathi kohlelo.
explanation: UGödel wakha isitatimende esizikhombisayo G: 'Lesi sitatimende asikwazi kufakazelwa ohlelweni T'. Uma u-G ungafakazelwa, u-T awuhambisani; uma u-G ungafakazelwa, u-G uyikho, kufakazela ukuthi u-T awugcwaliseki.

question: Esayensini yekhompyutha engqondweni, iyiphi imibuzo eyinhloko ephakanyiswa inkinga ye-Millennium Prize enenani elingamamilionu edola ethi 'P versus NP'?
options: Ingabe zonke izinkinga zekhompyutha lapho isixazululo esiphakanyisiwe singaqinisekiswa ngokushesha (ngesikhathi sepolynomial) zingaxazululwa ngokushesha futhi
correctAnswer: Ingabe zonke izinkinga zekhompyutha lapho isixazululo esiphakanyisiwe singaqinisekiswa ngokushesha (ngesikhathi sepolynomial) zingaxazululwa ngokushesha futhi
explanation: I-P iwuhlobo lwezinkinga ezingaxazululwa ngesikhathi sepolynomial; i-NP iwuhlobo lwezinkinga ezingaqinisekiswa ngesikhathi sepolynomial. Uma P = NP, khona-ke ukuthola umbhontshisi engqondweni yezembe kube lula ngokwekhompyutha njengokumazi umbhontshisi uma sewutholakele.

question: Kungani i-zero-player cellular automaton kaJohn Conway ethi 'The Game of Life' ifakazelwe ukuthi iyakwazi ukwenza i-Turing-Complete?
options: Imithetho yayo elula ye-grid ye-2D yeseli esiphilayo nesesefile ingalingisa amasango e-logic, amarejista wememori, futhi ifanekise noma yiliphi ikhompiyutha elijwayelekile
correctAnswer: Imithetho yayo elula ye-grid ye-2D yeseli esiphilayo nesesefile ingalingisa amasango e-logic, amarejista wememori, futhi ifanekise noma yiliphi ikhompiyutha elijwayelekile
explanation: Amaglidha, izibhamu ze-glider, kanye nabadliakudla sakha izixhumanisi ze-logic (amasango e-AND, OR, NOT) namathayiphu okugcina agudlukayo. Ngenxa yalokho, i-Game of Life ingalingisa noma yiliphi i-algorithm noma umshini ogcwele we-Turing.

question: Kungani umsebenzi we-Busy Beaver u-BB(n)—inani eliphezulu lezinyathelo umshini we-Turing onamazinga n ongawenza ngaphambi kokumisa—ungakwazi ukubalwa ngokuyisisekelo?
options: Ukukhula kwawo ngokushesha kakhulu kunazo zonke izindlela ezibalekayo ezingachazwa noma zinhlelwe emathematics
Imishini ye-Turing iphela iphepha layo lokushayela
correctAnswer: Ukukhula kwawo ngokushesha kakhulu kunazo zonke izindlela ezibalekayo ezingachazwa noma zinhlelwe emathematics
explanation: UTibor Radó wafakazela ukuthi uma u-BB(n) ubungabaliwe, umuntu angaxazulula Inkinga Yokumisa ngokulingisa noma yimuphi umshini onezinga n izinyathelo ze-BB(n). Ngakho-ke u-BB(n) uwela zonke izindlela ezingaphakathi, kuhlanganise ne-Ackermann.

question: Esicabangweni esidumile sikaJohn Searle sokuhlola 'Igumbi LaseShayina', kungani ukuphatha amakhadi esibazi ngaphakathi kwegumbi elivaliwe kwehluleka ukuba ubuhlakani bokwenziwa beqiniso?
options: Isakhiwo asilingani nencazelo: ukulandela imithetho ngokuphelele ngaphandle kwenjongo, incazelo yomuntu siqu, nokuqonda kweqiniso
correctAnswer: Isakhiwo asilingani nencazelo: ukulandela imithetho ngokuphelele ngaphandle kwenjongo, incazelo yomuntu siqu, nokuqonda kweqiniso
explanation: USearle waphikisa ukuthi umuntu ongayiqondi nhlobo iShayina angalandela incwadi yemithetho yesiNgisi ukuze aphumeze izimpendulo eziqondile zesiShayina. Uhlelo lunezimpawu zokusebenza kwezimpawu ngaphandle kokuqukethwe okunezinjongo.

question: Ebumqondweni bomcabango ka-Frank Jackson othi 'Igumbi likaMary', yisiphi isifundo sezifilosofi esivela lapho uMary—onguchwepheshe we-neuroscience owaziyo yonke imininingwane ngokombono wobomvu ephuma ekamelweni elimnyama nelimhlophe—aphuma ngaphandle futhi abone imbali ebomvu?
options: Uzuza ulwazi olungokungokwemvelo (qualia), okubonisa ukuthi i-physicalism ayikwazi ukuchaza ngokuphelele ulwazi lokuzibona
Amehlo akhe ayakhala ngenxa yokukhanya kwelanga
correctAnswer: Uzuza ulwazi olungokungokwemvelo (qualia), okubonisa ukuthi i-physicalism ayikwazi ukuchaza ngokuphelele ulwazi lokuzibona
explanation: I-Knowledge Argument ifakazela ukuthi naphezu kokwazi yonke imininingwane emayelana nomzimba (amalingeza, ukuqhuma kwemizwa yomzimba), ukubona okubomvu kunikeza uMary ulwazi olusha lokuhlangenwe nakho 'ukuthi yini okufana nokuyibona' okubomvu (qualia).

question: Yini i-'Philosophical Zombie' (p-zombie) emfundisweni kaDavid Chalmers ngomqondo wengqondo?
options: Isidalwa esicabanga ngokusobala nesibukeka ngokomzimba njengomuntu kunoma yiliphi imininingwane engaphansi kwe-athomu, kodwa esingenakho ngokuphelele isipiliyoni somqondo osobala
Umuntu oshonile ophiliswe kabusha ngotshwala bamangqamuzana
I-robot efana nomuntu egqoke isikhumba sesilicone
correctAnswer: Isidalwa esicabanga ngokusobala nesibukeka ngokomzimba njengomuntu kunoma yiliphi imininingwane engaphansi kwe-athomu, kodwa esingenakho ngokuphelele isipiliyoni somqondo osobala
explanation: UChalmers usebenzisa ama-p-zombies ukwenza Umbuzo Onzima Wokuphila Ngokuqonda: uma umhlaba we-zombie ungacabangwa ngokwe-logical lapho wonke amaqiniso omzimba egcina ngaphandle kwe-qualia, umqondo awusophelele ngokomzimba kuphela.

question: Ku-Teletransporter Paradox ka-Derek Parfit, umshini uhlole ama-athomu akho, ubhujise umzimba wakho eMhlabeni, bese uphinde wakhe ikhophi efanayo ngokomzimba ngomzimba kuwela eMars. Ingabe wahamba waya eMars, noma wabulawa?
options: Uma ubuqotho bomuntu budinga ukusinda okuqhubekayo ngokomzimba, wabulawa wathathelwa indawo yikhophi engokomqondo efanayo
Isikhangeli siguqula izinto zibe amandla acocekile
correctAnswer: Uma ubuqotho bomuntu budinga ukusinda okuqhubekayo ngokomzimba, wabulawa wathathelwa indawo yikhophi engokomqondo efanayo
explanation: UParfit wasebenzisa lokhu ukuphikisa imibono enganciki ekwehliseni ngobuqotho bomuntu: ukuqhubeka Kokomqondo kugcinwa, kodwa uma umshini wokuqala uhluleka ukubhubhisa umzimba waseMhlabeni, kuzoba khona ababili abefanayo 'ini wena' ngesikhathi esisodwa.

question: Kwi-'Swampman' yocwaningo lwengqondo ka-Donald Davidson, izikhukhula zihlaba ichibi, ngesikhathi esifanayo zidiliza u-Davidson futhi ngokungahleliwe zihlele uthuli lwesichibi lube ikhophi yakhe efanayo yomzimba. Ingabe i-Swampman inemicabango?
options: I-Externalism ithi i-Swampman ayinakho okuqukethwe kwengqondo kweqiniso ngoba izimo zengqondo zakhe azinayo inhlobonhlobo yomlando wokubangela emhlabeni wangempela.
ISwampman incibilika ibuye ibe ulwembu oluhlaza
Isikhukhula sishaya uhlelo lwakhe lokukhuluma ngogesi
correctAnswer: I-Externalism ithi i-Swampman ayinakho okuqukethwe kwengqondo kweqiniso ngoba izimo zengqondo zakhe azinayo inhlobonhlobo yomlando wokubangela emhlabeni wangempela.
explanation: I-Semantic externalism ithi incazelo nezimo zengqondo kuncike emlandweni wokubangela nezinto ezisemvelweni. ISwampman uyabazi abangane baka-Davidson ngokwakheka okungahleliwe kuphela ngaphandle kokubhekiseleka emlandweni.

question: Ezibonelweni ezidumile zango-1963 zika-Edmund Gettier, kungani ukuba ne-‘Ukukholwa Okusekelwe Futhi Okuyiqiniso’ kuboniswa njengokunganele ukuze kube Nolwazi Lwangempela?
options: Izinkolelo zingase zixhaswe futhi zibe yiqiniso ngokweqiniso ngenxa yenhlanhla engokwemvelo noma ukuhambisana
correctAnswer: Izinkolelo zingase zixhaswe futhi zibe yiqiniso ngokweqiniso ngenxa yenhlanhla engokwemvelo noma ukuhambisana
explanation: UGettier waphikisa incazelo yendabuko kaPlato yolwazi: uma uJohn enobufakazi obuqinile bokuthi uSmith unayo iFord, futhi ngenhlanhla umngane wakhe uBrown akhona eBarcelona, ukukholwa kwakhe okuyiqiniso kusekelwe enhlanhleni engahleliwe.

question: Enkinga kaMolyneux ebibuzelwe kuJohn Locke ngo-1688, uma indoda ezalwe ingasakwazi ukubona ifunda ukuhlukanisa ibhola nekhyuzi ngokuthinta kuphela, ingakwazi yini ukuziqaphela ngokubona uma ukubona kwayo kubuyiselwa ngokuzumayo?
options: Okuhlolwayo ngokuqinisekile kubonisa cha: ukuhlela okungaphakathi kokuthinta nokubona kufanele kufundwe ngomuzwa wokuzwa
Cha, amehlo abuyiselwe angabona kuphela okubomvu
correctAnswer: Okuhlolwayo ngokuqinisekile kubonisa cha: ukuhlela okungaphakathi kokuthinta nokubona kufanele kufundwe ngomuzwa wokuzwa
explanation: Uhlelo lukaPrakash lwahlola iziguli ezingazibonanga ezazibuyiselwa ukubona emigqeni yesiguli. Iziguli zazikwazi ukuhlukanisa izimo ngokubona, kodwa zahluleka ukuhlela izinkumbulo zokuthinta ezintsha ezithombeni zokubona ngaphandle komzamo.

question: Ku-Sorites Paradox (iPhutha le-Heap), ukususa iqhwa elilodwa lesihlabathi esiqwini kusashiya isiqwenga. Kungani lokhu kudala inkinga engaxazululeki ngokwengqondo?
options: Ukuphindaphinda ukusebenzisa isimiso sokuphakamisa esingenakho ukuphikisana kuphoqa isiphetho esingenangqondo sokuthi iqhwa elilodwa lesihlabathi liyisiqwenga ngenxa yemingcele egungxile yencazelo
correctAnswer: Ukuphindaphinda ukusebenzisa isimiso sokuphakamisa esingenakho ukuphikisana kuphoqa isiphetho esingenangqondo sokuthi iqhwa elilodwa lesihlabathi liyisiqwenga ngenxa yemingcele egungxile yencazelo
explanation: Le paradox ikhombisa inkinga yokungacaci ku-logic yamasiko emigqeni emibili: izimpendulo zolimi lwemvelo ('isiqwenga', 'ihlazo') azinayo imingcele ecacile, okuphonsela inselelo umbono obili kanye ne-modus ponens.

question: Kungani iphuzu elidumile likaBertrand Russell mayelana 'nesethi yonkana yezinhlelo ezingazifaki zona ngokwazo' laqula izisekelo zefomula yesethi?
options: Uma isethi ingeyayo, iphula incazelo yayo; uma ingeyayo, kufanele ibe yayo ngokwayo (R ku-R <=> R akukona ku-R)
Zero ayikwazi ukuba inombolo evunyelwe yezibalo
correctAnswer: Uma isethi ingeyayo, iphula incazelo yayo; uma ingeyayo, kufanele ibe yayo ngokwayo (R ku-R <=> R akukona ku-R)
explanation: Ifomula yesethi elula ivumela ukuqonda okungenamkhawulo {x : P(x)}. Iphuzu likaRussell libonise ukuthi ukuqonda okulula kuholela ekuphikisaneni okungabulala, okwenza kudingeke ifomula yezinhlelo zeZermelo-Fraenkel enezigaba zezinhlobo.

question: Kungani i-Berry's Paradox ('Inani elincane elingezwakali incazelo ngaphansi kwamagama ayishumi nanye') iyinqaba yokuziphikisa kolimi nokuqonda?
options: Lesi sibongo siqukethe amagama ayishumi ngqo futhi sichaza inombolo, ngokushesha ukuphula umqondo wokuthi inombolo ayinakuchazwa ngaphansi kwamagama ayishumi nanye
correctAnswer: Lesi sibongo siqukethe amagama ayishumi ngqo futhi sichaza inombolo, ngokushesha ukuphula umqondo wokuthi inombolo ayinakuchazwa ngaphansi kwamagama ayishumi nanye
explanation: Incazelo yesiNgisi ethi 'Inani elincane elingezwakali incazelo ngaphansi kwamagama ayishumi nanye' inamagama ayi-10. Uma ngempumelelo igama ifaka inombolo N, khona-ke i-N isivele ichazwe ngaphansi kwamagama ayishumi nanye.

question: Indlela iSizathu sikaGeorg Cantor se-Diagonal Argument sbungaza ngayo ukuthi kunenombolo enkulu ye-real numbers (ama-decimal) phakathi kuka-0 no-1 kunezinombolo ezingenamkhawulo zokubala ezihlanganisiwe?
options: Ngokwakha inombolo entsha ye-decimal lapho isikhawu sayo esingu-n sihluke kusikhawu se-n so nombolo ye-n kunoma yiliphi uhlu oluphakanyisiwe, kufakazela ukuthi izinombolo ze-real azibaliwayo.
correctAnswer: Ngokwakha inombolo entsha ye-decimal lapho isikhawu sayo esingu-n sihluke kusikhawu se-n so nombolo ye-n kunoma yiliphi uhlu oluphakanyisiwe, kufakazela ukuthi izinombolo ze-real azibaliwayo.
explanation: UCantor wacabanga ukuthi kukhona uhlu oluphelele lwama-real numbers. Ngokushintsha isikhawu se-diagonal (isb. uma d_nn = 1 setha kube 2), wakhe inombolo ye-real eqinisekisiwe ukuthi ayikho ohlwini, efakazela ukuthi |R| > |N|.

question: Ehhotela likaDavid Hilbert elikhulu elinamagumbi angenamkhawulo agcwele ngokuphelele, umqondisi angakwamukela kanjani kalula isivakashi esisha esifika ngaphandle kokukhulula noma ubani?
options: Ngokudlulisela isivakashi ekamelweni n ukuya ekamelweni n + 1, kuvula Igumbi 1 losivakashi osanda kufika
Ngokwenza izivakashi ezimbili zihlale embhedeni owodwa
correctAnswer: Ngokudlulisela isivakashi ekamelweni n ukuya ekamelweni n + 1, kuvula Igumbi 1 losivakashi osanda kufika
explanation: UHilbert wakhombisa izibalo ezingaqondakali zezinkulu ezingenamkhawulo: aleph_0 + 1 = aleph_0. Ukudlulisela umhlali ngamunye ekamelweni n+1 kuvula igumbi 1 ngenkathi wonke umuntu esengumhlali wegumbi lomuntu siqu.

question: Kungani ukubikezela isimo sezulu sesikhathi eside ngaphezu kwezinsuku eziyi-10 kuya kweziyi-14 kungelula nhlobo, ngisho noma sinesibalo esingenamkhawulo samakhompyutha asheshayo (Umthelela weBhuthelefisi)?
options: Ubuhlakani be-Deterministic Chaos: izindlela ezingajwayelekile zomoya zibonisa ukuzwela kakhulu kwizimo zokuqala, lapho amaphutha amancane okulinganisa ekhula ngokushesha
Izindiza zomkhathi zeweather satellites ziphela uwoyela

question: Enkinga Yezinto Ezintathu, kungani kungekho uhlaka lwezibalo olujwayelekile olungavala ukuhlela ukuhamba okuqondile kwezinto ezintathu ezinamandla adonsela emhlabeni ezizungezana phakathi kwazo?

question: Kungani i-Fitch's Paradox of Knowability ifakazela ngokwengqondo ukuthi uma zonke izimanga zingaba khona ukwaziwa, khona-ke zonke izimanga kufanele sezivele zaziwa njengamanje?

question: Ngokwe-Theorem kaRice kwesayensi yekhompyutha, yisiphi isici esisemqoka semanejanethi ye-computer esinganqunywa nge-algorithm?

question: Kungani usesosayensi wezibalo uPaul Erdős ethi 'Izibalo zingase zingakakulungeli lezi zinselele' lapho ekhuluma nge-Collatz Conjecture (inhloso ye-3n + 1)?

question: Iphi into emangalisayo yezenzakalo zomzimba yomhlaba wonke eyatholakala nguMitchell Feigenbaum ngo-1978 mayelana nokudlulela okuhlelelwe ekudidekeni (Feigenbaum Constant delta = 4.6692016...)?

question: Kungani umngcele we-Mandelbrot Set—okhiqizwa ngokuphindaphinda isibalo esilula se-quadratic z = z^2 + c—waziwa njengento enobunzima obukhulu kakhulu kumathematics?

correctAnswer: Ibonisa amaphethini e-fractal ayinkimbinkimbi angenamkhawulo, angaphindi, afana nawo ngokwawo ane-dimension ye-Hausdorff yomngcele eyi-2 ngokunembile
explanation: Ukuphindaphinda z_(n+1) = z_n^2 + c ngenombolo eziyingqayizivele c kuhlola ukuthi uchungechunge luhlala lulinganisiwe. UShishikura wafakazela ukuthi umngcele walo unedimension ye-Hausdorff engu-2, uqukethe izinqumo ezincane ezingapheliwona kanye nohlaka lwejiyometri olungapheli.

question: Kungani i-Lorenz Strange Attractor kwi-chaos theory idweba umjikelezo osuka kumfanekiso wenyosi ongaphindaphindi noma ungahlangani nomzila wayo?

correctAnswer: Indlela ihlale ngaphakathi kwesikhala esilinganiselwe se-3D kodwa ine-fractal dimension engu-2.06, okudala ubude obungenamkhawulo ngaphandle kokuzihlanganisa

question: Kwisayensi yokushisa kwezibalo, uJ. Willard Gibbs waxazulula kanjani 'iGibbs Paradox' lapho ukuhlanganisa iziqukathi ezimbili ezifanayo zegesi ye-ideal efanayo bekubikezela okungeyikho ukwanda kwe-entropy?

question: Kungani uJosef Loschmidt ephikisa ukuthi Umthetho Wesibili Wezokushisa uhambisana nemishini yeklasi (Ipharadesi likaLoschmidt / Ipharadesi Lokuphenduka)?

question: Kungani 'Isiphakamiso Sangesikhathi Esedlule' sikaDavid Albert sisadingeka ukuze sichaze ukuthi kungani sikhumbula esikhathini esedlule kodwa singakwazi ukukhumbula ikusasa?

explanation: Ithini elilodwa elijikeleza liyenza njenge-gyroscope enkulu; ukuhamba komkhathi kungadala ukuphenduka kwe-gyroscopic, kulahlekelwe ukuhambisana nelanga. Izindibano ezifanayo eziphikisanayo ziletha ingqondo yokujikeleza engu-zero.

question: Kungani umakhi wezobuciko besayensi owaziwayo uLarry Niven we-megastructure yakhe ethi 'Ringworld' engazinzile ngokomzimba eduze kwenkanyezi ephakathi?

Indandatho ijikeleza ngokushesha kakhulu futhi idubula umoya wayo
Umlando wesayensi wamandla eplanethi uphahlazekile odonga

question: Kungani indlela enkulu ebizwa ngokuthi i-Shkadov Thruster ingahambisa kancane yonke inkanyezi ngokuhamba kwesikhathi naphakathi kwesikhala phakathi kwezinkanyezi eminyakeni eyizigidi?

Ngokunamathisela ama-rocket boosters ekuhambeni kwe-equta yenkanyezi
Ngokudubula izibhamu ze-antimatter ngaphakathi enhliziyweni yenkanyezi
correctAnswer: Isibuko esikhulu esimile esigoqekayo sime phezu kwenkanyezi, sibuyisela ingxenye ye-pressure yayo yokukhanya ukuze kudaleke ukuqhuma okungalingani kwegqugquzela
explanation: ULeonid Shkadov waklama uhlobo lwe-A lwenjini yenkanyezi: isibuko esikhulu se-statite silinganisa umfutho wokukhanya ngokumelene nomdonsiswano. Ukukhanya okubonisiwe kwekhiqiza ukufudumala kwe-photon, okuqondisa iLanga cishe ku-100 km/s eminyakeni engu-10^8.

question: Kungani Impikiswano kaNick Bostrom ye-Simulation iphetha ngokuthi cishe nakanjani uphila ku-simulation yekhompyutha yezihlobo zakho ezingaphambili?

Ubuchopho bomuntu buqhuba ngokusebenzisa amasignali kagesi angu-5-volt
Izibuko zekhompyutha ziphinde zibuyekeze ku-60 Hertz
Ukulahleka kwememori kufakazela amaphutha kwi-hard drive

question: Kuhlelo lokucabanga lwe-Quantum Suicide / Quantum Immortality, kungani umhloli ohlushwa isikhali se-quantum esisebenza ngokuzenzakalelayo ekholelwa ukuthi akanasiphelo sokufa?

question: Kwezemvelo zokuhamba ngesikhathi, umthetho we-Novikov Self-Consistency uqeda kanjani i-Grandfather Paradox ngaphandle kokudala izikhathi ezihambisanayo eziningi?

explanation: U-Igor Novikov uphakamise ukuthi imithetho yemvelo yasendaweni isebenza emhlabeni wonke ezindaweni ezivaliwe zesikhathi. Noma yisiphi isenzo somhambeli wesikhathi kumele sesivele siyingxenye ehlanganisiwe, engaphikisi umlando wesikhathi esidlule.

question: Yini i-Bootstrap Paradox (Ontological Paradox) ekuhambahambeni kwesikhathi ngokwesimo jikelele?

question: Yiliphi isixazululo esiyinqaba kwi-Einstein's Field Equations esatholakala ngumqaphi wezibalo u-Kurt Gödel ngo-1949 esasimangaza u-Einstein ngosuku lwakhe lokuzalwa lwama-70?

explanation: IMetric ka-Gödel iyisixazululo esiqondile se-cosmological esine-constant yesikhala nesikhathi engelona-zero kanye nezinto ezijikelezayo ezifanayo. Iqukethe imijikelezo yesikhathi evalekile kuyo yonke indawo, ekhombisa ukuthi isikhathi asinakuba ngokuqondile.

question: Kungani insika ende ngokungenamkhawulo, egijimayo ngokushesha yensimbi ye-neutron eqinile kakhulu ikhona ekwazi ukuvumela ukuhamba kwesikhathi emuva kuGeneral Relativity (iTipler Cylinder)?

Insika incibilikisa ama-athomu ibe ama-chroniton acocekile
correctAnswer: Ukudonswa kwemfram ephasikayo okuqine kakhulu kushukuma isikhala nesikhathi ngendlela enobuhlungu kangangokuthi imikhawulo yokukhanya iyalukhukhumala edlula ophahleni, iguqula izindlela zesikhala zibe izindlela zesikhathi ezivaliwe
explanation: UFrank Tipler wabonisa ukuthi eduze kwensika engenamkhawulo ejikeleza ngesigamu sebanga lokukhanya, ukudonswa kwemfram ephasikayo kushukumeza imikhawulo yokukhanya iye ngokuqonde toroidal, okuvumela umkhumbi ongaphansi kokukhanya ojikeleza insika ukubuyela ngaphambi kokuba ushiye.

question: Kungani ukugcina umlomo wewormhole ongahambeki (ibhuloho lika-Einstein-Rosen) uvulekile ngokomzimba kudinga izinto ezingavamile ezine-mass engalungile noma ubukhulu bamagquma okungewona omuhle?
options: Amandla ajwayelekile okudonsela phansi avala umsila kamoya ngesivinini sokukhanya, ngakho-ke amandla angalungile adingeka ukuze enze ukumelana nokudonsela phansi futhi uwuvule
Into ethile enhle ayinyibilika ngaphakathi kwezimfoloko zomgodi
Amanxeba ezimpukane adinga iqhwa elingaphansi kwe-zero
correctAnswer: Amandla ajwayelekile okudonsela phansi avala umsila kamoya ngesivinini sokukhanya, ngakho-ke amandla angalungile adingeka ukuze enze ukumelana nokudonsela phansi futhi uwuvule
explanation: UMorris noThorne babonise ukuthi izimbobo zezinyoka ezingadlula zigqekeza i-Null Energy Condition (NEC: T_munu k^mu k^nu >= 0). Kuphela amandla amancane (njengezikhalazo ze-Casimir vacuum) akhiqiza ukugxilisa okuphikisayo okudingekayo ukuvimbela ukuwa.

question: Iyiphi into yezinkanyezi esebenzisa imfundiso ebhalwe phansi esibikezelwa ngokwesibalo yi-General Relativity njengezithombe eziqondile zomzuzu oshintshwe emuva we-Black Hole (i-White Hole)?
options: Umngcele wezehlakalo lapho izinto nokukhanya kungaphuma kuphela ngaphandle, kodwa akukho lutho olungangena emhlabeni wangaphandle
correctAnswer: Umngcele wezehlakalo lapho izinto nokukhanya kungaphuma kuphela ngaphandle, kodwa akukho lutho olungangena emhlabeni wangaphandle
explanation: Ama-white hole ayizandiso eziphelele ze-analytical ze-Schwarzschild metric. Ngenkathi ama-black hole engamatemu lapho lutho olungaphunyuki khona, ama-white hole anemigqa yezenzakalo zangaphambili lapho izinto ziphuma khona njalo futhi ukungena kwangaphandle akunakwenzeka.

question: Iyiphi uguquko oluhlukumezayo lwe-topological yesikhathi nendawo eyabikezelwa nguJohn Archibald Wheeler ukuthi luzokwenzeka ezingeni le-subatomic le-Planck (Quantum Foam)?
options: Isikhathi nendawo siyayeka ukuba bushelelezi futhi siqhubeke, siguquke saba umkhovu onobunzima we-quantum foam onama-micro-wormholes namabhakabhaka e-topological
