Ama-Photon aphukile abe amabholi ensimbi eqinile
correctAnswer: Isikhathi nendawo siyayeka ukuba bushelelezi futhi siqhubeke, siguquke saba umkhovu onobunzima we-quantum foam onama-micro-wormholes namabhakabhaka e-topological
explanation: Ezingeni eliseduze nobude be-Planck (1.6 x 10^-35 m) nesikhathi se-Planck (5.4 x 10^-44 s), ukungaqiniseki kuka-Heisenberg kudala ukushintsha kwamandla Delta E ~ hbar / Delta t okuguqula i-geometry ibe yi-quantum foam engahleleki.

question: Kungani Ubude bePlanck (1.616 x 10^-35 amamitha) kubhekwa njengobude obufushane kakhulu obunengqondo emzimbeni wezibalo eziyisisekelo?
options: Ukuphenya amabanga amancane kune-Planck kudinga amandla amaningi kangangokuthi kufaka le ndawo ibe mnyama omncane wokuzumeka
Ama-microscope awakwazi ukugxila emisebeni encane yokukhanya
Izilinganiso ziyaphuka ngaphansi kwamandla amancane e-athomu
correctAnswer: Ukuphenya amabanga amancane kune-Planck kudinga amandla amaningi kangangokuthi kufaka le ndawo ibe mnyama omncane wokuzumeka
explanation: Ukuze kuxazululwe ubude Delta x, ama-photon adinga i-momentum p ~ hbar / Delta x. Ukucindezela la mandla ku-Delta x kudala i-Schwarzschild radius r_s = 2GE/c^4 >= Delta x, okwakha imbobo emnyama edla isilinganiso.

question: Kungani igagasi lomsindo we-acoustic osuka ku-jet esheshayo ngenxa ye-sonic boom yayo lisabalala emoyeni njengekoni le-3D kunokuba libe yigagasi le-spherical (i-Mach Cone)?
options: Ukungqubuzana okwakha kwamaza omsindo ayindilinga akhishwa emaphuzwini alandelanayo ohambeni lwendiza kwakha iphaki le-conical tangent
correctAnswer: Ukungqubuzana okwakha kwamaza omsindo ayindilinga akhishwa emaphuzwini alandelanayo ohambeni lwendiza kwakha iphaki le-conical tangent
explanation: Uma isivinini sendiza v sidlula isivinini somsindo c, ama-wavefront ayindilinga akhishwe ahlala ngemuva. I-envelopu yalezi zindilinga ezisefanelweni yakha ikhoni enekona engu-half sin(mu) = c/v = 1/M, lapho ukungqubuzana kwengcindezi kuhlangana khona.

question: Kungani iphrojekthile esheshayo ehamba ngokushesha okukhulu kunesivinini sokukhanya emanzini ikhipha ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka okungajwayelekile (Cherenkov Radiation)?
options: Ingxenye enesifo ibaleka isivinini sendawo sokukhanya esikhuphukile esimeni esiyingozi, idala ulwandle lukackson olufana ne-sonic boom
Amanzi ahlukaniswa abe ama-isotopu aluhlaza kahydrogen
correctAnswer: Ingxenye enesifo ibaleka isivinini sendawo sokukhanya esikhuphukile esimeni esiyingozi, idala ulwandle lukackson olufana ne-sonic boom
explanation: Ngenkathi c emkhathini wendawo ingashintshi, ukukhanya emanzini kuhamba ku-c/n ~ 0.75c. Izingxenye ezinhlayiya ezinamandla ezingaphezu kuka-c/n zipholaza ama-athomu amanzi, zakha ama-wave electromagnetic akhuthazayo ahlukaniswe kahle agxile kuma-wavelength aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka ne-UV.

question: Kungani i-X-ray enomfutho omkhulu noma imisebe ye-gamma edlula ezintweni ezinzima idlula i-Bremsstrahlung ('Imisebe Yokumisa')?
options: Ama-elekthroni ahlawuleke ngokushesha ancishiswa yi-lasi kagesi le-Coulomb lamangqamuzana asindayo, ekhishwa amandla asele njengama-photon
Amaseli ayamunca ama-elekthroni phakathi kwemijikelezo yamaseli
correctAnswer: Ama-elekthroni ahlawuleke ngokushesha ancishiswa yi-lasi kagesi le-Coulomb lamangqamuzana asindayo, ekhishwa amandla asele njengama-photon
explanation: Ifomula ka-Larmor ikhipha ukuthi noma yiliphi ishaja kagesi elisheshisiwe noma elicishisiwe likhipha amandla P = (q^2 * a^2) / (6*pi*epsilon_0*c^3). Ama-elekthroni aphikiswa amasimu e-Coulomb esekela amandla entambo akhipha i-Bremsstrahlung ye-X-ray eqhubekayo.

question: Kungani i-photon ye-gamma enomfutho omkhulu inganyamalala ngokuphelele bese iveza ama-electron kanye ne-positron eduze kwesibindi se-athomu (Ukukhiqizwa Kwezibhamu)?
options: Ukulingana kobukhulu namandla kuka-Einstein (E = mc^2) kuvumela amandla e-photon adlula 1.022 MeV ukuba aguqulwe abe ubukhulu be-particle endaweni ye-Coulomb
correctAnswer: Ukulingana kobukhulu namandla kuka-Einstein (E = mc^2) kuvumela amandla e-photon adlula 1.022 MeV ukuba aguqulwe abe ubukhulu be-particle endaweni ye-Coulomb
explanation: I-equation ka-Dirac imisa ukuthi i-photon enomandla E >= 2 * m_e * c^2 (1.022 MeV) ingaguquka ibe yi-electron kanye ne-positron. Isibindi esibukeli simunca i-momentum ephindayo ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nemithetho yokugcina izinto.

question: Iyiphi inkanyezi eshaye umoya ebangelwa ukwenzeka komzimba wensimu yombane uma i-electron kanye ne-positron zihlangana endaweni ejulile yesikhala sendawo (Ukuqothulwa Kwe-Particle)?
options: Zombili lezi zihlukanisi ziyazilimaza ngokuphelele, ziguqula iphesenti elingu-100 losayizi wazo wokuqina ube ama-gamma-ray photons angu-511 keV abheke komunye nomunye
Zihlangana zibe yingxenye ye-atomu ye-helium engathathi hlangothi
Ziyaqhekeka zibe yimbobo emnyama encane kakhulu
correctAnswer: Zombili lezi zihlukanisi ziyazilimaza ngokuphelele, ziguqula iphesenti elingu-100 losayizi wazo wokuqina ube ama-gamma-ray photons angu-511 keV abheke komunye nomunye
explanation: Ngoba inombolo ye-lepton kanye nokulingana kwamandla (+e no -e), yonke imass yomzimba iguqulwa ibe imisebe kagesi ngokusebenzisa E = mc^2. Ukongiwa kwe-momentum kuqinisekisa ukuthi ama-photon amabili angu-511 keV ahamba ngomugqa owodwa kodwa aqonde ezindleleni eziphambene.

question: Kungani iwashi le-athomu elisebhasini elisheshayo kakhulu elidabula umhlaba lisendleleni yasempumalanga lilahlekelwa isikhathi, kuyilapho iwashi elifanayo elindiza entshonalanga lithola isikhathi (Uphenyo lukaHafele-Keating)?
options: Isivinini sokunyakaza sifaka ku-velocity yokujikeleza komhlaba ngasempumalanga endleleni yasempumalanga bese sisusa kweyokuhamba entshonalanga, sokuguqula isikhathi sokudilizwa okwe-relativistic
Izindiza ezisempumalanga zihamba zingene emkhakheni kagesi welanga
Izindiza ezisentshonalanga zihamba zehle isiqondiso somhlaba
Amaphethini ejethi akhipha izingcezu ezinamandla adalayo
correctAnswer: Isivinini sokunyakaza sifaka ku-velocity yokujikeleza komhlaba ngasempumalanga endleleni yasempumalanga bese sisusa kweyokuhamba entshonalanga, sokuguqula isikhathi sokudilizwa okwe-relativistic
explanation: Ngo-1971, uHafele noKeating bahamba namawashi e-cesium ezindizeni zezindiza. Ngokwesilinganiso sesigaba somhlaba esingajikelezi, isivinini esiya empumalanga yi v_rot + v_plane (ukudilazwa kwesikhathi okukhulu, iwashi lisebenza kancane), kuyilapho ngasentshonalanga yi v_rot - v_plane (iwashi lisebenza ngokushesha).

question: Kungani umuntu obuka ilayiphi lokuhlobisa elikhanyiswe nge-fiber optic ebona amaphuzu akhazimulayo okukhanya kombala kuphela emiphethweni yeziqhongo ezicacile zepulasitiki?
options: Ukubonakaliswa okuphelele kwangaphakathi kugcina ukukhanya konke ngaphakathi kwe-core ecacile, kuphume kuphela lapho ama-fiber ephela emaphethelweni acishiwe
Imiphetho iqukethe amabhulbhu okukhanya amancane e-LED
correctAnswer: Ukubonakaliswa okuphelele kwangaphakathi kugcina ukukhanya konke ngaphakathi kwe-core ecacile, kuphume kuphela lapho ama-fiber ephela emaphethelweni acishiwe
explanation: Ukukhanya okungene esisekelweni kuqhubeka nokubonakaliswa okuphelele kwangaphakathi eceleni kwe-cylindrical dielectric waveguide. Amafotoni awukwazi ukuphuma kuze kushintshe isimo somngcele emaphethelweni acishiwe.

question: Kungani ukwehla kombala okubomvu kwe-cosmological okubangelwa ukwandiswa komkhathi kweplanethi kuhluke kakhulu emthethweni ojwayelekile we-Doppler?
options: Ukubomvu kwe-cosmological kukhudlula i-wavelength yokukhanya njengoba uboya besikhala sikhula ngesikhathi sokuhamba
Amagalaxi akude ahamba esikhaleni ngokushesha okungaphezu kokukhanya
Ungqimba lomkhathi luhlakaza amawavelength aluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka aye kobomvu
Amandla adonsela phansi anciphisa isivinini sokukhanya kuze kube yimiqulu ebomvu
correctAnswer: Ukubomvu kwe-cosmological kukhudlula i-wavelength yokukhanya njengoba uboya besikhala sikhula ngesikhathi sokuhamba
explanation: Umphumela we-Doppler wukunyakaza kwe-kinematic ngaphesheya kwesikhala esime. Ukwehla kombala kwe-cosmological z = (a_obs / a_emit) - 1 kwenzeka ngenxa yokuthi ukwanda komlinganiso wesikhathi nesikhala yandisa ngokomzimba ama-wavelengths e-photon ahamba.

question: Kungani i-Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs) evela emkhathini omude ifika nezikhathi eziphakeme ezifinyelela ama-radio dishes ngaphambi kwezikhathi eziphansi (Ukusatshalaliswa kwePlasma)?
options: I-plasma enezinto ezikhanyisiwe phakathi nezinkanyezi naphakathi kwamagalaxi iyanciphisa izikhathi eziphansi kakhulu kunezikhathi eziphakeme ngokuhambisana nenani lamakholomu e-electron
Amaza e-radio anezikhathi eziphakeme anesisindo esincane ngokwengxenye yomzimba
Amaza anezikhathi eziphansi abuyele emuva ezimweni zezinto ezimnyama
Amatalakithi asebenza kancane ngezinga lemisindo ephansi
correctAnswer: I-plasma enezinto ezikhanyisiwe phakathi nezinkanyezi naphakathi kwamagalaxi iyanciphisa izikhathi eziphansi kakhulu kunezikhathi eziphakeme ngokuhambisana nenani lamakholomu e-electron
explanation: Ukulibaziseka kokusatshalaliswa Delta t = 4.15 ms * DM * (nu_low^-2 - nu_high^-2). Okwamahhala we-electron ku-plasma phakathi kwamagalaxi kube nomthelela ekuhamba kwezigaba ngokwe-frequency, okuvumela ososayensi bezinkanyezi ukukala izinto ze-cosmic eziphakathi.

question: Kumhloli okude osesikhathini sangaphandle, isikhumbuzi esiwela endlini emnyama enkulu kakhulu sibonakala simile ekhoneni lesenzakalo phakade. Empeleni isikhumbuzi sihlangana nalokhu kanjani?
options: Isikhumbuzi siwela ngokuthambile phakathi kwekhona lesenzakalo esikhathini esinqunyiwe sokufanele ngaphandle kokuma nhlobo
Isikhumbuzi siguquka sibe amandla amnyama aqinile ngokushesha
correctAnswer: Isikhumbuzi siwela ngokuthambile phakathi kwekhona lesenzakalo esikhathini esinqunyiwe sokufanele ngaphandle kokuma nhlobo
explanation: Isikhathi sokuhleleka t siya kosqongweni ku-r = 2M kubahloli abakude ngenxa yokudonsa komhlaba. Esikhathini sokuhamba kwesikhumbuzi tau, ukuwela ikhona kuthambile futhi ngaphandle komcimbi omkhulu.

question: Iyiphi into engajwayelekile yesitimela se-astronomical ephakanyiswe uKip Thorne no-Anna Żytkow (iThorne-Żytkow Object)?
options: Inkwenkwezi enkulu ebomvu esigcinwe isibalo se-neutron esinemininingwane, iphakathi kwe-neutron njenge-core yayo enkulu esebenzayo
correctAnswer: Inkwenkwezi enkulu ebomvu esigcinwe isibalo se-neutron esinemininingwane, iphakathi kwe-neutron njenge-core yayo enkulu esebenzayo
explanation: Ukushayisana kwababili kuholela ekutheni inkwenkwezi enkulu ebomvu idle isihambi sayo se-neutron. I-neutron core ehlukile inikeza amandla adonsela phansi ngokusebenzisa i-rp-process nucleosynthesis, ifana nenkwenkwezi enkulu ene-anomalies yamakhemikhali eyingqayizivele.

question: Esikhathini sefiziksi yezinkanyezi eceleni, yini i-'Kugelblitz'?
options: Umbhobho omnyama owakhiwe ngokuphelele ngenxa yokugqokwa okukhulu kokukhanya okuqondiswe kahle kwesibani somsebenzi kagesi (ukukhanya) kunokwakheka kwesibindi
correctAnswer: Umbhobho omnyama owakhiwe ngokuphelele ngenxa yokugqokwa okukhulu kokukhanya okuqondiswe kahle kwesibani somsebenzi kagesi (ukukhanya) kunokwakheka kwesibindi
explanation: Ku-General Relativity, amandla aguqula isikhala nesikhathi nge-stress-energy tensor T_munu. Ukuqondisa ukukhanya okwanele endaweni encane kubamba ukukhanya ngaphakathi kwe-radius yayo yobumnyama be-Schwarzschild, kwakha i-Kugelblitz.

question: Kungani u-Albert Einstein ephikisana kakhulu nomqondo we-'Relativistic Mass' (umqondo wokuthi into iyakhuphuka ngokomzimba njengoba isheshisa)?
options: Ubuningi buwukulinganisa okungashintshi; ijubane lishintsha amandla okudonsa okwe-relativistic namandla, hhayi ubuningi bokuphumula obuyisisekelo m_0
Izinto ezihambayo zilahlekelwa ama-athomu ngenxa yokungqubuzana
correctAnswer: Ubuningi buwukulinganisa okungashintshi; ijubane lishintsha amandla okudonsa okwe-relativistic namandla, hhayi ubuningi bokuphumula obuyisisekelo m_0
explanation: U-Einstein wabhala ukuthi ukwethula inhlayiya yokuziphendukela kwemvelo m = gamma * m_0 kuyadida futhi akuvumelani nezimiso ze-covariant. Ifisiksi yanamuhla ichaza inhlayiya ngokungaguquki kuphela njengenhlayiya ekuphumeni m = sqrt(E^2 - p^2 c^2) / c^2.

question: Kungani igalaksi elikhulu eliphakathi lidalela uzungezo oluphelele, olukhanyayo olujikelezayo olwaziwa ngokuthi 'i-Einstein Ring'?
options: Umthombo wokukhanya ongemuva, igalaksi lensi ephambili, noMhlaba bahlelekile emgqeni oqondile, olinganayo
Igalaksi liyasha igesi ye-hydrogen ebunjwe njengeringi
Ukujika kwegalaaksi kudiliza izinkanyezi phakathi kwe-halo
correctAnswer: Umthombo wokukhanya ongemuva, igalaksi lensi ephambili, noMhlaba bahlelekile emgqeni oqondile, olinganayo
explanation: Ukuthinteka komthwalo womkhathi kudonse ukukhanya ezungeze inani. Uma umthombo, i-lens, nomlobi behlangene endaweni yesikhala esisodwa sokubuka, ukuvumelana komgogodla kudonsa ama-wavefront angemuva abe yi-Einstein ring enobubanzi be-engeli theta_E.

question: Abahloli bezinkanyezi bangayithola kanjani 'iziplanethi ezizimele' ezihambayo esikhaleni esimnyama ngokuphelele ngaphandle kwesibani esiyinhloko (Ukulinganisa Kwamandla Okudonsa Ngesibani)?
options: Amandla okudonsela phansi epulanethi ehambayo agxila ngokwesikhashana futhi anyuse ukukhanya okuvela enkanyezini esengemuva njengengilazi enkulu yezinkanyezi
Iplanethi ephambukayo ibonisa ukukhanya okujulile kwezinkanyezi
Izibuko zezinkanyezi zilandelela imikhondo yokukhishwa kweplanethi
correctAnswer: Amandla okudonsela phansi epulanethi ehambayo agxila ngokwesikhashana futhi anyuse ukukhanya okuvela enkanyezini esengemuva njengengilazi enkulu yezinkanyezi
explanation: Ukulinganisa kwamandla okudonsela phansi kwenzeka lapho into encane engakhanyisiwe ifika phambi kwenkanyezi esengemuva. Insimu yayo kazibuthe iguqula imisebe yokukhanya, ikhiqiza ukukhuphuka kwesikhashana okulinganayo ekubonakaleni kokukhanya kwenkanyezi.

question: Yini echaza imingcele ye-'Hill Sphere' yesiphumluli somkhathi emishinini yezinkanyezi?
options: Isifunda sendawo esizungeze umzimba lapho ukudonselana kwawo okwakhe kuqhuba kakhulu kunokudonselana kwenkanyezi yakhe enkulu
Ibanga lapho izinkambu zikagesi zesiphumluli ziphela khona
Indlela yokuhamba kwenkanyezi yokwenziwa ephakeme kakhulu
correctAnswer: Isifunda sendawo esizungeze umzimba lapho ukudonselana kwawo okwakhe kuqhuba kakhulu kunokudonselana kwenkanyezi yakhe enkulu
explanation: I-radius ye-Hill sphere r_H = a * (1 - e) * (m / 3M)^(1/3) ichaza isifunda sokudonselana. Izinyanga ezizungeze ngaphandle kwe-Hill sphere ekugcineni ziyasuswa ukutshaywa komoya welanga.

question: Kungani ama-Asteroids e-Trojan ehlala ehlanganisiwe unomphela ama-degree angama-60 phambili (L4) kanye nama-degree angama-60 emuva (L5) kuJupiter ngaphandle kokuwela iplanethi noma ukuphuma kude?
options: Amandla e-Coriolis esakazweni esijikelezayo azinzisa ama-orbit azungeze amaphoyinti e-Lagrange alinganayo ngokumelene nokuphazamiseka komhlaba wonke
Umoya welanga uwabambezela ama-asteroids ebqeni lesikhala
correctAnswer: Amandla e-Coriolis esakazweni esijikelezayo azinzisa ama-orbit azungeze amaphoyinti e-Lagrange alinganayo ngokumelene nokuphazamiseka komhlaba wonke
explanation: L4 kanye ne-L5 zingamaphakethe aphezulu ekusebenzeni kwamandla okusebenza. Ukuvunyelwa kwe-Coriolis kulinganisa ukudlulela komhlaba wonke nokuphuma kwe-centrifugal kuma-mass ratios M1/M2 > 24.96, kubamba ngamandla ama-swarms e-Trojan.

question: Kungani ukukhanya kwelanga kuhlangothi luthinta futhi kushintshe izindlela zokujikeleza zamanye ama-asteroid amancane ngokuhamba kweminyaka eyizigidigidi (Umphumela we-Yarkovsky)?
options: I-asteroid ishisa eceleni layo lalo ntambama bese iphinda ikhiphe ama-thermal infrared photons ngenhloso yokuphindisela
Umoya welanga ugunda ngokomzimba ungqimba lwama-asteroid
Ama-solar flares anyibilikisa inhliziyo yethusi ye-asteroid
correctAnswer: I-asteroid ishisa eceleni layo lalo ntambama bese iphinda ikhiphe ama-thermal infrared photons ngenhloso yokuphindisela
explanation: Ngenxa yokumelana nokushisa, indawo eshisayo ye-asteroid ayikuso phakathi nosuku, kodwa ntambama. Ukukhupha ama-thermal infrared photons ngendlela engafani nezindleko kunikeza amandla wokuphendula, kushintsha i-semi-major axis ngokuhamba kweminyaka eyizigidigidi.

question: Kungani i-injini yesibhakela eshisa ikhona ikhiqiza amandla e-kinetic amaningi kakhulu uma ishiswa ku-periapsis (ukusondela okuseduze kakhulu nokushesha okuphezulu kwe-orbital) kunaku-apoapsis (Umphumela ka-Oberth)?
options: Amandla e-kinetic atholwayo akhula ngokushesha kwenqwaba yesithuthi: Delta KE = m * v * Delta v + 0.5 * m * (Delta v)^2
correctAnswer: Amandla e-kinetic atholwayo akhula ngokushesha kwenqwaba yesithuthi: Delta KE = m * v * Delta v + 0.5 * m * (Delta v)^2
explanation: UHermann Oberth wathola ukuthi ngenxa yokuthi amandla e-kinetic ahlobene no-v^2, ukuhlanganisa i-Delta v ngesivinini esiphezulu v kuguqula amandla okuphakela amakhemikhali ube amandla e-kinetic wesithuthi ngokuphumelelayo kakhulu.

question: Kungani ukuhamba okuhamba kancane okungaqondakali kwesiphequluli se-Pioneer 10 no-11 kwaqaqa abaphysicists iminyaka eminingi kwaze kwaxazululwa ngo-2012 (i-Pioneer Anomaly)?
options: Ukukhishwa okungalingani kokushisa: ukushisa okuvela kuma-radioisotope thermoelectric generators angaphakathi kwezindiza kwakushayisana ngasemva kwegobolondo eliphakeme, kukhiqize amandla amancane okuphendula
Ukudonsa okumnyama izinto ezimnyama kudonse ama-probe
Ushintsho lwe-Newton oluyisisekelo G esikhaleni esijulile
Igesi phakathi kwezinkanyezi yavimba ama-thrusters e-probe
correctAnswer: Ukukhishwa okungalingani kokushisa: ukushisa okuvela kuma-radioisotope thermoelectric generators angaphakathi kwezindiza kwakushayisana ngasemva kwegobolondo eliphakeme, kukhiqize amandla amancane okuphendula
explanation: U-Slava Turyshev waxazulula le anomaly: ukukhishwa okungalingani kokushisa okuphuma kumabhokisi kagesi nama-RTG akhanyiselwe phambili ku-antenna ye-parabolic, kukhiqiza ukusheshiswa kwe-thermal photon okungamodelwanga a_P = -(8.74 x 10^-10) m/s^2 eya eLanga.

question: Indiza yesikhala ithola kanjani ijubane elikhulu ngeSlingshot yeGravitational (Usizo Lwamandla adonsela phansi) eduze komkhathi ohambayo ngaphandle kokwephula umthetho wokulondolozwa kwamandla?
options: Indiza yesikhala ikweba ingxenye encane kakhulu ye-momentum enkulu yomkhathi ozungeza iLanga, ikhuphula ijubane layo elizungeze iLanga
Insimu kazibuthe yomkhathi iphonsela indiza yesikhala njengomshini wesitimela
Izivunguvungu zelanga zivutha uphethiloli olusele lokudubula ifutha
correctAnswer: Indiza yesikhala ikweba ingxenye encane kakhulu ye-momentum enkulu yomkhathi ozungeza iLanga, ikhuphula ijubane layo elizungeze iLanga
explanation: Emhlabeni womkhathi, ukuhlangana kuyagudluka (ijubane lokungena = ijubane lokuphuma). Emhlabeni weLanga, indiza yesikhala iphuma ngo v_final ~ v_initial + 2 * v_planet, ikhipha ingxenye encane kakhulu yamandla okuzungeza komkhathi.

question: Kungani isazi senkanyezi sokuqambisa ama-rocket uKonstantin Tsiolkovsky abiza i-equation yakhe edumile ye-rocket, i-Delta v = v_e * ln(m_0 / m_f), ngokuthi 'ubukhosi bemithetho ye-rocket'?
options: Ukuze engeze umthwalo noma isivinini, isisindo samafutha adingekayo sikhula ngokwe-exponential, ngoba i-rocket kumele iphathe amafutha ukuze iphakamise amafutha.
Injini zama-rocket ziyashisa ngemva kwemizuzu emi-3.
correctAnswer: Ukuze engeze umthwalo noma isivinini, isisindo samafutha adingekayo sikhula ngokwe-exponential, ngoba i-rocket kumele iphathe amafutha ukuze iphakamise amafutha.
explanation: Ngoba isilinganiso sobunzima m_0 / m_f = exp(Delta v / v_e) siyakhuphuka ngokwe-exponential, ukufinyelela isivinini se-orbit (~8 km/s) ngamajarabhu amakhemikhali (v_e ~ 3-4 km/s) kudinga cishe u-90% wobunzima bemoto yokwethula ukuba kube ama-propellant ahlanzekile.

question: Kungani ama-ion thrusters endaweni ejulile yesikhala ehambisa amandla aphansi alingana nobunzima beshidi lephepha, kodwa agqula amasathelayithi aye eplanethini ekude ngokushesha kunamakhabhu amakhemikhali?
options: Ama-ion thrusters afinyelela i-impulse ekhethekile ephakeme kakhulu kanye nezivinini zokukhishwa (30 kuya ku-50 km/s), esebenza ngokuqhubekayo iminyaka eminingi.
Onjiniyela be-ion basebenzisa amashidi elanga ukubonakalisa ukukhanya kwelanga.
correctAnswer: Ama-ion thrusters afinyelela i-impulse ekhethekile ephakeme kakhulu kanye nezivinini zokukhishwa (30 kuya ku-50 km/s), esebenza ngokuqhubekayo iminyaka eminingi.
explanation: Nakuba amandla F = m_dot * v_e emancane ngenxa yokugeleza okuncane kwesisindo m_dot, isivinini sokukhishwa v_e siphakeme kakhulu kunokushiswa kwamakhemikhali. Ukushaya isikhathi eside cishe amahora angu-10,000 kuhlanganisa i-Delta v enkulu kakhulu.

question: Indlela i-Solar Sail engakwazi ngayo ukuqhuba isikhala semkhathi ngaphandle kokuthwala inyunyana eyodwa kawoyela ephakathi kwekhondi?
options: Ukubonakaliswa kwamaphoton kudlulisa kabili amandla awo (p = 2E/c) esikhangweni esibonakalayo ngegesi yokukhanya
Umoya welanga uphakamisa isikhala njengomoya wolwandle ophakamisa isikhala
Ukukhanya kwelanga kugcwalisa amabhethri elanga ukuqhuba izifeni
correctAnswer: Ukubonakaliswa kwamaphoton kudlulisa kabili amandla awo (p = 2E/c) esikhangweni esibonakalayo ngegesi yokukhanya
explanation: Amaphoton aphethe amandla p = E/c. Isibuko esibuyisela ngokugcwele amaphoton sibuyisela amandla, sinikezela amandla Delta p = 2 * E / c. Umfutho oqhubekayo wokukhanya (~9 micro-Newtons/m^2 eduze kwePlanethi) usheshisa isikhala esisemkhathini ngokuqhubekayo.

question: Indlela amateleskopu ezinkanyezi ezisephansi zomhlaba asebenzisa i-Adaptive Optics afinyelela ngayo ekusebenziseni ukubonakalisa okucacile kunamateleskopu we-Hubble Space?
options: Inkwenkwezi yomhlahlandlela ye-laser ikala ukuqhuma kwamafu emoyeni, nekhompyutha ilungisa isibuko esiguquguqukayo izikhathi ezingama-1,000 ngomzuzwana ukuze ikhulule ukuphazamiseka komoya.
Amateleskopu asemhlabeni asebenzisa izikrini zekhompyutha ezinkulu.
Onjiniyela bavala umoya ngaphakathi kwedome le-observatory.
Ukuphazamiseka komoya kuyaqina phakathi nobusuku obuphakathi.
correctAnswer: Inkwenkwezi yomhlahlandlela ye-laser ikala ukuqhuma kwamafu emoyeni, nekhompyutha ilungisa isibuko esiguquguqukayo izikhathi ezingama-1,000 ngomzuzwana ukuze ikhulule ukuphazamiseka komoya.
explanation: Ukuphazamiseka komoya kuyaphazamiseka ama-wavefronts (i-Fried parameter r_0). I-Adaptive optics ikala ukuphazamiseka isebenzisa inkwenkwezi yomhlahlandlela ye-sodium laser futhi isebenzisa ama-actuator e-piezoelectric ukuguqula isibuko esincane, ibuyisele umkhawulo we-diffraction.

question: I-Event Horizon Telescope yathatha kanjani isithombe sokuqala esingaqondile sesikhala esimnyama esikhulu kakhulu e-galaxy M87 ngo-2019?
options: Ngokuhlanganisa izitsha zomsakazo ezihambisanayo emhlabeni wonke usebenzisa i-Very Long Baseline Interferometry ukudala ithesikopu elibonakalayo elilingana noMhlaba
Ngokuthumela iphrakthoni yezobuchwepheshe esikhungweni somcimbi se-M87
correctAnswer: Ngokuhlanganisa izitsha zomsakazo ezihambisanayo emhlabeni wonke usebenzisa i-Very Long Baseline Interferometry ukudala ithesikopu elibonakalayo elilingana noMhlaba
explanation: Ukulungiswa kwe-engeli theta ~ lambda / D. Ngokuhlanganisa izikhungo zomsakazo eHawaii, eChile, e-Europe, naseSouth Pole ngokusebenzisa amawashi e-athomu, i-EHT yadalela indawo yokuvula D elilingana nobubanzi beMhlaba, yalungisa ama-microarcseconds angama-20.

question: Abaphilisisayensi baze bathole kanjani igebe elingaziwa elingamamitha angama-30 ngaphakathi kweGquma Elikhulu laseGiza ngo-2017 ngaphandle kokumba itshe elilodwa (Muon Tomography)?
options: Ama-muon e-ray yomkhathi adlula ngezitshe kodwa amuncwa ngokwehlukana kuye ngokunamandla; izinzwa zirekhoda ukwanda kwe-flux ye-muon edlula egobeni elingenalutho
Ngokuthumela ama-wave e-ultrasound ezindlebeni zesigodlo sezigodlo
Ngokukala izinga lokushisa komhlaba ngamakhamera e-infrared
correctAnswer: Ama-muon e-ray yomkhathi adlula ngezitshe kodwa amuncwa ngokwehlukana kuye ngokunamandla; izinzwa zirekhoda ukwanda kwe-flux ye-muon edlula egobeni elingenalutho
explanation: Ama-muons adalwe ama-ray emkhathi adlula amakhulu ezikhala zamatshe. Amaplathi e-nuclear emulsion nama-scintillator trackers akala ukuncipha kwe-muon okukhethwa ngendawo: igebe elingenalutho livumela ama-muon amaningi ukuthi adlule, libonisa isakhiwo sawo se-3D.

question: Indlela i-PET Scan yezokwelapha (Positron Emission Tomography) esho ngayo amathumba omdlavuza ngaphakathi komzimba womuntu ngokunemba okungaphansi kwe-millimeter ingakanani?
options: I-tracer e-radiyokhwekhwe elenjulile ifaka amapositron ahlaselana nama-elektroni, ikhulula ama-gamma rays amabili ayi-511 keV kuma-degree angama-180 abikwaziwa ngesikhathi esifanayo
Ama-laser e-X-ray ashisa amaseli omdlavuza ngqo
Izinkambu ze-magnetic zenza ama-athomu ensimbi e-tumor ajike
correctAnswer: I-tracer e-radiyokhwekhwe elenjulile ifaka amapositron ahlaselana nama-elektroni, ikhulula ama-gamma rays amabili ayi-511 keV kuma-degree angama-180 abikwaziwa ngesikhathi esifanayo
explanation: I-Fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) igxile kumathumba anoshukela ophezulu. Ukuwohloka kwe-positron beta+ kuholela ku-e+ e- ukubhubha, kudubula ama-gamma photons amabili ayi-511 keV aqondile abikwaziwa ngesikhathi esifanayo ngobukhulu besiyingi, okukhipha umugqa wokuphendula.

question: Kungani umshini we-MRI wenza imisindo emikhulu yokushaya nokucindezela ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa kwezokwelapha kobuchopho?
options: Amandla kaLorentz: iziqhebezo zikagesi ezisindayo eziguquguqukayo ezidlula emayini ye-gradient ngaphakathi emkhakheni kazibuthe we-3-Tesla zibangela lezi coils ukuba ziguquke zomile futhi zishaye ezindaweni zabo
Amathambo ekhanda lesiguli aphindaphinda amasignali omsakazo
correctAnswer: Amandla kaLorentz: iziqhebezo zikagesi ezisindayo eziguquguqukayo ezidlula emayini ye-gradient ngaphakathi emkhakheni kazibuthe we-3-Tesla zibangela lezi coils ukuba ziguquke zomile futhi zishaye ezindaweni zabo
explanation: Ama-gradient coils aguqula ngokushesha ama-gradient kazibuthe ukuze kuqoqwe indawo. Izinga elikhulu likagesi (amaphampu angamakhulu) emkhakheni oqinile we-3T lidala amandla anesilinganiso esikhulu sikaLorentz (F = I * L x B), ehla egadini yomshini wokushaya ama-coil kumasignali omsindo.

question: Kungani i-Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS) ingadala ngokungenabuhlungu ukuntshontsha umunwe womuntu noma okwamanje iphoxe inkulumo ngaphandle kokuthinta ubuchopho?
options: Ukukhishwa kukagesi kwe-Faraday: ikhowudi yensimu yomsindo ebekwe ebusweni bekhanda idala ukushayela kukagesi okuncane ezinzwaneni zomzimba ongaphansi kobuso bekhanda
Izimboni zensimu zikhanga insimbi egazini iye kumunwe
correctAnswer: Ukukhishwa kukagesi kwe-Faraday: ikhowudi yensimu yomsindo ebekwe ebusweni bekhanda idala ukushayela kukagesi okuncane ezinzwaneni zomzimba ongaphansi kobuso bekhanda
explanation: Ikhowudi ye-figure-8 iphakamisa insimu engu-2-Tesla cishe emayikhosini angama-100. NgokweMithetho kaFaraday curl(E) = -dB/dt, ukushintsha okusheshayo kwensimu kazibuthe kudala insimu kagesi emzimbeni wedlala, kudinga izindonga ze-axon zezinzwa futhi kubangele ukuphendula kwezimiso zokusebenza.

question: Kanjani i-Optogenetics eshintsha umqondo ivumela ososayensi bobuchopho ukuthi bavule futhi bavale izinkumbulo nezindlela ezenzakalayo ezithile besebenzisa ama-pulse okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka e-laser?
options: Iziteshi ze-ion ezicubungula ukukhanya ezibizwa ngokuthi i-opsin yamagciwane (i-Channelrhodopsin-2) zifakwa ngokwezakhi zofuzo kuzicubu ezithile ezinezintambo, okubenza bacishe uma kukhanya okwesibhakabhaka
Ama-laser aluhlaza ashisa ama-neurons ukuvusa ama-neurotransmitters
Amafothoni ayashesha izicubu zegazi emithanjeni yobuchopho
correctAnswer: Iziteshi ze-ion ezicubungula ukukhanya ezibizwa ngokuthi i-opsin yamagciwane (i-Channelrhodopsin-2) zifakwa ngokwezakhi zofuzo kuzicubu ezithile ezinezintambo, okubenza bacishe uma kukhanya okwesibhakabhaka
explanation: U-Ed Boyden no-Karl Deisseroth banethule ama-gene e-ChR2 ngezakhi zofuzo ezithathelwayo. Ukukhanya okuluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka (470 nm) kuvula isiteshi se-ion se-opsin, kushayela ukungena kwe-Na+ okusheshayo okujwayele ukufinyelela ukudlidliza kweseli somzimba esihlosiwe phakathi kwamamilisekhondi.

question: Kungani ukutholakala kokuthi izifo eziyingozi ezifana ne-Mad Cow ne-Kuru zibangelwa amaPrion kwabhekwa njengokungakholeki okubabazekayo emolekyuli yezinhlayiyana?
options: AmaPrion ayizinto ezibangelayo ezosulelayo ezakhiwe ngokuphelele ngamaprotheni aqhekekile engekho nakancane i-DNA noma i-RNA
AmaPrion ayizibungu zangaphandle ezivela ematshe avela esikwatini semeteorite
Isifo sidalwa yizingodo zeglasi ezincane kakhulu
Isifo seMad Cow sidalwa amagciwane ohlaza
correctAnswer: AmaPrion ayizinto ezibangelayo ezosulelayo ezakhiwe ngokuphelele ngamaprotheni aqhekekile engekho nakancane i-DNA noma i-RNA
explanation: Stanley Prusiner wafakazela umqondo othi ku-protein kuphela. Amaprotheni amaPrion aqhekekile (PrPSc) asebenza njengezifanekiso ezidala ukuthi amaprotheni ajwayelekile (PrPC) aphinde aqukathe kuhlelo lokwakheka oluxhumene ne-amyloid beta-sheet ngaphandle kwanoma iyiphi ikhodi yomzimba wedna.

question: I-Tardigrades encane kakhulu (Amabhande Amanzi) ingaphila kanjani ngaphandle kwamanzi ngokuphelele, ekungeneni komoya wangaphandle, nasekutholeni ukushiswa okungaphezu kwesikhathi esiningi kwabantu (i-Cryptobiosis)?
options: Bathatha indawo yamanzi emzimbeni ngamaprotheni akhethekile avikela i-glass (TDPs), bangena esimweni esibanjelwe njenge-vitrified
correctAnswer: Bathatha indawo yamanzi emzimbeni ngamaprotheni akhethekile avikela i-glass (TDPs), bangena esimweni esibanjelwe njenge-vitrified
explanation: Ama-Tardigrades aveza ama-protein angahlelekile e-tardigrade (TDPs) kanye ne-trehalose. Ukoma ku-vitrifies ingaphakathi leseli labo libe iglasi yebhayoloji, kubophe ama-macromolecule futhi kumisa ukusebenza kwesimiso (isimo se-tun) unomphela.

question: Kungani izintwala ezinkulu ezingaphansi kolwandle ezihlala emigodini ye-hydrothermal ejulile ku-2,500 metres zikhula kahle ebumnyameni obuphelele ngaphandle kwanoma yiluphi ukhanyiso lwelanga?
options: Amabhaktheriya e-chemotrophic asebenzisanayo aguqula i-hydrogen sulfide eyingozi evela emgodini wevolokano ukuze akhe izakhamzimba eziphilayo (iChemosynthesis)
Izintwala zidla izindlovu ezifa ezwehlela phansi kuphela
Imigodi yevolokano ikhipha ukukhanya kwe-ultraviolet ukuze kube nokufotoynthesis
Izintwala zamukela amandla ashisayo e-magma ngegills
correctAnswer: Amabhaktheriya e-chemotrophic asebenzisanayo aguqula i-hydrogen sulfide eyingozi evela emgodini wevolokano ukuze akhe izakhamzimba eziphilayo (iChemosynthesis)
explanation: IRiftia pachyptila ayinazo izinhlelo zokugaya ukudla. Ibanikeza amabhaktheriya ayizigidigidi endaweni ye-trophosome agxotha i-carbon engenzi lutho nge-oxidation ye-sulfide: H2S + 2O2 -> SO4^2- + 2H+ + amandla, okugcina izinhlelo zemvelo zizimele emandleni elanga.

question: Kungani umuntu oneziteshi zangaphakathi zomphimbo ezilimele ezindlebeni ezibangelwa iziteshi eziyindilinga ezibhekelelwa umuzwa, ehlangabezana nokujikeleza okukhulu kwegumbi njalo lapho eguqa ikhanda (BPPV)?
options: Amaqhwa e-calcium carbonate (otoconia) ahlukanisiwe ahamba ngaphakathi emafutheni eziteshi eziyindilinga, adonsa izicubu zomsebenzi wokuzwa ngendlela engafanele ngenxa yomhlaba.
Imithambo yokuzwa ilahlekelwa yonke imisebe kagesi.
Umhuzuko wendlebe uvimba ukugeleza kwegazi okuya ebuchosheni.
correctAnswer: Amaqhwa e-calcium carbonate (otoconia) ahlukanisiwe ahamba ngaphakathi emafutheni eziteshi eziyindilinga, adonsa izicubu zomsebenzi wokuzwa ngendlela engafanele ngenxa yomhlaba.
explanation: Ku-Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo, ama-otoconia ahlukanisiwe ahlala esiteshini sangemuva esiyindilinga semisebenzi. Ukuqagela ikhanda kubangela ukudonswa komhlaba emanzini e-endolymph, ukujikeleza kwe-cupula, nokuzwa okunenkohliso kwe-nystagmus.

question: Kungani umgibeli ogibele isikebhe eba nokugula okukhulu kokuhamba ngasolwandle ngisho naselele ngokuphelele embhedeni okhululekile wekhabhinethi?
options: Imfundiso ye-Sensory Conflict: amathambo azungeze ngaphakathi kwe-labyrinth ephakathi kwezindlebe akhomba ukunyakaza okuqhubekayo kwesiqhingi ngenkathi amehlo ebona igumbi lekhabhinethi elimele
correctAnswer: Imfundiso ye-Sensory Conflict: amathambo azungeze ngaphakathi kwe-labyrinth ephakathi kwezindlebe akhomba ukunyakaza okuqhubekayo kwesiqhingi ngenkathi amehlo ebona igumbi lekhabhinethi elimele
explanation: Ukuhamba okukhulu kwesifo sokugula kwenzeka lapho ama-vestibular semicircular canals ehlola usheshayo, kodwa izimpawu zokubona ezivela odongeni olungashukumi lekhabhinethi zirekhoda ukunyakaza okungu-zero. Ingqondo ihumusha lokhu ukuphambana kwezimpawu eziningi njengokubonwa kwe-neurotoxin, okuvusa ukuhlanza.

question: Kungani ukuphuza amanzi ahlanzekile amaningi kakhulu ngemva kokuzivocavoca okuphezulu komzimba kungaba yingozi (Ukudla Amanzi / Hyponatremia)?
options: Ukuncipha kakhulu kwamangqamuzana esodium egazini kudala umehluko wokumuncwa kwamanzi okushukumisela amanzi ukuthi angene kumaseli ebuchopho, okubangela ukuvuvukala kobuchopho okubulalayo
Amanzi ahlanzekile abanda ngaphakathi kwemithambo yegazi
Amanzi ayenza ukuthi ama-enzyme okuh digest permanently
correctAnswer: Ukuncipha kakhulu kwamangqamuzana esodium egazini kudala umehluko wokumuncwa kwamanzi okushukumisela amanzi ukuthi angene kumaseli ebuchopho, okubangela ukuvuvukala kobuchopho okubulalayo
explanation: Ukugcwaliswa ngokweqile okungaphansi kokulinganisa kwe-hypotonic kwe-hydration kwehlisa i-sodium yegazi ngaphansi kuka-135 mEq/L. Ingcindezi ye-osmotic iphoqa uketshezi olungaphandle kweseli ukuba lungene kumakhompartment angaphakathi kweseli, kubangele ukugcwala kwezitho ze-neurons ngaphakathi kwekhanda eliqinile futhi kubangele i-herniation ebulala.

question: Kungani ukunyathela esikalithini esiphukile esimi endaweni esenza umuntu azizwe engalingani okwethulwa okwesikhashana, naphezu kokwazi ukuthi asihambi?
options: I-cerebellum ngokuzenzakalelayo iqalisa uhlelo olungaqapheli lokulungisa ukunyakaza olusekelwe kumakhono okubonwayo afundwayo
Izitebhisi zesikalithini zigcwele uwoyela onamandla kazibuthe
Ugesi ohlala endaweni uwuhlanyisa izimpendulo zesitho somlenze
correctAnswer: I-cerebellum ngokuzenzakalelayo iqalisa uhlelo olungaqapheli lokulungisa ukunyakaza olusekelwe kumakhono okubonwayo afundwayo
explanation: 'Uphenyo lwesikalithini esiphukile' lukhombisa ukuzimela komzimba: ukubona izitebhisi zesikalithini kubangela ukulungiswa kwesimo ngomzimba okufundisiwe (ukuzulazula phambili ukuze kubhekwe ukuthuthuzwa okulindelekile), okukhiqiza ukungahambisani kokunyakaza komzimba.

question: Kungani ukunuka iphunga elithile lobuntwana noma iphunga lokudla kushesha ukuveza izinkumbulo ezicace kakhulu, ezingokwemizwa (Umphumela we-Proust)?
options: I-olfactory bulb inezixhumanisi ezinqamulelayo, ezingaqondile zokwakheka kwe-amygdala kanye ne-hippocampus, idlula i-thalamus yokucabanga
Izinhlayiya zephunga ziyanyibilika ku-fluid yasemgogodleni wobuchopho
Izinwele zomlomo ziqukethe amashidi ezinkumbulo zefenitya
correctAnswer: I-olfactory bulb inezixhumanisi ezinqamulelayo, ezingaqondile zokwakheka kwe-amygdala kanye ne-hippocampus, idlula i-thalamus yokucabanga
explanation: Ngokungafani nawo wonke amanye amazinga ombono (umbono, ukuthinta, ukuzwa) adlula enkabeni ye-thalamic relay, amasignali ephunga athumela ngqo kuhlelo lwe-limbic (i-amygdala yemizwa, i-hippocampus yezinkumbulo), okukhiqiza ukukhumbula ngokushesha.

question: Kungani umuntu ophatha ingilazi enamanzi abandayo ebona umqashi njengomzwana obandayo, kanti ukuphatha indebe eshisayo kubenza babone umqashi njengomfudumele nothembekile?
options: Ukuqonda ngomzimba: i-insular cortex ihlela kokubili imizwa yomzimba yokufudumala nomuzwa wobudlelwano nomphakathi isebenzisa izindlela zengqondo ezifanayo
Iziselo ezibandayo ziqeda ukufudumala kwamakhodi okuvocal
correctAnswer: Ukuqonda ngomzimba: i-insular cortex ihlela kokubili imizwa yomzimba yokufudumala nomuzwa wobudlelwano nomphakathi isebenzisa izindlela zengqondo ezifanayo
explanation: ULawrence Williams noJohn Bargh babonisa ukuqeqeshwa komzimba: ukufudumala komzimba kukhuthaza i-insula, kuqeqesha ukufudumala kwemizwa yomphakathi nokuphatha ngokuzithandela ngaphandle kokuqaphela.

question: Kungani umuntu ohamba ngokugcwele ukudicilelwa kokuzwa ezweni elimnyama, lithule, elinemanzi anoshukela oshisayo omzimba eqala ukubona imibono ngokucacile ngaphakathi kwemizuzu engama-45?
options: Ukudicilelwa kokuzwa kuphoqa i-cerebral cortex ukuthi yandise umsindo wengqondo ongahleliwe ngaphakathi ukuze kufezwe ukushoda kokungeniswa kwezimpawu zangaphandle
correctAnswer: Ukudicilelwa kokuzwa kuphoqa i-cerebral cortex ukuthi yandise umsindo wengqondo ongahleliwe ngaphakathi ukuze kufezwe ukushoda kokungeniswa kwezimpawu zangaphandle
explanation: Ubuchopho buyinjini yokubikezela. Lapho ukufinyelela kwezimpawu zangaphandle kwehla kuye ku-zero, amandla engqondo ayanyuselwa. Ukushintshashintsha okuzenzakalelayo kancane kwe-cortical kuchuzwa njengokuzwa ngempela, okuholela ekubonisweni kwemibono.

question: Kungani ukuphindaphinda ukuveza igama elijwayelekile nelivamile (njenge 'door' noma 'fork') ngomsindo izikhathi ezingama-40 kwenza igama libonakale ngokuzumayo njengokungelutho okungenangqondo (Semantic Satiation)?
options: Ukuphindaphinda okude okubangela ukuvuselelwa kubangela ukuvinjelwa kwemizwa ebuchosheni emele izincazelo ezithile, okwenza umsindo uhlukane nomqondo.
Amathambo olimi azizwa ekhathele ngenxa ye-asidi yelactic.
Izintambo zombhalo zitshintsha ukuphakama kwazo komsindo.
Umuthi wokuluma ususa inkumbulo yokunambitheka kwamagama.
correctAnswer: Ukuphindaphinda okude okubangela ukuvuselelwa kubangela ukuvinjelwa kwemizwa ebuchosheni emele izincazelo ezithile, okwenza umsindo uhlukane nomqondo.
explanation: ULeon Jakobovits James wafakazela i-semantic satiation: ukuphindaphinda okuqhubekayo kukhiqiza ukukhathala okuvimbayo ezixhumaneni ezithile zobuchopho, kuhlukanisa ukuqonda komsindo wokuphimisela kanye nokufinyelela incazelo yegama.

question: Kungani abantu ababuka isikrini sethelevishini esinomsindo noma ukwakheka kwamafu bengakwazi ukubona ubuso bomuntu obucacile kalula, kodwa bengenakuvame ukubona izinto eziyimishini ezingahleliwe ezifana nama-toaster (iPareidolia)?
options: Ukuphila ngokwemvelo kufakwe ngaphakathi ku-Fusiform Face Area ukuthi kuthande kakhulu ukubona amaphutha afanele lapho kubhekwa ubuso kunokuphuthelwa ubuso langempela
correctAnswer: Ukuphila ngokwemvelo kufakwe ngaphakathi ku-Fusiform Face Area ukuthi kuthande kakhulu ukubona amaphutha afanele lapho kubhekwa ubuso kunokuphuthelwa ubuso langempela
explanation: Ukubona ubuso kusekelwe ekuhlelweni okuqondile kobuchopho (FFA). I-Theory yokuphathwa kwamaphutha ichaza ukuthi ukungaboni ifu njengomsindo wombulali/umuntu okuseduze akunamphumela wokuhlala phila ngokwemvelo, kuyilapho ukubhosha ubuso obungokoqobo kungaba yingozi.

question: Kungani ukufunda uhlu lwamagama njengalawa [umbhede, vuka, khathala, iphupho, hlonyela, ingubo yokufudumeza] kubangela ukuthi abantu abangama-80 ekhulwini bakhumbule kabi igama elithi 'ulala' lisohlwini (i-DRM Illusion)?
options: Ukusabalalisa ukuvuselelwa kwenethiwekhi yememori yencazelo ngokuzenzakalela kusebenza njengesiqalo sezibizo ezibalulekile ezingashiwongo ezihlanganyela amaphuzu amaningi aphathelene
Uhlu luqukethe amafrekhwensi omsindo angabonakali ngeso lengqondo
Inkumbulo yesikhashana iphela ngemva kwamagama amathathu
correctAnswer: Ukusabalalisa ukuvuselelwa kwenethiwekhi yememori yencazelo ngokuzenzakalela kusebenza njengesiqalo sezibizo ezibalulekile ezingashiwongo ezihlanganyela amaphuzu amaningi aphathelene
explanation: Iparadigimu ye-Deese-Roediger-McDermott ikhombisa ukuthi ukwethula amagama ahlobene kuvusa inqaba yendaba enkulu ('ukulala') kuzinhlelo zokuxhumana ngemisho enencazelo, kudala izinkumbulo ezingamanga ezinethemba eliphezulu.

question: Kungani inkumbulo yomboni wesikhathi sodwa somcimbi wemoto ishintsha kakhulu uma uphenyi efaka imibuzo ethi 'Izimoto zazihamba kanjani ngomzuzu lapho zishayisana?' uma kuqhathaniswa nokuthi 'zaxhumana kanjani' (umthelela Wolwazi Ongalungile)?
options: Ulimi oluholela ngemuva komcimbi luguqula futhi lufake endaweni yokucabanga kwezinkumbulo eziguquguqukayo ngesikhathi senqubo yokuthola ulwazi lwengqondo.
Ababoni basuke bephika iqiniso ngenhloso yokuzuza imivuzo.
Igama elithi 'shaya' lidala amafuoms akhuthaza umsindo ezindlebeni.
Izingozi zezimoto ziyasula izingxenye zangaphambili ze-temporal lobe.
correctAnswer: Ulimi oluholela ngemuva komcimbi luguqula futhi lufake endaweni yokucabanga kwezinkumbulo eziguquguqukayo ngesikhathi senqubo yokuthola ulwazi lwengqondo.
explanation: Elizabeth Loftus wakhombisa ukuthi inkumbulo iyakhiwa kabusha kunokwenziwa kabusha. Ukufaka iziphazamiso ('shaya') ngokubuyela emuva kufaka imininingwane engamanga (efana nokuphuka kweglasi) enkumbulweni yomuntu ekhalwayo.

question: Kungani amakhulu ezigodi zaseYurophu ezijwayelekile ngo-1518 edansa ngokungenamkhawulo esikhumulweni sedolobha amasonto amaningi kwaze kwaba nokukhathala okungenamkhawulo nezinkinga zenhliziyo (iDancing Plague)?
options: Isifo Sobuningi Sengqondo / Ukuqhuma Kokuziphatha Okuningi okubangelwa ukulambela okukhulu, ububha, nokucindezeleka kwengqondo okungokwesiko okabelwana ngakho
correctAnswer: Isifo Sobuningi Sengqondo / Ukuqhuma Kokuziphatha Okuningi okubangelwa ukulambela okukhulu, ububha, nokucindezeleka kwengqondo okungokwesiko okabelwana ngakho
explanation: Umcwaningi weze-mlando uJohn Waller wafakazela ukuthi ukujaha ukudansa kwaseStrasbourg ngo-1518 kwakuyihlukaniso lobuningi bokuqonda. Ngokumelene nokulamba okukhulu kanye nopolwetse lwenkolo lwesijeziso sikaSt. Vitus, izinkolelo ezabiwe zesiko zabangela izimo zokungakwazi ukuzilawula zasakazeka ngokuthinteka kokuziphatha.

question: Kungani abantu abakwi-isolation ephelele izinyanga eziningi bethuthukisa ukukhathazeka okukhulu, ukuzizwa bezwa izinto ezingekho, kanye nokuphazamiseka okukhulu ekuqondeni indawo?
options: Ubuchopho bomuntu budinga impendulo eqhubekayo yezinzwa neyokuxhumana nabantu ukuze bulungise amamodeli bawo okuhlola iqiniso langaphakathi kanye nezinga lemizwa
Amakhelisi okuvalelwa wedwa apendwe ngezinto eziyingozi
correctAnswer: Ubuchopho bomuntu budinga impendulo eqhubekayo yezinzwa neyokuxhumana nabantu ukuze bulungise amamodeli bawo okuhlola iqiniso langaphakathi kanye nezinga lemizwa
explanation: Ukuvalwa kobuchopho kukhawulela amanethiwekhi e-cortical emafomini wokubhekisela acebile ngezinto zokuzwa adingekayo ekucubungulweni kokubikezela kwe-neural. Ngaphandle kokulinganiswa okuqhubekayo okwenzeka ngaphandle, imijikelezo yokuhlola amaphutha iyahluleka, okubangela ukuphazamiseka kwengqondo okunesaba okukhulu.
